title: Digital Marketer for Kathleen Wood Partners
description:
Digital Marketing Strategist — Social Media, Growth & Community



Kathleen Wood Partners is looking for an experienced Digital Marketing Strategist who can help us strengthen our online presence, grow our community, and turn our digital channels into a consistent source of qualified leads and new clients.



We are not looking for someone who simply posts content on social media.



We need someone who understands how to look at a consulting business, understand its audience and offers, identify opportunities, and develop a clear strategy for growth.



About Kathleen Wood Partners

Kathleen Wood Partners is an innovative and award-winning growth strategy firm dedicated to propelling Founder-led businesses to new levels of success.



Our marketing needs to reflect the strength of our expertise while helping us:

* Increase brand awareness

* Reach more qualified founders and business owners

* Generate potential client opportunities

* Build an engaged community

* Strengthen Kathleen Wood’s personal brand

* Position Kathleen Wood Partners as a trusted authority

* Create a consistent strategy across
, Instagram, and LinkedIn



What We’re Looking For

You should have strong experience with:

*
 marketing

* Instagram marketing

* LinkedIn marketing

* Organic social media growth

* Content strategy

* Personal brand marketing

* Lead generation

* Community building

* Marketing funnels and calls to action

* Analytics and performance tracking



Experience working with consulting companies, coaches, professional services firms, founder-led brands, or B2B businesses is strongly preferred.



We want someone who can think strategically and tell us:



What should we be doing?

Why should we be doing it?

How will it help grow the business?

How will we measure whether it is working?



Your Responsibilities

You will help us develop and execute a digital marketing strategy for Kathleen Wood Partners, including:



* Reviewing our current website and social media presence

* Identifying gaps and opportunities

* Developing a social media growth strategy

* Creating a content strategy for
, Instagram, and LinkedIn

* Identifying opportunities to generate leads from our content

* Developing strategies to grow and engage our community

* Recommending content pillars and campaign ideas

* Improving our calls to action and customer journey

* Helping turn followers and engagement into conversations and potential clients

* Reviewing analytics and adjusting the strategy based on results

* Creating a clear marketing plan rather than simply posting content



IMPORTANT — Please Review Us Before Applying



Before submitting your application, please research Kathleen Wood Partners.



Review:

* Our website - 

* Our
 presence

* Our Instagram

* Our LinkedIn presence



We do not want generic applications or copy-and-paste marketing proposals.



In your application, answer these questions:

1. After reviewing Kathleen Wood Partners, what are the top 3 opportunities you see for improving our social media and digital marketing?

2. What do you think we are currently missing?

3. If you were hired, what would your first 30 days look like?

4. How would you use
, Instagram, and LinkedIn differently for our business?

5. How would you help us turn our audience into a community and eventually into qualified leads or clients?

6. Please share 2–3 examples of companies or personal brands you have helped grow. Include actual results whenever possible.



Examples may include:

* Growth in qualified leads

* Increased engagement

* Revenue generated

* Audience/community growth

* Improved conversion rates

* Successful campaigns

* Client acquisition



Please explain what you personally did to achieve those results.



Who Will Stand Out

You will stand out if you come to us with ideas.



We want someone who can look at Kathleen Wood Partners and say:



“I studied your business. Here is what I see. Here is what I would change. Here is what I would test. And here is how I believe we can grow.”



We value strategic thinking, creativity, initiative, accountability, and measurable results.



If your experience is primarily posting graphics, writing captions, or scheduling social media without developing the underlying strategy, this position will probably not be the right fit.



We are looking for someone who understands marketing, business growth, positioning, community building, and client acquisition — not just social media management.



If this sounds like you, we’d love to review your application.

title: Scheduler Responsibilities at DB Cleaning
description:
The scheduler at DB Cleaning plays a crucial role in coordinating daily operations, ensuring cleaning services are performed efficiently and on time. This professional’s daily activities generally involve the following responsibilities:

1. Planning and Scheduling

• Schedule Creation: Develop and manage daily, weekly, and monthly schedules for cleaning staff, ensuring tasks are distributed evenly and efficiently.

• Task Assignment: Assign cleaning staff to various service locations based on their skills, availability, and geographic proximity.

2. Communication with Cleaners

• Daily Briefing: Conduct daily meetings or send communications to inform cleaning staff about their tasks, work locations, and any special instructions.

• Ongoing Support: Maintain constant communication with cleaning staff to resolve questions, provide support, and ensure tasks are performed as planned.

3. Client Interaction

• Customer Service: Respond to client inquiries, complaints, and service requests related to cleaning. This includes rescheduling, adjusting contracted services, and resolving issues.

• Service Confirmation: Confirm cleaning appointments with clients, ensuring they are aware of the schedule and service details.

4. Monitoring and Quality Control

• Operations Supervision: Monitor the progress of cleaning services, ensuring they are executed according to schedule and with the expected quality.

• Feedback and Evaluation: Collect client feedback on services rendered and periodically evaluate cleaning staff performance.

5. Emergency and Contingency Management

• Rescheduling: Adjust schedules in response to unforeseen circumstances, such as staff absences, last-minute emergencies, or client-requested changes.

• Quick Solutions: Develop fast and effective solutions for problems that may arise during service execution.

6. Administration and Reporting



• Documentation: Maintain accurate records of work schedules, completed services, and client feedback.

• Reporting: Create periodic reports on service efficiency, client satisfaction, and staff performance.

7. Use of Technology

• Scheduling Software: Utilize scheduling and ERP software to organize tasks, communicate with the team, and monitor service progress.

• Communication Tools: Employ tools such as
, instant messaging, and internal communication apps to stay in constant contact with staff and clients.

Required Skills

• Organization and Planning: Ability to create and manage detailed schedules.

• Effective Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills for interacting with clients and staff.

• Problem-Solving: Capacity to resolve issues quickly and efficiently.

• Flexibility: Adaptability to handle changes and unforeseen circumstances.

• Attention to Detail: Precision in documentation and quality control.

A Typical Day

• Start of the Day: Review and update the daily schedule, confirming all tasks and staff assignments.

• Morning: Communicate with cleaning staff about their tasks and work locations. Respond to client calls and
s.

• Afternoon: Monitor cleaning service progress, address any unforeseen issues, and adjust the schedule as needed.

• End of the Day: Gather feedback from clients and staff, review task completion, and prepare the next day’s schedule.

This professional is essential for ensuring cleaning operations run smoothly and efficiently, maintaining client satisfaction and staff motivation.

description:
About Rude Cosmetics

At Rude Cosmetics, we create bold, high-pigment, cruelty-free beauty products with an attitude! From vibrant graphic liners and anime-inspired palettes to viral lip oils and dewy blushes, we empower beauty lovers to express themselves without limits. We are expanding our outreach team to partner with content creators, beauty gurus, and micro-influencers across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.



About the Role

We are seeking an energetic, trend-savvy Influencer Outreach Coordinator who lives and breathes the cosmetics and beauty fashion world.



This is a live, active position during fixed US business hours. You will be required to be online in a continuous Google Meet session with live screen sharing enabled for your entire 5-hour shift (7:30 AM – 12:30 PM PST). This allows real-time coaching, direct collaboration with our LA team, and instant verification of pitch quality and prospective creator profiles.



Key Responsibilities

> Beauty Creator Sourcing: Identify micro/macro influencers, UGC creators, and makeup artists who fit the edgy, vibrant Rude Cosmetics brand identity.



> Trend Spotting: Track live beauty trends on TikTok and Instagram (e.g., graphic liner looks, lip combo trends, anime makeup, dewy blush aesthetics) to submit creators who match active trends.



> Direct Pitching & Outreach: Send high-volume, personalized
s and DMs to target creators using established Rude Cosmetics campaign templates.



> Proposal Gathering & Submission: Collect creator rates, media kits, and collaboration terms to submit to company management for final selection and approval.



> Live CRM Management: Track daily pitch status, creator responses, address collection, shipping details, and posting dates real-time in Google Sheets.



> Briefing & Delivery: Coordinate PR package deliveries, provide company-approved creative briefs, and follow up to ensure timely content posting.



Requirements & Qualifications

> Beauty & Trend Knowledge: Strong understanding of current cosmetics trends, viral social media beauty challenges, and beauty influencer culture.



> Workstation Setup: High-speed internet, reliable computer, and a setup capable of running continuous Google Meet video calls with screen sharing smoothly throughout the shift.



> Work Schedule: Must be available 7:30 AM – 12:30 PM PST (Los Angeles Time) consistently Monday through Friday.



> Communication: Flawless written English with a friendly, trendy, and persuasive communication style tailored for beauty creators.



> Experience: 1+ years in influencer outreach, virtual assistance, or PR in the beauty, fashion, or lifestyle sectors.



Perks

> Direct Collaboration: Work directly with an established Los Angeles cosmetics brand.



> Reliable Payout: $4.00 – $5.00 USD / hour paid bi-weekly via Wise.



> Growth: Potential for increased hours and leadership roles as our outreach program scales.







How to Apply

To apply, please answer these exact points in your message:



1. Beauty Trend Check: Name 2 current makeup trends or product categories that are viral on TikTok right now.



2. Current Desk & Makeup Check: Look at your desk right now—what is the exact local time in your city, what drink is sitting on your desk, and what are 3 items currently inside your personal makeup bag?



3. Casual DM Pitch: Write a 2-sentence Instagram DM inviting a creator to test Rude Cosmetics PR products. Write this in all lowercase letters, casually, without any bold text or formal quotation marks.



4. Shift Confirmation: Confirm your setup can handle a continuous 5-hour Google Meet call with live screen sharing during 7:30 AM – 12:30 PM PST.



5. Rate Acceptance: Confirm your agreement to the $4.00 – $5.00 USD/hour rate.



6. Link to your resume/portfolio.



Please write “Rude Beauty Specialist – [Your First Name]” at the top of your message.

Monday through Sunday (with Wednesday off)



The VA must be fully available and actively monitoring communications throughout the entire shift. Guest communications take priority over all administrative tasks at all times. The VA may not take on other clients whose hours conflict with this shift without prior written disclosure and approval from Genuine Resources LLC. 



You must be available during these exact hours. Please do not apply if you cannot commit to this schedule.



---



? REQUIREMENTS



• Excellent verbal, written English — clear, professional, and warm tone

• Minimum 1 year experience in short-term rental, hospitality, or property management

• Experience with Airbnb and/or VRBO platforms

• Strong interpersonal and problem solving skills

• Reliable internet connection and dedicated, quiet workspace

• Organized and strong attention to detail and ability to follow SOPs precisely

• Ability to make calm, sound judgment calls with upset guests

• Responsive and accountable — we will notice if messages are missed



---



? PREFERRED (NOT REQUIRED)



• Experience with Hospitable, Guesty, or similar channel manager

• Familiarity with PriceLabs or dynamic pricing tools

• Prior experience managing multiple properties simultaneously



---



COMPENSATION



• $850 – $950/month depending on experience

• Paid weekly via Wise or similar

• Performance review at 90 days with raise potential

• Long-term position — we do not hire for short-term projects



---



HOW TO APPLY



To be considered you MUST include all of the following in your application:



1. A brief description of your STR or hospitality experience

2. Which channel managers or property management tools you have used

3. Confirmation that you can work the PST schedule listed above

4. Your answer to this question: A guest messages at 4:30pm saying that they arrived at the property, however it wasn't clean. Walk me through exactly what you would do.



Applications that do not answer question #4 will not be reviewed. This helps us identify candidates who can think clearly under pressure.



We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Great With People? Come Build a Team With Us.
description:
Recruiting here is part people skills, part detective work, and part keeping a lot of moving pieces on track. You’ll help us find great people, guide candidates through the hiring process, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks. If you love talking to people, staying organized, and getting things done, this could be a great fit for you.



Title: Talent Acquisition Coordinator



Important: Make sure to read the full listing for application instructions.



ROLE OVERVIEW 



Recruitment & Talent Acquisition

- Manage end-to-end recruitment activities across multiple roles, from job posting and sourcing through to selection and onboarding.

- Source candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, databases, Boolean searches, and targeted outreach.

- Review applications, conduct initial screening interviews, and coordinate interviews with hiring managers.

- Manage candidate communication, assessments, reference/background checks, and recruitment follow-ups.

- Maintain accurate candidate pipelines, recruitment trackers, and hiring reports while supporting improvements to recruitment processes.



Onboarding & Employee Administration

- Coordinate new-hire onboarding and ensure all required documentation is collected and completed.

- Prepare onboarding materials, checklists, and relevant company information for new employees.

- Coordinate communication between new hires, management, and relevant internal stakeholders.

- Maintain accurate employee records and track outstanding onboarding requirements.

- Support new employees with administrative requirements and ensure a smooth transition into the business.



Process & Operational Support

- Develop and maintain recruitment templates, interview guides, assessments, checklists, and candidate communications.

- Assist with creating and documenting standard operating procedures and internal workflows.

- Identify opportunities to improve efficiency across recruitment and administrative processes.

- Track deadlines, priorities, outstanding actions, and recruitment activity to support effective operations.

- Work closely with leadership and internal stakeholders to ensure tasks and processes are completed accurately and on time.



Key Skills & Competencies

- Excellent organisation, time management, and attention to detail.

- Strong written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong proficiency with spreadsheets, Google Workspace/Microsoft Office, databases, and recruitment platforms.

- Professional handling of confidential information, with strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.



Qualifications & Experience

- Previous experience in recruitment, talent acquisition, human resources, administration, or a related role.

- Relevant qualification in Psychology, Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field is advantageous.

- Experience managing multiple vacancies or recruitment processes simultaneously.

- Experience with candidate sourcing platforms, recruitment databases, and applicant tracking systems.

- Strong computer literacy and confidence working with spreadsheets, digital systems, business software, and AI.

title: Client Intake & Client Success Specialist (Part-time)
description:
Client Intake & Client Success Specialist

Full-Time | Remote | 9AM-5PM EST



We are hiring a highly responsive and organized Client Intake & Client Success Specialist

to support a fast-growing Canadian law firm. You will be the first point of contact for prospective clients and will play a key role in making sure every inquiry is responded to quickly, properly assessed, documented, followed up on, and moved through the intake process. This role is ideal for someone who is confident on the phone, empathetic with clients, highly organized, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where follow-up and responsiveness matter.



What You'll Do

• Respond promptly and professionally to new client inquiries by phone,
, and

other channels

• Conduct intake calls and gather relevant information from prospective clients

• Screen and qualify inquiries based on established criteria and workflows

• Schedule consultations and coordinate next steps

• Follow up consistently with prospective clients so qualified opportunities do not go cold

• Prepare client agreements and intake documentation accurately

• Track outstanding documents and signatures through completion

• Maintain accurate notes and records in the lead/client management system

• Coordinate smooth handoffs to internal team members

• Provide a professional, compassionate, and positive client experience

• Support client satisfaction initiatives, including requesting and responding to online reviews

• Track follow-ups, response times, conversion activity, and other intake metrics



What We're Looking For

• 2+ years of experience in client intake, customer service, sales, customer success, lead management, or a similar client facing role

• Excellent spoken and written English

• Strong and confident phone communication skills

• Excellent active listening and interpersonal skills

• Highly organized with strong follow-through

• Comfortable managing a high volume of inquiries, tasks, and deadlines

• Strong attention to detail when preparing documentation and recording client information

• Comfortable using CRM, lead management, scheduling, and other online systems

• Able to follow structured workflows while using good judgment

• Comfortable working with KPIs, response-time expectations, and accountability metrics

• Able to work independently in a fast-moving remote environment



Strong Advantages

Experience in any of the following is a strong asset:

• Law firms or legal services

• Insurance or claims

• Healthcare or medical services

• Financial or professional services

• High-volume inbound sales or lead qualification

• Preparing agreements, contracts, retainers, or other client-facing documents



Experience with personal injury matters is an advantage but not required. Training on intake criteria, processes, and systems will be provided.



You'll Be a Great Fit If You Are

• Responsive — you do not let calls, messages, or follow-ups sit unanswered

• Empathetic — you can communicate professionally with people who may be

stressed or dealing with difficult circumstances

• Accountable — you take ownership of your leads, follow-ups, documentation, and results

• Detail-Oriented — you understand that accuracy matters

• Decisive — you can follow established criteria and make sound intake decisions

• Process-Driven — you enjoy systems, workflows, and keeping things organized

• Persistent — you are comfortable following up multiple times when needed

• Growth-Minded — you enjoy working in a fast-growing organization that continuously improves



This Role May Not Be Right for You If

• You are uncomfortable speaking with clients regularly by phone

• You frequently need reminders to complete follow-ups

• You struggle to manage multiple conversations and priorities at once

• You prefer a slow-paced environment with limited accountability

• You dislike working with KPIs or structured processes

• You are uncomfortable having respectful but direct conversations with prospective clients who may not qualify



How to Apply

Please submit:

1. Your updated resume

2. A short audio or video introduction explaining your experience with client intake, customer

service, sales, or lead management

3. Include your desired shift schedule



Schedule: We're looking for two part-time team members to cover the following shifts:



Weekday Shift: Monday–Friday, 5:00 PM–10:00 PM ET (25 hours)

Weekend Shift: Saturday–Sunday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM ET (16 hours)

title: Airbnb Virtual Assistant (~20 properties)
description:
We are looking for a reliable, experienced Virtual Assistant to handle guest communications and operations coordination as a core member of our growing team. Our company current manage 20~ properties across the US. And we use Hospitable as PMS. 





SCOPE OF WORK 



1 Guest Communications

• Respond to all guest messages via Hospitable (channel manager) within 15 minutes during shift hours 

• Handle pre-arrival questions, check-in support, and mid-stay issues 

• Respond to guest reviews professionally and promptly 

• Escalate urgent issues to the operations manager per established protocol 

• Maintain a professional, warm, and clear tone in all guest communications 

• Submit reimbursement request for damage 



2 Operations Coordination 

• Schedule cleaning

• Coordinate with cleaners and maintenance vendors when issues arise 

• Log and track cleaning performance

• Log and track maintenance requests and follow through to resolution 

• Review cleaning pictures and flag any turnover conflicts promptly 

• Monitor supply levels and submit orders when running low on essentials, 



3 Administrative Support 

• Create SOPs and streamline business operation

• Maintain and update property performance tracking spreadsheets 

• Reconcile monthly Airbnb and VRBO payouts against expected amounts 

• Assist with building and updating standard operating procedures and house manuals 

• Compile weekly and monthly performance summaries per property 

• Maintain vendor contact database and lease tracking documents 

• Support general business administrative tasks as assigned

---



HOURS & SCHEDULE



This is a 10-hour availability shift (9:30am–7:30pm PST), on-call after hours for urgent issues

Monday through Sunday (with Wednesday off)



The VA must be fully available and actively monitoring communications throughout the entire shift. Guest communications take priority over all administrative tasks at all times. The VA may not take on other clients whose hours conflict with this shift without prior written disclosure and approval from Genuine Resources LLC. 



You must be available during these exact hours. Please do not apply if you cannot commit to this schedule.



---



? REQUIREMENTS



• Excellent verbal, written English — clear, professional, and warm tone

• Minimum 1 year experience in short-term rental, hospitality, or property management

• Experience with Airbnb and/or VRBO platforms

• Strong interpersonal and problem solving skills

• Reliable internet connection and dedicated, quiet workspace

• Organized and strong attention to detail and ability to follow SOPs precisely

• Ability to make calm, sound judgment calls with upset guests

• Responsive and accountable — we will notice if messages are missed



---



? PREFERRED (NOT REQUIRED)



• Experience with Hospitable, Guesty, or similar channel manager

• Familiarity with PriceLabs or dynamic pricing tools

• Prior experience managing multiple properties simultaneously



---



COMPENSATION



• $850 – $950/month depending on experience

• Paid weekly via Wise or similar

• Performance review at 90 days with raise potential

• Long-term position — we do not hire for short-term projects



---



HOW TO APPLY



To be considered you MUST include all of the following in your application:



1. A brief description of your STR or hospitality experience

2. Which channel managers or property management tools you have used

3. Confirmation that you can work the PST schedule listed above

4. Your answer to this question: A guest messages at 4:30pm saying that they arrived at the property, however it wasn't clean. Walk me through exactly what you would do.



Applications that do not answer question #4 will not be reviewed. This helps us identify candidates who can think clearly under pressure.



We look forward to hearing from you.

title: COLD CALLER / APPOINTMENT SETTER – US Home-Service Contractors
description:
COLD CALLER / APPOINTMENT SETTER – US Home-Service Contractors | 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM US Central Time | Paid Probation → Full-Time



We're hiring confident cold callers to join our outbound team calling U.S. contractors (roofing, plumbing, HVAC, and other home-service businesses). Your job is to speak with business owners and book qualified appointments for our sales team. You don't need to close deals, just get the meeting.



SCHEDULE

8:00 AM – 4:00 PM US Central Time, Monday to Friday

(That's 9:00 PM – 5:00 AM Philippine time. From November, when US daylight saving ends, it becomes 10:00 PM – 6:00 AM PH time.)



PAY & PROBATIONARY PERIOD

Selected applicants will start with a paid probationary period at $20 per day, paid daily. You'll be working on our real dialer, real leads, and real script from day one.



If your performance is strong during the probationary period, we will offer you a full-time position with our team.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Make high-volume outbound calls using our dialer and lead lists (no manual dialing)

- Speak with contractor business owners and decision-makers

- Handle basic objections and book qualified appointments

- Log every call accurately at the end of each shift

- Follow our script while keeping the conversation natural



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Priority goes to applicants who have sold leads, marketing, or services to contractors, e.g. HomeAdvisor/Angi, HomeStars, Thumbtack, Yelp, Yellow Pages, Jobber, ServiceTitan, lead-gen companies, or agencies serving home-service businesses.



Strong cold callers from other industries are welcome to apply too.



REQUIREMENTS

- Clear, natural spoken English

- Cold calling / appointment setting experience

- Comfortable making a large number of calls per shift

- Reliable internet, a quiet workspace, and a good headset

- Available for the full shift, Monday to Friday



HOW TO APPLY (IMPORTANT)

Applications that don't follow these steps will not be reviewed.



1. Record a voice recording at 
 answering this scenario:



   You're cold-calling a roofing contractor named Mike. He picks up and says:

   "Hey, I'm in the middle of something. What is this about?"

  

 Respond naturally, handle his objection, and try to get him to agree to a short meeting.



   Please don't read a script word-for-word. We want to hear how you actually sound on a call.



2. Click "Save & Share" on Vocaroo and copy the link.



3. Fill out our application form here: 





We know applying takes a bit of effort, and we truly appreciate the time you put into your recording. Every application is reviewed personally, and we listen to every voice recording. If you're someone who enjoys conversations, stays positive through a busy calling day, and wants to grow with a team that rewards hard work, we'd love to hear from you. We look forward to meeting you!

joy and information to our audience.

What We Need From You

software, or other professional editing software. This means paid, professional work, not self taught or

personal editing. CapCut and Canva do not count as professional editing tools.

● Real availability overlapping 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM Chicago time, plus attendance at our Tuesday team

REQUIRED with your Cover Letter: Share a link to a 60 to 90 second simple video where you talk about your favorite ice cream and what you love about being a video editor.



Pay and Growth

based.

● A paid test project ($15 flat fee) with a 24 hour turnaround, guided by several quality checkpoints

along the way.

Our Hiring Process

● Our first round interview includes a live editing component so we can confirm your advanced skills

together, in real time.

the real deal.



Everyone at Ice Cream Sunshine wishes you joy always and delicious ice cream too. 🍦

title: Applied AI Engineer – 3D Automation & Rendering
description:
JOB TITLE

Applied AI Engineer – 3D Automation & Rendering (Mac Required)



ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a talented AI Engineer who is passionate about artificial intelligence, automation, and emerging technologies.



Our goal is to use AI to dramatically simplify and automate the process of creating 3D models and realistic renderings from architectural floorplans and CAD files.



We work in the manufactured housing industry and have thousands of home designs that need to be converted into accurate 3D models with customizable materials, finishes, and options.



Today, much of this work is done manually. We want to change that.



IMPORTANT: We are NOT looking for a traditional CAD designer, 3D artist, or rendering specialist. We want a strong technical developer who can use AI, programming, and automation to eliminate as much manual work as possible.



This is an opportunity for someone who wants to become an expert in AI-powered 3D modeling and rendering while helping build something innovative.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Research and experiment with the latest AI tools for 3D modeling and rendering.

- Build automated systems that convert architectural plans and CAD files into accurate 3D models.

- Develop Python scripts, APIs, and automated workflows.

- Integrate AI models, computer vision, and open-source technologies.

- Use AI and procedural modeling to automate 3D geometry creation.

- Automate materials, textures, colors, and finishes.

- Develop systems for automatically generating realistic interior and exterior renderings.

- Automate configurable home options such as flooring, cabinets, countertops, appliances, siding, roofing, doors, and windows.

- Create automated processes for generating organized layers and assets for our interactive Product Builder.

- Build quality-control systems to identify errors and maintain consistency.

- Continuously test new technologies to make the entire process faster, easier, and more scalable.



REQUIRED SKILLS

- Strong Python programming and software development skills.

- Hands-on experience using AI models, AI APIs, and automation tools.

- Experience with generative AI, computer vision, or multimodal AI.

- Experience building automated workflows and connecting different software systems.

- Ability to research, evaluate, and implement new AI technologies.

- Experience using AI-assisted coding tools.

- Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.

- Ability to work independently and build solutions from scratch.

- Comfortable using Git, Terminal, and developer tools on macOS.



MAC REQUIREMENT

- Must own and use a Mac as your primary development computer.

- Must be comfortable working in a macOS development environment.

- Must be able to install, configure, and troubleshoot Python, AI development tools, Blender, and related software.

- Applicants using only Windows or Linux computers will not be considered.



BONUS SKILLS (NOT REQUIRED)

- Blender Python API

- AI-powered 3D generation

- Procedural modeling

- CAD, AutoCAD, Revit, or BIM

- 3D rendering automation

- GPU computing

- Image-to-3D or floorplan-to-3D technologies

- AI model integration and deployment



You do NOT need to be a professional 3D artist or CAD designer. We care much more about your programming abilities, AI knowledge, and ability to automate complicated processes.



WHAT WE ARE TRYING TO BUILD

Our current workflow:



CAD / Plans → 3D Home → Materials & Options → Renderings & Layered Assets → Product Builder



Our goal is to automate as much of this workflow as technically possible.



Ideally, we want to take an architectural floorplan or CAD file and automatically:

1. Interpret the architectural drawings.

2. Generate accurate 3D home geometry.

3. Apply materials, colors, and finishes.

4. Create configurable interior and exterior options.

5. Produce consistent, realistic renderings.

6. Generate organized layers and production-ready assets.

7. Export everything needed for our interactive Product Builder.



We understand that AI cannot perfectly automate every step today.



Your job is to research what's possible, experiment with different technologies, build prototypes, and create a production system that continually reduces the amount of manual work required. We are open to completely new approaches if they produce better results.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We want someone who loves technology and figuring things out.



Someone who:

- Is genuinely excited about AI and follows emerging technologies.

- Enjoys experimenting with new tools and approaches.

- Has strong programming and technical problem-solving skills.

- Thinks about how to automate a task instead of doing it manually.

- Can take a challenging problem and independently research possible solutions.

- Is comfortable building prototypes, testing ideas, and learning from failures.

- Wants to become an expert in AI-powered 3D modeling and rendering.

- Is interested in building technology that could eventually scale across thousands of homes.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- We are not measuring success by how many 3D models you personally create.

- We are measuring success by how much of the modeling and rendering process you can automate.

- We want to build a repeatable system that makes each new home faster and easier to produce than the last.

- Our long-term goal is to create a highly automated production pipeline capable of generating thousands of accurate, configurable 3D homes with minimal manual involvement.



HOW TO APPLY

Please answer the following questions when applying:



1. What AI-powered tools, applications, or automation systems have you personally built? Please provide examples or links.



2. What experience do you have with Python, AI models, APIs, and AI-assisted coding tools?



3. If we gave you 1,000 architectural floorplans and asked you to automate the creation of accurate 3D homes and realistic renderings, how would you approach the problem?



4. What AI tools or technologies would you investigate first for automating 3D modeling and rendering?



5. What Mac do you currently use? Please include the model, chip (M1/M2/M3/M4/M5 or Intel), and RAM.



- We are not looking for someone to manually create 3D models.

- We are looking for someone who can use AI and technology to make the entire process dramatically easier.

- If you're a talented developer who loves AI, automation, and solving challenging technical problems, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Customer Service & Operations Manager – E-commerce Fashion (Long-term)
description:
We run several Shopify fashion stores, scaled with Google Ads. Volume is getting high, and so is the number of escalations and supplier issues. We need an experienced manager to own our entire backend: customer service escalations, the CS team and supplier follow-up.



You will lead our customer service team and work hand in hand with the founders. This is a leadership role. You have run a support or operations team at another e-commerce company before and don't need to be taught the basics. If you have only worked as an agent, this role is not for you.



This is a long-term position, not a project.



What you will own



1. Escalations – the core of this job



Every ticket our agents escalate comes to you: angry customers, refund demands, "refund me or I'm calling my bank."

You close those cases before they become disputes: resolve, replace, refund or de-escalate.

You d
 quickly when to give in and when to hold firm.

You set the rules for what agents handle themselves and what gets escalated.



2. Leading the CS team:



You lead our customer service team.

You coach them so fewer tickets reach you in the first place.

You write the SOPs and macros so the team works the same way every time.

As we add stores, you grow and shape the team.



3. Orders and suppliers:



You handle late shipments, wrong sizes, lost parcels and tracking that stopped updating.

You chase our supplier on defects, delays and reshipments.

You spot problems before customers do.

You work closely with the founders and are their main point of contact for everything customer service and backend.

You flag recurring issues with products, suppliers or ads that cause complaints, so we can fix them at the source.

You help d
 refund policies, return rules and how we handle customers.



5. Disputes:



You help keep our dispute and chargeback ratio low, mainly by solving problems before customers go to their bank or PayPal.

Experience with submitting disputes in Shopify Payments or PayPal is a plus, but not required.



6. Reporting:



Monthly report per store: escalations handled, refund rate, response times and dispute ratio.

Plus your analysis: what is causing the problems and what we should fix.



How we work:



All communication with the founders and the team runs through Slack.

Reporting, order tracking and supplier follow-up are done in Google Sheets and Excel.



Requirements – please don't apply if you can't tick these:



You have worked as an Operations Manager, Backend Manager, Support Manager or Team Lead at an e-commerce company. Not as an agent. We will ask for the company name, team size and a reference from your manager.

You have managed a team and been responsible for their output, not just your own.

Proven experience with escalated customers: you know how to calm people down and keep them from filing a chargeback.

Experience with high-volume stores running paid ads.

Experience working directly with suppliers.

Hands-on experience with Gorgias, Zendesk or Re:amaze.

Comfortable working in Slack, Google Sheets and Excel.

Excellent written English. You will be writing to angry customers every day.

Flexible availability, including for urgent escalations.



Nice to have:



Experience handling chargebacks and disputes in Shopify Payments or PayPal.

Experience in fashion e-commerce.



What we offer:



A long-term, stable position with room to grow as we add stores.

You lead the CS team and work directly with the founders.

Full ownership: you d
 how this function is run.



How to apply:



Start your application with the word BACKEND. Applications without it will not be reviewed.



Briefly tell us:



Your most recent management role and team size.

Which helpdesk tools you have used.

title: L2 Tech Support Engineer
description:
Dear Technology Lover!

We're a small (but VERY efficient) 20-year-old MSP based in Arizona.

As a small company. we're VERY employee-focused, and believe that our team members are our MOST IMPORTANT ASSET!



Here are some of the things you can expect from working with us:

• Ongoing (monthly) manager review and feedback- you should never guess where you are "standing" and what you, AND THE COMPANY, can do better!

• Paid certifications- we will pay for your courses and tests and allocate time during business hours to help you achieve your desired goals

• Paid Time Off- it's important to us that you are happy, healthy, and have a work-life balance!

• Bonuses- when the company wins, you win!

• Raises- As we grow, we believe you should as well. We have to stay competitive as an employer to retain our awesome employees!

• Opportunities to grow- In our industry, we can't be on "cruise control"... We need to push our team members to stay ahead of the technology curve. Help you continually sharpen your skills with a focus on your career aspirations.

• Paid sick days- We understand life happens. We don't want you to feel that you have to drag yourself to work sick if your body tells you to relax...



You're the right fit if you:

• LOVE learning, working with, and experimenting with new technology

• Get excited when you save someone's day and provide great service

• Are a hard-working, fun person, and see yourself being in the IT industry for the foreseeable future

• Want to work in a GROWING environment, with STABLE income, Bonuses, and a great attitude!

• Want the opportunity to advance and learn more!



Some of the responsibilities that your position will include are:

Helpdesk (mostly escalations, but some basic if needed), cyber security related tasks/ audits, cloud hosting and virtualization (HyperV, SonicWall, VPN), MS365 management and automation, BCDR (Axcient), networking (UniFi, SonicWall), IT projects, Servers maintenance (Windows only), scripts creation, testing new technology, and other tasks related to IT.



IMPORTANT:

This position requires AT LEAST 3 years of MSP experience and at least 2 years of experience in an L2 position, supervisory, or lead role. 100% clean background check, highly organized, technologically savvy, and can work diligently with little supervision. Several hiring steps will take place to verify the above requirements, including reference checking, employment verification, technical testing, and more.



Minimum technical level that you will need to be able to pass a test on:

• Explaining to a non-technical person what the "cloud" is

• Consulting with a new client on what BCDR solution you would recommend to an SMB, and why

• Explaining what the differences are between traditional anti-virus and XDR

• Creating a new Virtual Machine on a Hyper-V host, from an ISO file located on a different computer on the network.

• Explaining the differences and commonalities between SharePoint and OneDrive.

• Creating an Intune policy that will install Firefox on an Azure-joined VM, and make Firefox the default browser, with the specific home page we'll provide to you during the test.

• Several other situational and technical questions.

• CCNA certificate candidates preferred but not required.



MORE DETAILS:

• A PRE-EMPLOYMENT BACKGROUND CHECK is performed (at our expense). You must have 100% clean background check. Please do not apply if you don't have 100% clean background check.

• Personality is KEY for us. We are looking for an easy-going, yet professional, friendly, and HONEST person.

• You will be working from home. This means you must have a quiet work environment and no excessive background noise.

• FAST AND RELIABLE INTERNET SERVICE IS REQUIRED with at least 100Mbps download speed and 20+ Mbps upload speed.

• As part of this position requirement, you must have a computer that will be used exclusively for your work with us. This means we will be installing our security software on that computer, will remove admin rights from you, and monitor/ control it for security and compliance reasons. In return, we will pay you additional “rent” fees, on top of your salary, in the amount of several hundred dollars. Details about this “rental” will be discussed during your second interview. There are minimum requirements that your computer must have in order to be employed with us. You must have a Computer/Laptop with at least i5 minimum 9th gen processor (preferably a newer one) with 16 GB RAM or more, or Ryzen 5/7 (MUST include TPM support) as well as Windows 11 OS.

• You must have recently worked on a night shift for 2 consecutive years or more.

• We evaluate/ review employees monthly and provide consistent feedback.

• We offer raises and bonuses according to performance, certifications, attitude, and customer reviews twice/ year.

• Your manager (our IT director) will create a roadmap for your "KPIs" and certifications track. We always push our team to earn certifications and additional knowledge – even allowing “disconnect study time” during business hours!

• On-call rotation (after-hours) for a week at a time, once every 4-5 weeks. It's VERY rare that we get calls after-hours (the average is only twice/ year!).

title: Executive Operations Assistant
description:
About Us



The Tauro Group is a US-based business marketing and strategy firm. We provide marketing strategy, website and logo creation, social media management, and more for small, founder-led businesses. We are a small team, and we are growing.



We are looking to add an experienced Executive Operations Assistant who can help take us to the next level, this individual needs to be extremely efficient, have good social medial marketing skills, hard-working, and have good communication.



About This Role



You will support our executive team with administrative operations, including lead generation, managing
, and managing accounts. You will also serve as a client account manager and create high-quality, high-converting social media content. You will work directly with the founder and have room to grow into a full-time role.



We want someone who is reliable, flags problems early, communicates fast, and does not need to be chased. If you go quiet when you are behind, this is not the right fit.



What You’ll Do



Executive Team Support and Administrative Operations



-Manage the company inbox and shared mailboxes. Client
s get a reply the same business day

-Conduct lead generation: research potential clients and partners and prepare outreach for review

-Manage business accounts and logins securely

-Coordinate calendars, meetings, and scheduling

-Keep our project management system current daily and log your hours in our time management system

-Prepare documents, spreadsheets, and client-ready materials

-Send a mid week and end-of-week report and daily check-in is ideal



Client Account Management



-Be the day-to-day contact for assigned clients by
 and video call

-Turn client requests into clear briefs for our graphic designer, web developer, and other team members

-Track every deadline, follow up on open items, and tell clients early if something is at risk

-Prepare monthly performance reports for client social media accounts

-Escalate pricing, refunds, scope changes, complaints, and legal issues to the founder



Social Media and Content Creation



-Create content that gets views, engagement, and conversions, not just content that fills a calendar

-Produce high-quality, UGC-style content, short-form video, reels, carousels, and graphics

-Produce AI video as one part of the mix, using tools like Google Flow, Kling, and HeyGen, along with Canva, ElevenLabs, ChatGPT, and Claude

-Write scripts, hooks, and captions, and turn one idea into several formats

-Build content calendars, schedule approved posts, and report on what is working

-Work quickly. Good content creation within a reasonable amount of time - not hours on end

-What We’re Looking For



Required



-A portfolio with both high-quality UGC-style or short-form content and AI-generated video you created, with results (views, engagement, sales) where you have them. Applications with only AI videos or only generic graphics will not be considered

-2+ years in executive or operations support, account management, social media, or content creation

-Excellent written English and a confident speaking voice on video calls with US clients

-Fast, consistent communication, and a proven record of meeting deadlines and speaking up early when one is at risk

-Familiarity with project management tools (Trello or similar), Google Workspace, and business
 platforms

-Strong attention to detail, comfort with spreadsheets, and discretion with confidential information



Nice to have



-Experience supporting professional service businesses, such as consultants, agencies, or private practices

-Marketing experience, especially running paid ads on Meta 
 and Instagram) and reading campaign results

-Understanding of audience targeting, offers, and what makes a post or ad convert

-Experience with content scheduling tools and social media analytics



Your Work Setup

-A reliable smartphone with WhatsApp, with notifications on during working hours. Our team communicates on WhatsApp, and messages are answered within 2 hours

-Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet workspace, and a backup internet or power plan

-A secure computer. You will use a VPN, follow our data security practices, and sign a confidentiality agreement before accessing client information

-Some overlap with US Eastern time on most days (hours discussed at interview)



Details



-Hours: 15 hours per week to start, developing into full-time for the right person

-Pay: $5/hour

-Start: Paid two-week trial, then a review

How to Apply

title: Healthcare Provider Outreach & Business Development Virtual Assistant
description:
Healthcare Provider Outreach & Business Development Virtual Assistant

Specialty Pharmacy / IVIG / Home Infusion



We are seeking a highly organized, confident, and results-driven Healthcare Provider Outreach & Business Development Virtual Assistant to help grow an established specialty pharmacy. 



We are looking for someone who can help build and manage a complete provider-acquisition system—from researching potential referral partners and identifying decision-makers to conducting outreach, following up consistently, scheduling meetings, and tracking opportunities through our sales pipeline.



The goal of this position is to help increase the number of active physician practices, hospitals, discharge planners, case managers, and healthcare organizations that work with our pharmacy.



What You Will Be Responsible For:



*Provider & Hospital Lead Generation

*Research and build targeted prospect lists. 

*You will identify the correct contacts within each organization. 



Outbound Provider Outreach:



You must be comfortable making professional outbound calls to medical offices.

Your objective will NOT simply be to ask:

“Can you send us patients?”



Instead, you will learn how to introduce our pharmacy professionally, understand the practice’s needs, identify who manages specialty pharmacy or infusion referrals, and begin building the relationship.



Outreach may include:

*Cold calling medical offices


 outreach & follow up

*Scheduling meetings for our pharmacist, owner, or business-development representative



CRM & Sales Pipeline Management

You will maintain an organized CRM containing:



Provider Marketing



You will also assist with creating and managing provider marketing campaigns, including:

*Educational
 campaigns

* Provider newsletters

* Webinar invitations

* Referral-resource distribution

* Provider follow-up sequences

* Existing-provider reactivation campaigns



Insurance & Network Research:



You will organize opportunities for pharmacy leadership to review and pursue.



Healthcare Compliance:



Because this is healthcare marketing, compliance is extremely important.



You must understand that healthcare referral marketing is different from ordinary sales.



Our strategy is based on providing exceptional service, education, responsiveness, administrative support, and patient care. 

You will be expected to follow approved scripts, marketing materials, and company policies.



What Success Looks Like:



We are not looking for someone who simply says:

“I made 100 calls today.”

We care about RESULTS.



Your performance will be measured using metrics including:



* Qualified medical practices identified

* Decision-makers reached

* Referral coordinators identified

* Provider information packets sent

* Follow-ups completed

* Qualified opportunities created

* Meetings scheduled

* New referral sources

* First referrals received

* Active referring accounts

* Reactivated accounts

* Repeat referral sources



Our ultimate goal is:



More qualified healthcare organizations consistently referring appropriate patients to our pharmacy.



Ideal Candidate:



We would strongly prefer someone with experience in one or more of the following:



* Healthcare virtual assistance

* Medical sales

* B2B lead generation

* Specialty pharmacy

* Home infusion

* Medical billing

* Insurance verification

* Prior authorization

* Physician-office outreach

* Healthcare business development

* Pharmaceutical sales support

* Medical-office administration

* Hospital outreach



Experience specifically with IVIG, specialty pharmacy, infusion therapy, biologics, physician referrals, prior authorizations, or healthcare insurance is a major advantage.



You Should Be:

* Extremely organized

* Confident on the phone

* Persistent without being aggressive

* Comfortable speaking with gatekeepers

* Excellent at follow-up

* Detail-oriented

* Comfortable maintaining a CRM

* Results-driven

* Comfortable working with KPIs

* Able to communicate professionally in English

* Able to follow healthcare compliance guidelines

* Able to manage hundreds of prospects without losing track of follow-ups



Technology:



You should be comfortable learning new software quickly.



Important: This Is a Sales & Growth Position



If you are looking primarily for data entry, graphic design, social media posting, or general administrative work, this position is not the right fit.



You should genuinely enjoy:



Researching → Calling → Connecting → Following Up → Building Relationships → Scheduling Meetings → Tracking Results → Growing Accounts



You must be comfortable hearing “no,” getting past gatekeepers, following up multiple times, and continuing to build the relationship professionally.



How to Apply

1. Please submit:

2. Your resume.

3. A brief explanation of any healthcare, pharmacy, medical-office, lead-generation, or B2B sales experience.

4. Tell us whether you have experience making outbound sales calls.

5. Requested pay rate 

6. Describe how you would handle this situation:

You call a neurology office and the receptionist says, “We already have a specialty pharmacy that we use.” What would you say next?

7. Submit a short voice recording introducing yourself as though you were calling a physician’s office on behalf of our pharmacy.

title: Digital Marketing & Growth Manager
description:
Digital Marketing & Growth Manager

Google Ads + Social Media Growth Strategy

Remote | Full-Time



Majesty Day Spa is seeking a highly capable Digital Marketing & Growth Manager who can take ownership of our digital growth strategy, with a strong focus on Google Ads, conversion tracking, marketing attribution, and Instagram growth.



This is not an entry-level social media position.



We are looking for someone who understands both the analytical side of marketing and the creative side of growth. You should be comfortable reviewing data, optimizing advertising campaigns, improving conversion tracking, analyzing customer acquisition, and developing strategies that help an established luxury spa brand grow its social media presence and generate more revenue.



You will work closely with our Spa Director, management team, Social Media manager, Automation Specialist/Full-Stack Developer.



Primary Objectives

Your main objectives will be to:

Build and strengthen the tracking infrastructure needed to accurately measure Google Ads performance.

Improve Google Ads performance and marketing ROI.

Develop and lead an effective Instagram growth strategy.

Improve our ability to determine where leads, phone calls, bookings, and purchases originate.

Turn marketing data into actionable recommendations.

Increase qualified leads, bookings, average customer value, and revenue generated from marketing.

Provide strategic direction to the team executing social media content.



Google Ads & Tracking Responsibilities

You will be expected to understand how to design and implement a proper Google Ads tracking and attribution system.

You should be comfortable working with:

Google Ads

Google Analytics 4

Google Tag Manager

Conversion tracking

UTM parameters

Website conversion events

Call tracking

Form tracking

Landing-page tracking

Lead attribution

Revenue attribution

Cost per lead

Cost per acquisition

ROAS

Campaign reporting

Keyword research

Negative keywords

Search campaigns

Performance analysis

Conversion optimization

You will work directly with our Automation Specialist and Full-Stack Developer, who can assist with APIs, custom integrations, automations, webhooks, dashboards, database connections, and more advanced technical implementation.

Google Ads Management

Landing-page recommendations

Conversion-rate optimization

Budget recommendations

Performance reporting

Lead-quality analysis

Identifying wasted ad spend

Tracking revenue generated from advertising

Content strategy

Reel strategy

Content pillars

Viral-content research

Hook development

Competitor analysis

Trend research

Engagement strategy

Collaboration strategy

Local audience growth

Influencer opportunities

Reviewing content performance

Identifying high-performing and low-performing content

Recommending improvements

Developing testing strategies

Helping the content team understand what should be created and why



You should be comfortable reviewing Instagram Insights and using performance data to make strategic recommendations.



We are especially interested in someone who understands how to grow a local service-based business, not simply an entertainment or influencer account.



Management & Strategy

This is a manager-level role.



You should be able to take ownership of projects instead of waiting for step-by-step 



instructions.

You will be expected to:

Create marketing plans

Manage deadlines

Coordinate with team members

Delegate marketing projects

Review performance

Identify problems

Recommend solutions

Excellent written English

Strong communication skills

We are looking for someone who understands customer acquisition, attribution, conversion, growth, and revenue.



Compensation

Mention requested hourly rate

Compensation may increase based on performance, responsibility, and demonstrated results through commission eligibility after consistent performance.

title: GoHighLevel Builder and Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
ABOUT INTERCEPTLY



Interceptly helps B2B companies find and start conversations with buyers who are already showing intent. We run signal-driven outbound campaigns for our clients and our partners’ clients, and we build our own intent products, including LeadIntercept, which tracks competitor engagement at the individual level.



We are a small team that runs on AI. Most of our processes live as Claude Code skills in a shared Git repo, and GoHighLevel is the center of our marketing and client operations. You will be the person who builds in it and makes it look good.



THE ROLE



This is a hands-on role split across 3 areas:



Building in GoHighLevel. You own our GHL builds: funnels, landing pages, websites, forms, automations, and reporting.

SEO. You keep our sites fast, indexed, and ranking, and you make sure every page you build is set up properly for search.

Social media and creative. You run our company social channels and create the graphics and images that go with them.



We care a lot about design. We want pages and graphics that look sharp and modern, not like a template someone forgot to finish.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



GoHighLevel builds and automation



Design and build landing pages, funnels, and full websites in GHL, from wireframe to launch

Build and maintain automation workflows: lead capture, nurture sequences, onboarding flows, follow-ups, reminders, and internal notifications

Build forms, surveys, calendars, and pipelines, and connect them so leads go to the right place

Create dashboards and reports that show leads, conversions, pipeline, and campaign performance at a glance

Set up tracking, UTM handling, and integrations so the numbers in our reports can be trusted

Keep our GHL workspaces tidy: custom fields, tags, templates, and naming conventions



SEO



Make sure every page and site you build is set up for search: meta titles and descriptions, headings, image alt text, internal links, schema, and page speed

Run regular site audits with Ahrefs or Semrush and fix what they find: broken links, redirects, canonicals, orphan pages, and missing OG images

Monitor Google Search Console for indexing and performance issues and work through the fix list

Do keyword research for new pages and content, and track rankings over time

Recommend and carry out on-page improvements to the pages that matter most to us



Social media and creative



Plan, write, and schedule posts for our company social channels on a consistent calendar

Design graphics, carousels, banners, and images for social posts, landing pages, and ads

Repurpose blog posts, case studies, and product updates into social content

Track engagement and report on what is working each month

Keep everything on brand: colors, fonts, tone of voice, and product naming



Claude Code and AI



Use Claude Code and other AI tools daily to draft copy, speed up builds, and run our internal skills

Spot manual, repeated work and turn it into an automation or a skill



A TYPICAL WEEK



Every day: share your priorities in the morning and an end-of-day update with the team. Work through GHL build and automation tasks, and publish or schedule social content.

Weekly: at least 3 to 5 social posts with original graphics, plus progress on any open page, funnel, or website builds.

Monthly: performance reports for GHL funnels, SEO, and social.

Every 2 to 4 weeks: site audit and fixes.

As needed: new landing pages for campaigns, launches, and partners.



WHAT YOU WILL NEED



Must have



2+ years of hands-on GoHighLevel experience building funnels, landing pages, websites, and workflows

A portfolio with live links to landing pages, funnels, or websites you built. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

A strong eye for design. Your pages should look clean, modern, and professional on desktop and mobile

Experience building GHL reports and dashboards

Working knowledge of on-page and technical SEO, plus experience with Ahrefs, Semrush, or Google Search Console. You know what a canonical, a 301, and an orphan page are, and how to fix them

Experience managing company social media accounts and planning content calendars

Excellent written English. You will write copy that goes out under our name

Regular use of Claude or another AI assistant for real work, not just casual prompts



Nice to have



Graphic design skills in Canva, Figma, or Adobe tools, with samples of social graphics you created

WordPress and Elementor experience

Experience with B2B or SaaS marketing

Basic HTML and CSS for custom page tweaks

Experience with Zapier, Make, webhooks, or APIs

Experience with Claude Code, GitHub, or working from the command line



HOW TO APPLY



Send us:



Links to 3 or more landing pages, funnels, or websites you built (GHL builds preferred)

3 to 5 examples of graphics or social posts you designed

A short note on one automation or report you built in GHL and what it did for the business



Start your application with the word “Funnel” so we know you read this far.



HOW WE WORK



We document everything. If you do something twice, it should end up in our knowledge base or a skill.

We are async-first, but we expect daily overlap with UK hours for the team meeting and client work.

You will get a structured handover, plus access to our SOPs, brand guidelines, and skills repo.

title: Social Media Video Editor – Daily Lifestyle Vlogs & Reels
description:
I’m a full-time lifestyle content creator looking for a reliable video editor to help edit my daily vlogs and short-form social media content for Instagram Reels and other platforms.



My content is casual, personality-driven, day-in-the-life style content. I’m looking for someone who understands how to make everyday footage entertaining without making it feel overly produced.



Most videos will be created from raw clips I film throughout my day. I’ll upload the footage, and you’ll turn it into a finished short-form video that feels natural, fast-paced, and engaging.



What I’m looking for:



• Experience editing Instagram Reels, TikToks, daily vlogs, or similar creator content

• Strong sense of pacing and knowing which moments to keep or cut

• Clean cuts and transitions — nothing overly flashy or cheesy

• Ability to add text/captions when needed

• Good music selection and timing

• Ability to understand humor and leave in funny, candid, or imperfect moments that make the video feel real

• Comfortable following an established editing style rather than completely changing the feel of my content

• Reliable communication and quick turnaround

• Comfortable working with a large amount of raw footage

• Fluent enough in English to understand conversations, jokes, and context within the footage



I post consistently, so this has the potential to become an ongoing position with regular work. Ideally, I’d like to upload footage at the end of my day and have an edited draft ready for me to review the following morning.



I’m looking for someone who can learn my editing preferences over time so that very few revisions are eventually needed.



To apply, please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Links to 3–5 examples of short-form videos you have edited

3. Your typical turnaround time

4. Your hourly rate OR preferred rate per video

5. What editing software you use

6. Your availability each week

Please include the word “VLOG” at the beginning of your application so I know you read the full description.

description:
**Dental Concepts & Orthodontics | U.S. Dental Practice**



**Location:** Remote; candidates based in South America, Central America, Mexico or the Caribbean encouraged to apply  

**Schedule:** Must be available during our agreed U.S. Central Time business hours  

**Compensation:** Based on experience; please include your expected rate



Dental Concepts & Orthodontics, a boutique dental practice in Irving, Texas, is seeking an experienced virtual dental accounts receivable specialist with excellent spoken English.



**Your primary responsibility will be to reduce outstanding patient and insurance accounts receivable through consistent follow-up, accurate account review and successful collections.**



We are looking for someone who is comfortable discussing balances with patients, explaining billing clearly and following through until an account or claim is resolved.



**Responsibilities**



- Call patients about outstanding balances and collect payments through our approved payment process.

- Explain account balances and patient responsibility professionally, clearly and respectfully.

- Arrange payment plans within office guidelines and follow up on promised payments.

- Review patient and insurance aging reports, prioritizing overdue and high-balance accounts.

- Contact insurance companies by phone and through portals to follow up on unpaid, delayed, denied or underpaid dental claims.

- Coordinate corrected claims, missing documentation, resubmissions and appeals with our team.

- Review patient ledgers and explanations of benefits to identify billing discrepancies before requesting payment.

- Document every call, account update, payment commitment and next follow-up date in Open Dental.

- Communicate unresolved issues to the office lead and recommend next steps.

- Maintain daily activity records and provide weekly reports showing collections, resolved claims and remaining outstanding balances.

- Protect patient information and follow office confidentiality and security procedures.



**Required Qualifications**



- Previous experience supporting a U.S. dental practice in billing, accounts receivable, insurance claims or patient collections.

- Excellent spoken and written English, with clear articulation, strong listening skills and a professional telephone manner.

- Confidence making outbound calls and discussing financial matters with patients.

- Understanding of dental insurance claims, EOBs, patient responsibility and A/R aging reports.

- Strong organization, accuracy and consistent follow-through.

- Reliable internet, a computer, a quality headset and a quiet, private workspace.

- Availability during agreed U.S. Central Time working hours.



**Preferred Qualifications**



- Experience with Open Dental.

- Proven success reducing overdue dental accounts receivable.

- Experience resolving denied claims and following up with U.S. dental insurance carriers.

- Spanish fluency in addition to excellent English.



**How Success Will Be Measured**



Success means collecting outstanding balances, resolving unpaid insurance claims and reducing aged A/R. We will review dollars collected, accounts and claims resolved, follow-up completion and documentation accuracy. Account adjustments or write-offs require management approval.



**To Apply**



Please apply through this platform and include:



1. Your résumé and a summary of your U.S. dental billing and collections experience.

2. The dental software and insurance portals you have used.

3. Your country, time zone, availability and expected hourly or monthly rate.

4. A 60–90 second voice recording in English introducing yourself and explaining how you would professionally approach a patient about an overdue balance.

5. A brief example of how you helped collect an overdue balance or resolve an unpaid insurance claim. Do not include patient names or identifying information.



Selected candidates will complete a video interview and a short role-play using a fictional patient balance and insurance claim.



**We are seeking a dependable professional who takes ownership of follow-up and helps turn outstanding balances into collected revenue.**

title: Senior Bookkeeper
description:
First things first...

This is a 100% remote position that requires 0–10% travel and has a salary range of 1,700-1,900/month USD, plus 13th-month pay. This is a full-time, monthly salaried position. You will be required to work Central Standard Time business hours. 



We are looking for a seasoned accounting professional who can take ownership of daily accounting operations, confidently solve problems, and deliver accurate financials with minimal oversight. 



Does working on a variety of projects, contributing to different types of workflows, never having the same day twice in a row sound exciting to you? Are you a financial wizard with a passion for precision and a love for meaningful work? Us too.. That’s why we started Atomus Partners!



If you're ready to elevate your career in accounting, we have an exciting opportunity that awaits you!



What We Do

Atomus -- the Latin word for atoms, which are the basic building blocks of the universe. At Atomus Partners, we operate as a back-office nucleus, allowing the organization to focus on what it does best - its core business. We remove the common challenges small and medium-sized businesses often struggle with in developing, growing, and maintaining a highly functional back office (HR, Administrative, Finance/Accounting, IT), and help them to see beyond today.



What You’ll Do

Reporting to our Accounting Manager, our Senior Bookkeeper will independently manage day-to-day accounting operations, take ownership of month-end close activities, and ensure accurate, review-ready financial reporting. Your days will be filled with:



Client and Team Support:

• Independently manage accounting deliverables and collaborate with the Accounting Manager to ensure accurate financial reporting and dependable service. 

• Maintain organized files, ensure deliverables are complete and on time, and support the Accounting Manager in executing key initiatives throughout the year. 

• Work alongside cross-functional partners and external vendors to ensure smooth payroll processing, accurate reporting, and successful year-end preparation. 

• Communicate confidently and professionally with U.S.-based clients, participating in calls, proactively following up on outstanding items, and resolving routine accounting questions. 



Financial Mastery:

• Manage day-to-day activity in QuickBooks Online including transaction coding, accounts payable and receivable workflows, and maintaining clean, organized ledgers. 

• Perform bank and credit card reconciliations, review activity for accuracy, and ensure accounts are supported and properly documented. Independently prepare and post adjusting journal entries such as accruals, prepaids, deferrals, and depreciation. 



Balance Sheet Ownership:

• Own the review and reconciliation of balance sheet accounts to ensure completeness and accuracy. Identify variances or unusual patterns, independently research and resolve discrepancies, and escalate complex issues to the Accounting Manager with proposed solutions. 

• Maintain schedules and take ownership of month-end close processes, ensuring financial statements are accurate, complete, and ready for Accounting Manager review. 



Process Enhancement:

• Identify opportunities to streamline existing workflows, improve documentation, and reduce manual steps.

• Bring forward ideas and participate in projects to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and scalability in the accounting function.



What will make you successful in this role (skills)

• Excellent English, written and verbal skills required.

• Accounting education preferred.

• Proven Expertise: With at least 5 years of full-cycle US bookkeeping experience, fully utilizing GAAP accounting, you have strong skills in financial reporting, accurate reconciliations, and independently reviewing and analyzing balance sheets and financial statements to identify and resolve discrepancies before final review. 

• Technical Proficiency: You are tech-savvy, with a minimum of 3 years of experience in QuickBooks Online and strong expertise in Excel. You skillfully navigate multiple internal systems to manage time efficiently and ensure seamless client communication, and deliverables.

• Experience with accounts payable platforms such as 
, Ramp, or Melio; experience with Xero is a plus.

• Success in leveraging task management systems to stay organized, manage deadlines, and maintain clear priorities.

• Extreme Attention to Detail: Attention to detail is so important in what we do every day. So much, that we want to make sure you read this posting in its entirety. When you submit your resume, there will be a question that says “Please include any additional information that you feel has not been previously covered”, please enter your favorite color here.

• Accounting Judgment: Strong understanding of how transactions impact the financial statements, with the ability to identify unusual balances, research discrepancies, and determine appropriate accounting treatment without step-by-step guidance. 

• Integrity and Confidentiality: Uphold the highest ethical standards, ensuring confidentiality of sensitive financial information.

• Communication Extraordinaire: Your clear and concise communication skills, both written and verbal, set the stage for effective client interactions. You are confident in communicating directly with U.S.-based professionals, asking thoughtful questions, and clearly explaining accounting matters. 

• Multi-Tasking Maven: Thrive in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple tasks and deadlines with finesse.

• Independent Initiative: Demonstrated ability to independently manage accounting responsibilities, proactively identify and resolve issues, meet deadlines without constant follow-up, and deliver accurate, complete work with minimal oversight. 

• Collaborative Champion: Your collaborative spirit and positive attitude make you an invaluable team player.

• Continuous Improvement Advocate: Embrace change and champion process enhancements, keeping up with evolving client and organizational needs.



Why Us?

Working at Atomus Partners means living our core values: Commit to Quality, Create Solutions, Collaborate as One, Cultivate Raving Fans, and Climb Higher. You will be challenged daily to develop solutions. Atomus Partners is not for those who just want to clock in, go through the motions, and clock out, as you’ll learn more and grow in 1 year than in 3-5 years at other companies. If you share our core values and liked what you read on this job posting, please apply.



What is in store for you:

Collaborative team culture in a dynamic working environment

Medical insurance reimbursement for the employee and one dependent

20 Leave credits consumed at your discretion

Talent engagement & development programs

WFH arrangement

Important: To demonstrate your attention to detail, please include your favorite color in the subject line of your application message.



Note: Applications without a CV link and the correct subject line will not be considered.
