title: E-commerce Product Data Specialist (Listing Enrichment, Error Fixing & Data Entry)
description:
We're a US-based online electronics and technology reseller selling across multiple marketplaces (Amazon, Walmart, Best Buy, eBay, Newegg, and others). We're looking for a detail-oriented VA to improve and maintain our product listing data. This is a long-term, full-time role with room to grow into a team lead position.



WHAT YOU'LL DO:

- Enrich product listings: find and fill in missing attributes (specs, dimensions, model numbers, UPC/GTIN, categories, bullet points, descriptions) using manufacturer and distributor sources

- Fix listing errors and rejections from marketplace feeds and upload reports, then re-submit corrected data

- Enter and update product data in spreadsheets, our channel management platform, and marketplace dashboards

- Match products to the correct listings and flag mismatches or duplicates

- Follow our SOPs and checklists, and document any new issues you find

- Report daily on what you completed, what's pending, and what needs a decision

- Assist with other back-office e-commerce tasks as needed. Training is provided for anything new.



REQUIREMENTS:

- 1+ year of experience in e-commerce, product data entry, catalog management, or marketplace listing work (Amazon Seller Central experience is a big plus)

- Strong English reading and writing skills

- Very high attention to detail. Accuracy matters more than speed

- Comfortable with Excel or Google Sheets (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, filters, find and replace)

- Able to follow written SOPs and Loom video training

- Flexible and willing to learn new tasks as they come up

- Reliable high-speed internet, a backup internet or power option, and a computer that can handle multiple browser tabs

- Basic familiarity with electronics and IT products is a plus, but not required

- Comfortable using AI tools (like ChatGPT or Claude) to speed up research and drafting is a plus



SCHEDULE: Full-time (40 hrs/week). Some overlap with US Eastern time (at least 3-4 hours) is required. Please state your availability in your application.



PAY: $5-8/hr depending on experience. Paid weekly or bi-weekly via your preferred method.



TO APPLY, PLEASE INCLUDE:

1. A short summary of your relevant experience (e-commerce, catalog, or data entry)

2. Your availability and expected hourly rate

3. The tools and platforms you've worked with

4. The phrase "DATA CHECK" at the top of your message so we know you read this post

5. A short answer: "A product listing was rejected for 'missing required attribute.' How would you approach finding and fixing it?"



Shortlisted applicants will complete a short paid test project (about 1-2 hours) before final selection.

Relevant certifications such as:

title: Paralegal – Criminal Defense (Law Graduate)
description:
Position Overview:

We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Paralegal or Attorney to support our criminal defense practice. This role requires in-depth knowledge of criminal law, including motion preparation, legal research, and document management. The ideal candidate will be responsible for preparing motions, drafting legal documents, and ensuring compliance with legal procedures. They will work closely with attorneys to ensure the defense strategy is executed effectively, and help prepare cases for court. This is a remote position requiring exceptional written English, organizational skills, and a strong grasp of U.S. criminal law procedures fundamentals.



Key Responsibilities:



• Draft, review, and be prepared to file various legal documents including motions, briefs, and memoranda.

• Prepare appendices for motions, including organizing exhibits, declarations, and supporting documentation.

• Prepare the table of contents for legal filings, ensuring accuracy and compliance with court rules.

• Conduct in-depth legal research on complex criminal law issues and generate a research summary for the attorney.

• Analyze discovery materials to identify critical issues and inconsistencies.

• Prepare memoranda and case summaries to aid in litigation strategy.

• Assist in the preparation of motions for hearings, trials, and appeals, including motions to suppress evidence, dismiss charges, or modify bail.

• Manage case files, ensuring all relevant documents and evidence are properly documented and stored.

• Prepare discovery responses, subpoenas, and other legal documents as directed.

• Coordinate with clients, witnesses, and experts to gather information and evidence for cases.

• Maintain communication with the court, opposing counsel, and clients regarding motions, hearings, and court dates.

• Provide support during trial preparation, including organizing exhibits, trial briefs, and witness lists.

• Ensure all legal documents comply with applicable state and federal rules and deadlines.



Qualifications:



• Must be a Graduate of a law school (JD).

• Proven experience in criminal defense law, specifically in motion practice.

• Strong knowledge of court rules, procedures, and legal writing standards.

• Experience preparing appendices, tables of contents, and organizing large case files.

• Excellent research, analytical, and writing skills.

• Must have strong knowledge of legal citation

• Ability to manage multiple cases and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong communication skills and attention to detail.

• Experience with legal research tools (e.g.,Lexis/Nexis and Westlaw) and document management software, such as Clio CRM software.



Preferred:



• Prior experience in criminal defense law or litigation.

• Knowledge of specific motions in criminal defense, including motions to suppress, dismiss, and motions for bond 

 reductions.

• Familiarity with Nevada local court rules and procedures in criminal defense.



Application Process:



Interested candidates should submit the following:

• An updated resume.

• A cover letter detailing your experience with U.S. criminal law and Clio software.

• Two writing samples (legal motions or briefs preferred) with how long it required the applicant to finalize the presented 

 document (in hours) from the time the assignment was given to the document presented.

title: Application Specialist
description:
Position Overview:

About Power Plus Systems:

title: Client Intake & Client Success Specialist
description:
Client Intake & Client Success Specialist

Full-Time  | Remote | 9AM-5PM EST



We are hiring a highly responsive and organized Client Intake & Client Success Specialist

to support a fast-growing Canadian law firm. You will be the first point of contact for prospective clients and will play a key role  in making sure every inquiry is responded to quickly, properly assessed, documented, followed up on, and moved through the intake process. This role is ideal for someone who is confident on the phone, empathetic with clients, highly organized, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where follow-up and responsiveness matter.



What You'll Do

• Respond promptly and professionally to new client inquiries by phone,
, and

other channels

• Conduct intake calls and gather relevant information from prospective clients

• Screen and qualify inquiries based on established criteria and workflows

• Schedule consultations and coordinate next steps

• Follow up consistently with prospective clients so qualified opportunities do not go cold

• Prepare client agreements and intake documentation accurately

• Track outstanding documents and signatures through completion

• Maintain accurate notes and records in the lead/client management system

• Coordinate smooth handoffs to internal team members

• Provide a professional, compassionate, and positive client experience

• Support client satisfaction initiatives, including requesting and responding to online reviews

• Track follow-ups, response times, conversion activity, and other intake metrics



What We're Looking For

• 2+ years of experience in client intake, customer service, sales, customer success, lead management, or a similar client facing role

• Excellent spoken and written English

• Strong and confident phone communication skills

• Excellent active listening and interpersonal skills

• Highly organized with strong follow-through

• Comfortable managing a high volume of inquiries, tasks, and deadlines

• Strong attention to detail when preparing documentation and recording client information

• Comfortable using CRM, lead management, scheduling, and other online systems

• Able to follow structured workflows while using good judgment

• Comfortable working with KPIs, response-time expectations, and accountability metrics

• Able to work independently in a fast-moving remote environment



Strong Advantages

Experience in any of the following is a strong asset:

• Law firms or legal services

• Insurance or claims

• Healthcare or medical services

• Financial or professional services

• High-volume inbound sales or lead qualification

• Preparing agreements, contracts, retainers, or other client-facing documents



Experience with personal injury matters is an advantage but not required. Training on intake criteria, processes, and systems will be provided.



You'll Be a Great Fit If You Are

• Responsive — you do not let calls, messages, or follow-ups sit unanswered

• Empathetic — you can communicate professionally with people who may be

stressed or dealing with difficult circumstances

• Accountable — you take ownership of your leads, follow-ups, documentation, and results

• Detail-Oriented — you understand that accuracy matters

• Decisive — you can follow established criteria and make sound intake decisions

• Process-Driven — you enjoy systems, workflows, and keeping things organized

• Persistent — you are comfortable following up multiple times when needed

• Growth-Minded — you enjoy working in a fast-growing organization that continuously improves



This Role May Not Be Right for You If

• You are uncomfortable speaking with clients regularly by phone

• You frequently need reminders to complete follow-ups

• You struggle to manage multiple conversations and priorities at once

• You prefer a slow-paced environment with limited accountability

• You dislike working with KPIs or structured processes

• You are uncomfortable having respectful but direct conversations with prospective clients who may not qualify



How to Apply

Please submit:

1. Your updated resume

2. A short audio or video introduction explaining your experience with client intake, customer

service, sales, or lead management

3. Start your application subject line with the word RESPONSIVE – Your Name

title: Application Specialist
description:
Position Overview: 



The Application Specialist is responsible for testing, troubleshooting, and updating the internal apps, automations, and workflows Power Plus Systems develops, making sure each one is reliable, easy to use, and ready for rollout. This role works closely with the Operations Manager and Data Specialist, partners with the Process Specialist to make sure every new application or update process is documented before rollout, and collaborates with Admin Operations, Scheduling, Finance, Estimating, and Field teams to find issues before team members do and turn feedback into improvements. The ideal candidate has a software development background, hands-on experience using Claude and other AI tools, a working knowledge of webhooks and integrations, and a strong eye for user interface and user experience design. 



Pay Range: $8 per hour based on experience with a performance review scheduled after 90 days of employment. We believe in rewarding exceptional talents. 





About Power Plus Systems: 



Power Plus Systems LLC has been a dominant force in the residential electrical contracting industry for two decades, and we continue to lead the way. Our vision is to successfully wire 28,000 homes to completion by the year 2029, ensuring safe and efficient electrical solutions, thereby making a positive impact on the lives of our customers and communities. At Power Plus Systems, LLC, a position with us isn't just a job; it's an opportunity to grow and develop within a company that genuinely appreciates your contributions and dedication to our shared mission. 





Objectives: 



- Test company apps, automations, and workflows before rollout to confirm they work as intended across devices, browsers, and real-world scenarios.

- Perform manual testing and support automated testing to catch bugs, broken logic, and edge cases early. 

- Troubleshoot issues reported by team members, identify the root cause, and coordinate fixes with the Operations Manager and Data Specialist. 

- Test and monitor webhooks and integrations between systems such as GoHighLevel, Make, 
, Claude, Jotform, and other company platforms to ensure data passes correctly. 

- Review apps from the user's point of view and recommend and implement UI and UX improvements that make tools easier, faster, and clearer for team members. 

- Use Claude and other AI tools to speed up test case creation, debugging, documentation, and app updates. 

- Apply approved updates and improvements to existing apps and workflows, then retest to confirm nothing else broke. 

- Work with the Process Specialist to make sure every new application or update process is documented before rollout, and maintain test checklists and release notes so every rollout is consistent and repeatable. 





Competencies: 



- Solid understanding of software development concepts, including front-end and back-end logic, APIs, and how data moves between systems. 

- Hands-on experience using Claude and other AI tools in daily work, with the judgment to verify AI output before relying on it. 

- Working knowledge of webhooks, including how to read payloads, interpret response codes, and troubleshoot failed connections. 

- Familiarity with manual and automated testing methods, test cases, and regression testing for apps and workflows. 

- Strong eye for design with a clear understanding of user interface (UI) and user experience (UX) principles. 

- Analytical, detail-oriented approach to finding root causes rather than surface-level fixes. 

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues to non-technical team members. 

- Ability to manage multiple testing and update projects at once while meeting rollout deadlines. 

- Comfort using browser developer tools and automation platforms such as Make or Zapier is a plus. 

- Construction, electrical, or trade-industry experience is a plus. 





Education and Experience: 



- Background in software development through a degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience. 

- At least 2 years of experience in software development, QA testing, application support, or a related role. 

- Experience testing web apps, mobile apps, or automated workflows before release. 

- Experience working with webhooks, APIs, or system integrations. 

- Proven experience using Claude or other AI tools in a professional setting. 

- Experience with UI/UX design, design reviews, or tools such as Figma is a plus. 

- Experience with GoHighLevel, Make, 
, Claude, or similar business platforms is a plus. 





Equipment Requirements: 



- Computer or laptop capable of running multiple browsers, testing tools, and collaboration platforms at the same time. 

- Smartphone for testing mobile versions of company apps. 

- Stable and reliable internet connection for online operations and virtual communication. 





Physical Requirements: 



- Extended periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. 





Benefits: 



- Growth opportunities in a well-established company. 

- Ongoing training and professional development opportunities. 

- Opportunity for advancement within the company. 

- A supportive and collaborative work environment. 

- Company-observed paid United States holidays (full time). 



Paid vacation (full time). 





How to Apply: 



If you are ready to join Power Plus Systems, LLC, a well-established residential electrical contractor that values its team members and offers excellent benefits, please submit your application through the link below. 




/internationalform 



Power Plus Systems, LLC is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds to apply. 



Join us at Power Plus Systems, LLC, and be part of our continued success as we embark on the next 20 years of excellence in residential electrical contracting!

title: Part-Time Bookkeeper (QuickBooks, AR/AP)
description:
About us

Jay's Heating, Air & Plumbing is a four-generation HVAC, plumbing, and electrical company serving North Carolina and Virginia, with 50+ employees. We're growing, and we're building an offshore support team to back up our in-house office staff.



What you'll do

- Enter and code vendor bills and match them to purchase orders

- Follow up on past-due customer invoices and apply payments

- Prepare monthly bank and credit card reconciliations for our controller to review

- Help with month-end prep and keep our financial trackers up to date

- Collect and check payroll timesheet data (you will not process payroll)



Requirements

- 2+ years of bookkeeping or AR/AP experience, ideally with US businesses

- Experience with QuickBooks Online or QuickBooks Desktop (please tell us which you've used and for how long)

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

- Excellent written English and attention to detail

- Reliable internet and a quiet workspace

- Available for at least 4 hours overlapping US Eastern business hours (9 AM-5 PM ET)



Schedule: Part-time, 15-20 hours per week, long-term.



To apply

Send your resume and tell us which QuickBooks version you've used and for how many years. Shortlisted candidates will complete a short paid test (reconciling a sample account).

title: Medical Office Assistant / Practice Coordinator
description:
This job is for a telemedicine practice based in the US. We blend conventional, integrative, and functional medicine to treat hormone and thyroid conditions, autoimmune disease, gut health, weight loss (including GLP-1 therapy), fertility preparation, and more. We serve patients in three states.  We're a cash-pay practice ( no insurance accepted ) with a small, close-knit patient base, and we care a lot about patients feeling looked after.



About the role

This is not a "wait to be told what to do" job.  The practitioner sees patients about 15 hours a week. During those hours you keep the day running smoothly. The rest of your time goes to the back end: following up, cleaning up, and making our systems simpler and faster. You'll work with significant independence and little day-to-day oversight. The owner will rely on you heavily. The right person treats the practice like their own: they spot problems, find solutions, follow through, and leave no task open-ended.



What you'll do

Patient communication

• Answer calls, texts,
s, and portal messages warmly and professionally, always identifying yourself and the practice

• Schedule new and follow-up visits across time zones (schedule runs on Central Time)

• Send same-day appointment reminders and handle cancellations and reschedules according to our policy

• Answer clerical patient questions (lab status, billing, supplements, test kits) and route clinical questions to Rachel



Billing and payments

• Collect payment for visits and cash-pay labs and verify cards on file

• Follow up on declined cards and outstanding balances until resolved

• Reconcile the monthly lab bill against patient payments and catch billing errors



Labs, orders, and coordination

• Enter lab orders (Labcorp, Quest) and specialty tests 

• Prepare and fax imaging orders and referral letters

• Complete prior authorizations using chart notes (CoverMyMeds) - this is not frequent

• Manage incoming faxes: file results, prior auths, records requests, and refill requests, and route them correctly

• Handle medical records requests and releases of information, following each through to completion

• Communicate with pharmacies, other providers' offices, imaging centers, labs, and company representatives



Back-end and operations

• Keep every follow-up task closed out with a clear outcome

• Manage the practice inbox and keep shared documents organized and up to date

• Prepare monthly social media and
 content using provided templates and Canva ( eventually)

• Improve our workflows. Identify bottlenecks, suggest fixes, update our procedures guide, and reduce repeated work



Who you are

• Self-starter. When there's downtime, you find the next most valuable thing to do.

• Problem solver. You come with "here's what I found and what I recommend," not just "what should I do?"

• Loop closer. You follow up until things are resolved. Nothing falls through the cracks.

• Clear, personal communicator. Patients get concise, accurate, human replies, not long generic ones.

• Detail-oriented with money and medical information. You double-check orders, codes, and charges.

• Discreet and trustworthy. You handle protected health and payment information with care.



Requirements

• 2+ years in a medical office, medical virtual assistant, or healthcare admin role

• Experience with EHR systems, prior authorizations, and lab ordering

• Excellent written and spoken English

• Reliable internet, a quiet workspace, and a computer suitable for HIPAA-compliant work

• Availability during core patient hours: Monday - Friday 9:30 AM to 3:30 PM Central Standard Time

• Ability to learn new software quickly



Nice to have: experience with, RingCentral, CoverMyMeds, Fullscript, Google Workspace, Canva; functional or integrative medicine background; medical billing/coding knowledge (CPT, ICD-10).

title: Social Media Video Editor & Content Researcher
description:
Social Media Video Editor & Content Researcher



Brand: Après-Ski Daily

Platforms: Instagram, TikTok &

Position: Part-Time ± 10 hours

Schedule: Flexible hours, as long as weekly deadlines are met



About Après-Ski Daily

Après-Ski Daily is an Alpine lifestyle and après-ski brand focused on the party scene across the European Alps.

We have built a community of 115,000+ followers across Instagram, 
 and
, generating 50 million views during the last winter season.

We are looking for a highly independent and creative video editor who understands the energy of après-ski, electronic music, festivals and party culture.

This is not a traditional editing role where someone simply receives footage and cuts it together. We are looking for someone who can independently find content, identify great moments and trends, and turn them into engaging short-form videos.

We do not have our own video footage at the moment, so you will be responsible for sourcing content and developing videos from start to finish.



Your Responsibilities

1. Content Research & Sourcing

• Independently find and collect suitable après-ski, skiing, snowboarding, festival and party footage from the European Alps (from posted content by existing venues across the Alps).

• Identify the best clips, moments and angles to create engaging videos.

• Build and maintain a consistent pipeline of suitable content without needing us to provide footage or ideas.



2. Video Editing

• Independently create 7 short-form videos per week for Instagram Reels, 
 and
 Reels.

• Edit high-energy videos focused on après-ski, parties, DJs, electronic music and Alpine nightlife.

• Use strong hooks, fast pacing, well-timed cuts, music synchronization and engaging storytelling.

• Add text overlays, captions and other editing elements where appropriate.

• Understand what makes party videos exciting, immersive and shareable.

• Maintain a consistent style that fits the Après-Ski Daily brand.



3. Publishing & Scheduling

• Submit completed videos for our review and implement feedback or requested changes.

• Schedule approved posts through Metricool.



4. Performance & Improvement

• Monitor video performance and identify which styles, hooks and formats work best.

• Use these insights to continuously improve the content.



What We Are Looking For

• Strong affinity with party video editing, especially après-ski, festivals, nightlife, DJ sets and electronic music.

• Experience editing short-form content for Instagram, 
 and
.

• A good understanding of viral video formats, hooks, pacing and audience retention.

• The ability to independently source suitable footage and turn it into complete videos.

• A creative eye for selecting exciting moments and combining clips into engaging edits.

• You do not need daily instructions to get things done.

• Reliable communication, organization and respect for deadlines.

• Good written English.



Working Hours & Compensation

• Approximately ± 10 hours per week.

• Flexible working hours. You can organize your own schedule as long as all deliverables and deadlines are met.

• Long-term opportunity for the right person, with the potential to grow alongside the brand.

We value independence, creativity and consistent quality more than simply spending a certain number of hours online.



How to Apply

Please include the following in your application:

1. A short introduction about yourself and your experience.

2. Links to your portfolio, especially party, festival, nightlife or high-energy short-form edits.

3. Examples of videos you have edited that performed well, if available.

4. A short explanation of how you would independently source enough suitable footage to create 7 videos per week without receiving raw footage from us.

5. Your expected monthly salary for approximately 20–25 hours per week.

title: CUSTOMER SUCCESS & RETENTION SPECIALIST
description:
About the Role



We are looking for an experienced Customer Success & Retention Specialist to assist customers who have received an impression kit but have not yet started or completed the process.



This is a high-touch, phone-based role that combines customer support, proactive follow-up, troubleshooting, retention, and conflict resolution.



You will help customers understand the process, address their concerns, overcome obstacles, and move toward completion. You will also handle cancellation and refund requests by identifying the underlying concern and exploring appropriate solutions in line with company policies.



We are looking for someone who can balance empathy with confidence, protect the customer experience, and take ownership of each case from initial contact through resolution.



Key Responsibilities

Proactively call customers who have received their impression kits but have not started or completed the process.

Guide customers through the process using clear, patient, step-by-step instructions.

Identify reasons for delays, incomplete kits, cancellations, and refund requests.

Troubleshoot common issues and help customers overcome process-related difficulties.

Address concerns about timing, inconvenience, expectations, product confidence, and completion requirements.

Apply appropriate retention strategies to resolve concerns and prevent avoidable cancellations.

De-escalate frustrated customers while maintaining a professional and empathetic approach.

Explore realistic solutions without making promises outside company policy.

Conduct consistent follow-ups until the customer completes the process or reaches a final resolution.

Document calls, customer concerns, commitments, outcomes, and follow-up dates in the CRM.

Coordinate with internal teams regarding replacement kits, technical support, refunds, and escalations.

Identify recurring customer concerns and recommend ways to improve completion and retention.



Qualifications

Excellent spoken English with clear pronunciation, strong comprehension, and professional phone etiquette.

Previous experience in customer retention, customer success, phone support, healthcare support, complaint resolution, subscription retention, collections, or inside sales.

Strong verbal communication, active listening, and questioning skills.

Proven ability to handle objections, difficult conversations, and cancellation or refund requests.

Ability to remain calm and professional when dealing with upset or frustrated customers.

Strong problem-solving, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.

Empathetic but confident in guiding customers toward appropriate solutions.

Experience with CRM systems and case management is an advantage.

Excellent organization, follow-up discipline, and case ownership.

This position is best suited for experienced professionals who can build rapport quickly, uncover the real reason behind customer hesitation, and turn challenging conversations into positive outcomes.



How to Apply

To be considered, please submit BOTH of the following:



Your updated resume highlighting your relevant phone support, customer success, retention, or conflict-resolution experience.

An introduction video discussing your relevant experience, spoken English and phone communication skills, objection-handling abilities, and how you would handle a frustrated customer requesting a cancellation or refund.



Important: Applications submitted without BOTH an updated resume and an introduction video will NOT be considered.



If you have the confidence, patience, and customer retention skills needed to make a difference, we encourage you to apply!

description:
Company: Aquanauts Window Cleaning & Pressure Washing

Schedule: Every Friday and Saturday, 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM (U.S. Central Time)

Compensation: $5 per hour + Performance Bonuses + Sales Commissions

Location: Remote



About the Position



Aquanauts is looking for a reliable, friendly, and motivated Customer Service & Sales Representative to handle customer inquiries and sales opportunities every Friday and Saturday.



Your primary responsibilities will include answering incoming customer calls/text, assisting customers with questions about our services, scheduling estimates, providing virtual estimates, and helping turn customer inquiries into booked jobs.



What makes this position different?



Unlike a traditional customer service role, you will not necessarily be actively working every minute of your scheduled shift.



This is primarily a coverage based position. Call/Text volume and customer inquiries will vary throughout the day, meaning there may be more periods of downtime between tasks.



However, you must remain available, attentive, and ready to respond promptly whenever a customer calls/text or needs assistance.



We are looking for someone who can work independently, manage their time responsibly, and provide excellent customer service without constant supervision.



Key Responsibilities

- Answer incoming customer calls/text promptly, professionally, and with a friendly attitude.

- Assist customers with questions about our services, pricing, and availability.

- Schedule estimates, appointments, and service bookings.

- Prepare and provide virtual estimates using company pricing guidelines.

- Identify sales opportunities and confidently help customers move forward with booking services.

- Follow established company scripts, procedures, and customer service standards.

- Accurately document customer information, conversations, estimates, and appointments in our CRM.

- Follow up with customers when needed to help secure bookings.

- Remain available and responsive throughout your scheduled coverage hours.



What We're Looking For

- Excellent English communication skills, both spoken and written.

- A clear, friendly, confident, and professional phone presence.

- Previous experience in customer service, sales, receptionist work, virtual assistance, or phone support is preferred.

- Comfortable speaking with customers and answering questions independently.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to confidently present pricing and help close sales.

- Comfortable using computers, CRM systems, scheduling software, and other online tools.

- Dependable, self motivated, and able to work with minimal supervision.

- Consistent availability every Friday and Saturday from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM U.S. Central Time.



Compensation & Benefits

- $5 per hour for scheduled coverage hours.

- Additional performance bonuses.

- Sales commissions for qualifying sales you successfully close.

- Downtime between customer inquiries when call volume is low.

- Opportunity to develop valuable customer service and sales experience.



How to Apply



If you're a dependable, motivated individual with strong communication skills and a passion for helping customers, we'd love to hear from you!



To apply, please submit:



- Your updated resume or CV.

- A brief cover letter explaining why you believe you're a great fit for this position.

- Please make sure your cover letter highlights any relevant customer service, sales, or phone support experience.



Qualified applicants will be contacted with the next steps in our hiring process.

title: General Manager
description:
General Manager



Location: Fully Remote

Schedule: Full-time, aligned with U.S. Central Time

Engagement: Independent Contractor

Compensation: $3,000/month base + performance-based bonus opportunity



ABOUT THE COMPANY



We help businesses improve performance by identifying opportunities to strengthen processes, systems, automation, and overall operations.



Our goal is not simply to provide support. We aim to help elevate the businesses we serve by understanding how they operate, identifying opportunities for improvement, and helping clients build stronger, more efficient organizations.



THE ROLE



We are looking for an experienced General Manager to lead our remote services operation.



This is a hands-on senior leadership role for someone who is comfortable taking ownership of day-to-day operations, leading teams, managing client relationships, and driving business performance while partnering closely with company ownership on major strategic decisions.



The General Manager will have broad responsibility for the company’s operations, client satisfaction, team performance, financial results, service delivery, and continued development of the business.



The right person will be both an operator and a builder, someone who can successfully manage what exists today while continuously improving the systems, structure, and capabilities needed for the future.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



- Lead the day-to-day operations of the business

- Own client relationships, client satisfaction, and overall account health

- Develop a deep understanding of each client’s business, priorities, challenges, and expectations

- Identify opportunities to improve client workflows, processes, systems, automation, and operational efficiency

- Proactively surface opportunities where AI, automation, workflow redesign, or other improvements could create additional value for clients

- Lead and manage the remote team, including performance management, accountability, resource allocation, and workload planning

- Build and maintain clear KPIs, scorecards, operating rhythms, and performance standards

- Own the company’s P&L and overall financial performance

- Monitor profitability, margins, staffing efficiency, resource utilization, and service delivery economics

- Prepare and provide regular operating and financial updates to company ownership

- Lead new-client onboarding and implementation

- Ensure smooth transitions from sales through implementation and ongoing service delivery

- Build, improve, and enforce internal SOPs, processes, workflows, and operating standards

- Identify organizational, staffing, pricing, or structural improvements and make recommendations to ownership

- Support business development, account growth, and new-client conversations as appropriate

- Help shape the future direction, capabilities, and operating model of the business

- Over time, develop the financial fluency and client knowledge necessary to confidently participate in and lead financial discussions with clients



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



- 8+ years of progressive leadership experience in operations, finance, client services, general management, or a related field

- 5+ years of experience leading teams and holding people accountable for measurable results

- Required experience in at least one of the following environments:

  - BPO / outsourcing

  - Accounting or bookkeeping services

  - Professional services

  - Multi-client service delivery or account management

- Demonstrated experience owning client relationships and managing client satisfaction

- Strong operational judgment and the ability to balance client needs, team performance, delivery quality, and business profitability

- Experience building or improving systems, processes, SOPs, dashboards, and operating structures

- Fluent, professional-level English with excellent written and verbal communication skills

- Comfortable working U.S. Central Time hours

- Comfortable operating independently while knowing when to escalate major decisions



STRONGLY PREFERRED



- CPA designation

- Prior accounting or finance leadership experience

- Experience managing remote teams across multiple countries or time zones

- Experience managing P&L responsibility

- Experience working directly with business owners, executives, or senior client stakeholders

- Strong understanding of financial statements, margins, budgets, and business performance

- Experience in fast-moving entrepreneurial or growth-stage environments



STRONG PLUS



- Experience with AI tools, automation platforms, workflow automation, or process redesign

- Experience identifying operational improvement opportunities within client businesses

- Experience helping clients improve processes beyond the original scope of service

- Experience supporting business development or account expansion



LEADERSHIP STYLE



We are looking for someone who:



- Takes ownership

- Thinks commercially

- Communicates clearly

- Leads with accountability

- Builds structure where structure is missing

- Makes decisions using data rather than intuition alone

- Is comfortable having difficult conversations when necessary

- Can build trust with both clients and team members

- Looks beyond the immediate task to understand how the entire business can improve



DECISION AUTHORITY



The General Manager will have significant responsibility for running the business day to day.



Major decisions involving organizational restructuring, hiring or termination, pricing changes, contract changes, or other material business decisions will be made in partnership with and require approval from company ownership.



APPLICATION



Please
 your résumé or CV to 
 line: General Manager Application - [Your Name]



Along with your résumé or CV, please include a short response to the following:



In 3–5 sentences, explain why you are qualified to lead a multi-client remote services business and describe one example of how you have improved client outcomes beyond simply managing service delivery.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
# Full-Time Bookkeeper – Home Services Company



**Location:** Remote — Philippines

**Schedule:** 40 hours per week, with occasional additional hours as business needs require

**Working Hours:** [Insert required U.S. time zone and schedule]

**Compensation:** [Insert salary range and payment details]



## About the Role



We are a growing U.S.-based home services company seeking a dependable, detail-oriented full-time bookkeeper in the Philippines. You will oversee the company’s day-to-day bookkeeping, payroll coordination, invoicing, collections, commissions, and financial records.



This is a hands-on role for someone who takes ownership, follows up consistently, and keeps financial information accurate and organized. You will work closely with company leadership, team members in the United States and abroad, and our external accountant.



## Key Responsibilities



### Bookkeeping and Financial Records



- Maintain accurate and organized records in QuickBooks.

- Categorize and reconcile transactions, accounts, and payments.

- Keep financial information current and identify discrepancies promptly.

- Prepare regular reports that give management a clear view of the company’s financial position.

- Maintain supporting documentation for financial transactions.



### JobNimbus and Invoicing



- Maintain the financial side of our JobNimbus CRM.

- Confirm that customer invoices are accurate, complete, and issued on time.

- Monitor outstanding invoices and follow up on overdue balances.

- Record payments and keep customer account information current.

- Assess applicable late fees according to company policies.

- Perform other collection-related activities to help ensure timely payment.

- Reconcile financial information between JobNimbus and QuickBooks.



### Weekly Payroll



- Verify hours submitted by team members in the United States and abroad.

- Identify missing, inaccurate, or unusual time entries before payroll is processed.

- Prepare and coordinate weekly payroll for U.S.-based and international team members.

- Maintain accurate payroll records and resolve payroll discrepancies.

- Protect confidential employee and payroll information.



### Commissions and Spreadsheets



- Maintain spreadsheets used to calculate commissions and other team compensation.

- Verify commission amounts against completed jobs, collected payments, and company policies.

- Provide accurate commission reports before payments are approved.

- Maintain organized and auditable spreadsheet records.



### Accountant Coordination



- Coordinate with our external accountant regarding filings and financial reporting.

- Provide requested records and supporting documents accurately and on time.

- Help ensure the accountant has the information needed for tax filings, compliance, and year-end reporting.

- Respond promptly to questions and resolve missing-information requests.



### General Financial Administration



- Manage other financial and bookkeeping responsibilities as needed.

- Improve financial processes and help maintain strong internal controls.

- Communicate financial concerns, overdue accounts, and discrepancies to management.

- Meet recurring weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual deadlines.



## Required Qualifications



- Previous bookkeeping or accounting experience.

- Strong working knowledge of QuickBooks Online.

- Experience processing or coordinating payroll.

- Strong spreadsheet skills, including Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.

- Experience with invoicing, accounts receivable, and collections.

- High attention to detail and a strong commitment to accuracy.

- Excellent organization, time-management, and follow-up skills.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Ability to handle confidential financial and payroll information professionally.

- Reliable computer, stable high-speed internet connection, and a quiet workspace.

- Ability to work independently and communicate proactively with a remote team.

- Willingness to work the required U.S. business hours and occasional additional hours when needed.



## Preferred Qualifications



- Experience using JobNimbus or a similar home-services CRM.

- Bookkeeping experience with a U.S.-based company.

- Experience in roofing, construction, contracting, or another home-services industry.

- Familiarity with U.S. payroll and basic accounting practices.

- Experience calculating sales commissions or performance-based compensation.

- Experience working directly with an external accountant or CPA.



## What Success Looks Like



The successful candidate will:



- Keep QuickBooks and JobNimbus accurate and up to date.

- Ensure weekly payroll is prepared correctly and on time.

- Make sure invoices are issued promptly and actively followed up until collected.

- Maintain accurate commission calculations and supporting records.

- Give management timely visibility into financial issues.

- Provide complete, organized information to our accountant.

- Take ownership of financial tasks without requiring constant reminders.



## How to Apply



Please submit the following:



1. Your résumé or CV.

2. A brief description of your bookkeeping experience.

3. Details about your experience with QuickBooks, payroll, invoicing, collections, and spreadsheets.

4. Any experience you have with JobNimbus or another CRM.

5. Your preferred monthly salary in Philippine pesos.

6. Your availability and ability to work [insert required U.S. time zone].

7. Your internet speed and backup plans for internet or power interruptions.

8. The names of two professional references.



Please begin your application with the words **“Organized Finances”** so we know you read the entire posting.

The best CSRs are genuinely excited to help customers. They’re patient, empathetic, and passionately communicative. They love to talk. description:

About Good Luck Grams

Good Luck Grams creates custom keepsake posters for gymnastics meets across the country. Our “Grams” are displayed throughout the venue before competition begins, giving families a meaningful way to encourage their gymnast. After the meet, each family takes their Gram home as a lasting keepsake.



We work with gyms and meet directors nationwide, managing everything from design through production, shipping, and meet day display. Our busy season runs November through April, with order volume growing every year.



Key Responsibilities

Design & Production

- Populate each meet's approved template with individual order details: gymnast name, level, gym, and personal message.

- Drop in and mask out the background of each submitted photo, using Photoshop's AI selection tools for fast, accurate masking.

- Use Photoshop's Generative AI tools to fix photo issues, such as recreating a cropped-out elbow, instead of requesting a new photo (unless the resolution is too low).

- Make text corrections directly to existing JPG files without recreating the entire Gram.

- Adjust text sizing and layout so names and messages of different lengths still look clean and balanced.



Quality & Accuracy

- Proofread every file for spelling, correct gym, and correct details before marking it complete.

- Keep each order's data matched to the correct spreadsheet row so details and photos never get mixed up between Grams.

- Flag anything unclear using the designated notes field rather than letting it slide.



Workflow & Communication

- Check the order spreadsheet regularly and work through new orders as they arrive.

- Work within a shared Google Drive, organized by meet, using the designated business
.

- Communicate status and questions clearly so nothing gets lost.



Qualifications

Experience

- Previous experience with high volume, template based design work.

- Proficiency in Photoshop required, including familiarity with its newer Generative AI tools.

- Must have the latest version of Photoshop on your own computer. The software is not provided.



Skills

- A genuine eye for design: knowing when text or layout doesn't look right, and how to fix it.

- Comfortable working independently from a template and a spreadsheet of order data.

- Reliable internet and a personal computer capable of running Photoshop smoothly.



Personal Attributes

- Strong, consistent attention to detail. This is the single most important skill for this role.

- Methodical when working row by row through a spreadsheet, so the right photo and details always land on the right Gram.

- Takes initiative and doesn't need to be micromanaged.

- Able to overlap with North American working hours when needed for check-ins or urgent requests.

We're accepting applications through October 12th, 2026. We're looking to have someone started and onboarded by October 31, 2026.



Fill out the application form here -->

title: Senior Shopify Developer (Full Time, 8+ Years, Front End, Back End and QA)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We are a group of direct-to-consumer ecommerce brands on Shopify Plus, running constant tests and offers. We need one senior developer who owns everything technical on our stores: theme code, custom features, apps and integrations, A/B tests and tracking.



The most important part of this job is quality. Nothing goes live until it is tested on mobile and desktop, in every market, with every discount and cart combination. If you ship and let customers find the bugs, this role is not for you.











WHAT YOU WILL OWN



1. THEMES

   Build, customize and maintain Shopify themes (Liquid, JavaScript, CSS, Online Store 2.0 sections and blocks).



2. CART, CHECKOUT AND DISCOUNTS

   Cart drawer, bundles, tiered offers, free gifts. Shopify Functions and checkout UI extensions.



3. BACK END AND INTEGRATIONS

   Admin and Storefront APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, custom apps, and connections to fulfillment,
 and review tools.



4. A/B TESTS

   Set up, QA and end Intelligems tests (price, offer, content, shipping). Every test arm must show and charge the right price.



5. QA

   Test every release before it goes
 devices, browsers, markets, currencies, languages, discounts. Keep a written QA checklist and a release log.



6. TRACKING

   Meta pixel and Conversions API, GA4, Google Ads, UTMs. Tracked purchases must match real orders.



7. SPEED

   Core Web Vitals, app and script cleanup, image loading. Mobile first.



8. APPS

   Install, audit and remove apps. Know what every script on the site does.



9. BUG FIXING

   Fix bugs fast, find the root cause, and make sure they do not come back.



10. DOCUMENTATION

   Document everything you build and change.











HOW YOU WILL BE MEASURED



- Zero customer-facing bugs from your releases

- Every test and offer charges exactly what the site shows

- Critical bugs fixed within 24 hours

- Tracked purchases match store orders

- Mobile page speed improving month over month











REQUIREMENTS



- 8+ years of web development, at least 5 of them on Shopify ecommerce stores

- Expert in Liquid, JavaScript, HTML, CSS and Shopify theme architecture

- Back end: Shopify APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, Node.js or similar, custom apps

- Shopify Functions and checkout extensibility on Shopify Plus

- Hands-on Intelligems (or similar) price and content testing

- Strong QA habits: you test your own work before anyone else sees it

- Meta pixel, CAPI and GA4 setup and debugging

- Git, staging themes, version control

- Excellent written English

- Deadline discipline. If something will slip, you flag it before the due date, not after











NICE TO HAVE



- Multi-market, multi-currency and multi-language stores

- High-volume stores

- Klaviyo, bundle and upsell apps

- Hydrogen or headless experience











WHAT WE OFFER



- 3000 USD per month, long term, full time

- Several brands and real volume to work on

- Direct access to the decision makers. No layers, no politics











HOW TO APPLY



Generic applications are deleted. Answer all six points or do not apply.



1. Put the word CHECKPOINT at the very top of your message.



2. Links to 3 live Shopify stores you built or worked on, and exactly what you did on each.



3. One Shopify Function or checkout extension you built. What it did and how you tested it.



4. How you QA a cart discount change before it goes live. List your steps.



5. A bug of yours that reached customers. What happened and what you changed after.



6. Your available working hours in GMT+8 and your earliest start date.



Shortlisted candidates complete an unpaid trial task. Passing it is the gate to the final call with the team.

title: AI Video Generation Operator & Social Media Manager (Claude + Higgsfield)
description:
📌 Job Overview



We are seeking a highly organized, tech-savvy AI Video Generation Operator to manage our content pipeline. In this role, you will not be manually editing videos from scratch using traditional software. Instead, you will act as a systems operator—using advanced AI tools like Claude to engineer precise prompts, feeding them into video generation engines like Higgsfield, and managing the output for social media.

If you love cutting-edge AI technology, have a sharp eye for visual details, and enjoy building repeatable content workflows, this is the perfect role for you.



⚙️ Core Responsibilities



• AI Prompt Engineering: Work with Claude to write, test, and refine detailed programmatic prompts for video generation.

• Pipeline Management: Run inputs through Higgsfield to generate high-quality video assets.

• Visual Quality Assurance: Review generated clips for subtle AI glitches (flickering, morphing hands, distorted backgrounds) and re-prompt the AI to fix them.

• Social Media Management: Format, schedule, and publish the finalized video assets across our social media platforms.

• Workflow Optimization: Follow and improve step-by-step SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) to scale daily video output.



🧠 Profile & Requirements



• Technical Comfort: You must be highly comfortable troubleshooting software, handling configuration logic, and utilizing advanced AI chatbots (Claude/ChatGPT).

• Visual Eye / Editing Understanding: You understand composition, pacing, and visual storytelling, allowing you to catch micro-errors that regular viewers might miss.

• Process-Driven Mindset: You behave like a systems operator who loves following structured workflows, rather than a creative who prefers doing things manually.

• Excellent English: Strong communication skills are required to give precise instructions to AI models.



🔒 Application Instructions (The "Attention to Detail" Filter)



To prove you read this entire posting, please start your application headline with the words "System Operator Ready." Applications without this phrase will be automatically archived.

Please answer the following questions in your response:

title: Figma Designer + Showreel
description:
Figma designer and video editor for website portfolio showcases



I’m looking for a designer with a strong eye for presentation to turn websites I’ve worked on into high-quality portfolio assets and a polished showreel.



The websites already exist. Your job is to capture them properly and make the work look its best.



These assets will be used on my agency website, social media and in sales presentations. They need to feel professional, considered and visually impressive.



What you’ll do



• Take high-resolution screenshots and screen recordings of websites I provide. Like I have started in here: [
](
) Some I have to do in multi steps as the quality is low if using a browser tool. 

• Capture desktop and mobile layouts, key sections and relevant interactions.

• Create polished showcase assets in Figma, including website compositions, close-ups and device mockups where appropriate.

• Build a consistent visual style across the collection while respecting each website’s branding.

• Create a short showreel combining the projects, using smooth movement, strong pacing and clean transitions.

• Export finished assets ready for use and supply organised, editable source files.



The quality I’m looking for



Crisp screenshots. Strong composition. Thoughtful spacing. Good typography. Motion that helps show off the work.



I don’t want blurry captures, stretched screens, random mockup templates or excessive effects. The websites should be the focus.



You’ll need to check captures carefully for cookie banners, loading issues, missing images and awkward crops. The finished work should be ready to use without me having to spot and fix basic mistakes.



You’re a good fit if you



• Are confident working in Figma.

• Have examples of website showcases, digital portfolios or similar presentation work.

• Can create polished video using After Effects, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or a comparable tool.

• Understand how to capture responsive websites at high quality.

• Can follow a visual direction and make sensible design decisions independently.

• Communicate clearly and deliver reliably.



What I’ll provide



• Website URLs and details of the work to feature.

• Brand assets and visual references.

• Guidance on where the finished assets will be used.

• Feedback on the initial direction before you produce the full collection.



Deliverables



• An organised Figma file with editable showcase layouts.

• High-resolution exports in agreed website and social media formats.

• A finished showreel, plus versions for agreed placements.

• Editable video project files and any linked assets needed to use them.



We’ll agree the number of projects, assets, video length and deadlines before starting.



How to apply



Please send:



1. Two or three relevant examples of website showcase or portfolio design.

2. At least one showreel or motion design example.

3. A brief explanation of your role in each example.

4. The tools you use for website capture, design and video editing.

5. Your hourly rate or typical project pricing, availability and estimated turnaround for one website showcase.



Please lead with relevant examples rather than a large folder of unrelated work. If your strength is only design or only video, make that clear.



I’d like to start with a small paid trial covering one website showcase and a short motion sample. If the quality and working relationship are right, we can move on to the full collection.



The goal is to hand over the URLs and receive excellent, ready-to-use assets without having to manage every design decision.

title: Book Writer / Ghostwriter: Leadership Book Rewrite
description:
About the project

Leading with Heart is looking for a professional writer to rewrite an existing leadership book into a stronger Version 2. The book presents a heart-centered leadership model developed by the authors, Dr. Jeff Kaplan and Dr. Dan Young. The new edition keeps that model at its core and goes further: more research, proper citations, improved graphics, and a book that reads well from the first page to the last.

What the work involves

• Rewriting the existing manuscript as a new book, under the same title or as a second edition

• Researching and citing sources on the leadership problems organizations face today, and on why a heart-centered approach matter

• Drawing on the author's own materials, including findings from our 360-assessment research

• Meeting with the first author to understand his voice, his model and what he wants readers to take away

What we are looking for

• Professional writing experience, with a portfolio of long-form work such as books, ghostwriting or comparable projects

How we will select

2. Screening interview with our team.

3. Meeting with the author. Shortlisted candidates get an overview of the author and the project directly from Dr. Kaplan.

4. Proposal. Each finalist submits a proposal covering what you would do with the book, the specific areas you would focus on, your vision for the finished product, your estimated timeline and your cost. Finalists are evaluated on three factors: vision, experience, and cost.

title: Marketing & Social Media Manager
description:
ABOUT US

Chicago. People who join our tours have loads of fun as we explore Chicago neighborhoods, enjoy

delicious ice cream treats at local businesses, and learn fun facts about ice cream and the city. Guests

smile, mingle, laugh, and enjoy America's #1 dessert. Good vibes are the core of who we are, and that

extends to every person on our team.



THE ROLE



We are looking for a seasoned marketing leader who is also a hands-on social media expert. You will

own our marketing strategy, build our brand across social media from the ground up, and run our social

channels directly. As our team grows, you will lead our channel specialists. You will report directly to our

founder and work as a trusted partner in growing the business.



You will run Instagram,
, TikTok, Threads, and new platforms as we add them, plus YouTube

until our YouTube expert joins. Our LinkedIn Expert and Newsletter Growth Manager own LinkedIn and

 marketing, and you will lead them so every channel works as one brand.



We do not want AI produced content or AI generated strategy. We are hiring your expertise, your creative

judgment, and your proven ability to take a brand new business and make it thrive across social media.



This is a ground floor opportunity for someone who wants to build something meaningful and grow with

us for the long term. As the company grows, so will this role and the team you lead.





CANDIDATES WHO HEAR FROM OUR TEAM

Complete a full application.  Details are found in the HOW TO APPLY section.





WHAT YOU WILL DO



● Build and own our marketing strategy, including brand positioning, audience research, content pillars,

and a clear plan and KPIs for every channel.

● Run our social channels directly: plan the content calendar, write hooks and captions, publish, and

manage community engagement every day.

● Shape a native strategy for each platform: short form video built for YouTube Shorts and TikTok, a

distinct Instagram approach built on carousels, Stories, and community moments rather than reposted

videos, and a growing, monetized
 presence.

● Read platform analytics and algorithm signals, including reach, retention, watch time, saves, shares,

and click through rate, and turn them into smarter content decisions.

● Drive results beyond followers: use UTM tracking and clear calls to action to turn social attention into

tour bookings, private tours, gift card sales, and newsletter sign ups.

● Build partnerships that expand our reach, including creator and influencer collaborations, user

generated content, and spotlights with our partner ice cream shops.

● Direct our video team with clear creative briefs, so every video has a purpose.

● Lead our LinkedIn Expert and Newsletter Growth Manager, help hire future specialists, and build the

workflows, SOPs, and brand standards for a growing department.

● Deliver one clear weekly report across all channels, with results, insights, and next steps.



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



● 6+ years of hands-on marketing and social media management experience, with proven results backed

by real data and analytics.

● A track record of launching or growing a brand from the early stages across multiple social platforms.

● Deep, current knowledge of how each platform works: its audience, content formats, algorithm, and

what drives reach and engagement.

● Strong short form video instincts, including hooks, pacing, trends, and the first three seconds that stop

the scroll.

● Experience turning social media into measurable business results, not just likes and followers.

● Experience leading and developing marketing specialists, freelancers, or a team.

● Your own expertise, strategy, and creative ideas, not AI produced content or plans.

● A consistent track record of long term engagements with employers or clients, typically two years or

more.

● Works independently, communicates proactively, and follows through on every commitment.

● A positive, can do attitude, warmth with people, and a genuine love of teamwork and good vibes.

● Clear, confident, professional spoken and written English, and professionally presentable on video

calls.



Preferred: experience with paid social and Meta Ads Manager,
 
, and marketing

tourism, hospitality, food, events, or consumer brands.



This role is open to candidates in any country at the stated USD pay, as long as you meet every

requirement and can work during our US Central Time hours.



SCHEDULE & PAY



● 30 to 35 hours per week, Monday through Friday, fully remote

● Core hours 10 AM to 4 PM US Central Time, with some flexibility in hours and timing based on business needs

● Weekly team meeting, Tuesdays 2:00 PM to 3:30 PM US Central Time (required)

● Optional online team events, held at various times

● $6 to $9 per hour, plus potential bonus based on results

● Independent contractor

● Target start date: Friday, October 9 or Monday, October 12, 2026



GOOD VIBES ONLY COMPANY



We believe in good vibes, respect, value, appreciation, and fun as a company culture. We perform with

excellence and have a good time along the way.



HOW TO APPLY



We are hiring for the long term. If you are looking for a place to grow, lead, and do the best work of your career with a team that truly values you, we would love to hear from you.



Subject line: Write your own
 subject line. Make us want to open your
.



Cover letter (required): Two paragraphs, simple and to the point.



Paragraph 1, your personality. Tell us why Ice Cream Sunshine caught your eye and how you bring good vibes to the people and teams you work with.

Then add one or two sentences about the platforms where you are strongest and your experience leading a team.

The team at Ice Cream Sunshine wishes you joy always and delicious ice cream too. 🍦

title: Customer Success Manager
description:

Proactively identify potential operational issues and communicate solutions before they affect customers.

Use AI-powered tools to improve efficiency, streamline workflows, and support daily operations.

Logistics and E-commerce Fulfillment: Strong professional experience in logistics, order fulfillment, and warehouse operations.

Can confidently identify discrepancies and investigate their root causes.

List of fixes/adjustments made 



Open questions / items needing client decision

title: Short-Form Video Editor (Fashion Brand, Reels/TikTok/Paid Social)
description:
Easy Clothes USA is a fast-growing women's fashion brand based in Los Angeles. We sell online and are very active on Instagram, TikTok and paid social. We are looking for a truly exceptional short-form video editor to join our marketing team.



Please read this carefully. We are NOT looking for an average editor or someone doing this as a side gig. We want someone who lives and breathes short-form content, has real taste in fashion and visuals, and takes pride in every frame they deliver.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Edit vertical short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts

- Turn raw footage (collection launches, promotions, UGC, everyday content) into polished, scroll-stopping videos

- Create paid social ads focused on conversion: strong hooks, clear offers, clear calls to action

- Create organic content that feels natural and native to each platform

- Create variations of videos for testing (different hooks, lengths, angles)

- Work with our Head of Marketing and creative team on briefs and feedback



WHO YOU ARE

- 2+ years of professional short-form video editing experience

- A great eye for fashion, typography and visual style

- You understand the difference between organic content and paid ads, and you edit differently for each

- You know what makes a great hook and how to keep viewers watching

- You keep up with trends, sounds and formats on TikTok and Instagram

- Expert in Premiere Pro, CapCut, Final Cut or After Effects

- Fast, reliable, organized and great at taking feedback

- Good written English and a computer that can handle 4K footage



DETAILS

- Part time, 20 hours per week

- $550 USD per month

- Long-term role with room to grow as the brand grows

- Remote, with some overlap with US Pacific Time for meetings



HOW TO APPLY: EDITING EXERCISE REQUIRED

To apply, you must complete our editing exercise. Applications without it will not be reviewed.



DEADLINE: Monday, October 12, 2026



Download the raw footage here:





The folder contains raw footage for three scenarios. Create ONE vertical video for each (3 videos total):



1. COLLECTION LAUNCH

A video that introduces a new collection on Reels, TikTok or Shorts. Show us how you set the mood and identity of the collection, pick the strongest fashion moments, and handle pacing, music, text and transitions. Polished, but still native to social.



2. PAID SOCIAL AD

A conversion-focused ad for a sale/promotion. Show us your opening hook, how you communicate the offer, product visibility, on-screen text and call to action, while still feeling like a fashion brand. We want to see how your approach changes when the goal is sales instead of storytelling.



3. EVERYDAY UGC CONTENT

The footage here is casual and less produced. Turn it into an engaging, natural, social-first video we could post between bigger launches.



You do not need to use all the footage. Choosing the best moments is part of the test. There is no required length, song, font or style. We want to see your own creative instincts. Don't make it complex just to show off. We care about whether your choices make sense for the goal of each video.



For each video, add a few sentences or bullet points covering:

- Intended platform and use

- Creative objective

- Your editing approach and why you made those choices

- Other variations you would test if editing for us regularly



HOW TO SUBMIT

1. Create a Google Drive folder with your 3 videos and your notes

2. Set sharing to "Anyone with the link can view" (we will not request access, so if we can't open it, we can't review it)

3. Send us the folder link through your OnlineJobs application with:

   - The words "FASHION EDITOR" at the start of your message

   - A link to your portfolio

   - Your weekly availability and the software you use



All submissions must be received by Monday, October 12, 2026.



WHAT WE LOOK FOR

Creative judgment, editing quality, fashion and visual sense, finding strong moments in raw footage, pacing and storytelling, hooks and retention, typography, clear product and offer messaging, and overall fit with the Easy Clothes brand.



Your submitted videos are used for internal evaluation only and will not be published or used commercially without a separate agreement.



We can't wait to see your work!

title: Appointment Setter Who Books (Not Logs) | US Accounting Firm | Tue–Fri 10am–2pm Mountain | Performance Pay
description:
This is a booking job, not a calling job. We count dials, but we pay for meetings that show. If you’re the setter who gets more yeses than the people around you and you’re tired of a flat hourly that pays the same whether you book or not, read on. If you want a quiet shift leaving voi
s, this isn’t it.



About us - Powers Advisory is a US accounting firm doing bookkeeping, job costing and taxes for construction contractors across the United States. The owner, Parker, is a hands-on founder who answers his own phone. You would be the first voice our prospects hear, and the reason they get on his calendar.



The Job - Call US contractor owners from a list we build for you (name, company, trade, city, phone, licensed for years, so these are real businesses). Short conversational script, you make it your own after week one. Your one goal on every call: get the owner to say yes to a free 20-minute “Books Diagnostic” kickoff, and book it live on the founder’s Calendly while they’re still on the phone. You don’t quote prices beyond one sentence we give you, and you don’t need to: the offer is free and good, your job is to make the owner want it in 40 seconds. Every dial logged in a shared Google Sheet, one-line summary at the end of each shift.



The numbers we expect - 100 dials per 4-hour shift. 15 to 20 real owner conversations. 2 booked per shift once you’re warmed up. We review recordings weekly and we’ll tell you exactly where calls are being lost. Setters who hit the numbers get more hours and a raise at 90 days. Setters who don’t after 30 days are replaced. We’d rather say that here than surprise you.



Hours - Part-time, 16 hours a week: Tuesday through Friday, 4 hours a day, 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM US Mountain Time. In Manila, that is 12:00 midnight to 4:00 AM (1:00 to 5:00 AM from November through March). This is a fixed overnight block; please apply only if you can work it every week, long term.



Pay - $7 to $10 USD per hour base depending on experience, plus $15 for every booked meeting that shows up, plus $100 extra any month you hit 20 shows. A setter doing 10 shows a week clears roughly $1,200 to $1,400 a month at 16 hours a week. Paid weekly via Wise. Paid 10-call trial first ($20), then 30 days, then ongoing.



Requirements - 

Fluent, clear, easily understood spoken English with a neutral accent. Our customers are US tradespeople on noisy job sites; they must understand you the first time, every time. The voice memo below tests this and nothing else gets you past it.

At least one year of US outbound phone work with real booking or sales numbers you can state: appointment setting, telemarketing, or phone sales. Chat or
 support does not count.

Comfortable with blue-collar business owners. Direct, warm, quick on your feet. You hear “we already have a bookkeeper” and you have a next sentence.

Quiet workspace, stable internet, headset, on time every shift.

Google Sheets and Calendly (we train the specifics).



How to apply (all four, or you’re skipped) - 

1. Most recently updated resume.

2. Your numbers from your last US phone role: what you were booking or selling, dials per day, bookings or sales per week, and how long you held the job.

3. A 30 to 45 second voice memo reading this naturally, as if on a real call:

“Hi, is this Mike? This is Sam calling for Powers Advisory. Quick one, I know you’re busy. We do books, job costing, and business taxes for contractors like yours, one flat fee starting at $599 a month, taxes included. Right now we're offering a free 48-hour books diagnostic. Is knowing your real margin by job something you’d want to see?”

4. In the same memo, without stopping, answer this objection in your own words: “Yeah, we’ve got a bookkeeper already.”



**Put the word DIAGNOSTIC in the first line of your application so we know you read this far.

## Preferred Experience
