title: Assistant Content Project Manager – Video Editing & Social Media Content
description:
Company: Talent Tribe Media 

Work Setup: Remote / Work From Home

Employment Type: Part-Time During Probation, with Potential for Full-Time Employment

Work Hours: TBD 

Salary: TBD 



About the Role

Talent Tribe is looking for a creative, detail-oriented, and proactive Assistant Content Project Manager with a strong understanding of video storytelling, content strategy, and social media content creation.

The ideal candidate has previous experience as a video editor, content creator, or social media content specialist and understands what makes a video engaging, informative, and effective.



This role goes beyond writing instructions for editors. You must be able to develop creative video concepts, communicate ideas clearly, and turn basic business information and promotions into compelling content that captures attention and drives action.

You will work closely with our Project Manager and video editors to develop content projects, provide clear editing instructions, review video quality, and create videos based on your own concepts.



We are looking for someone who understands both the creative and technical sides of video content. You should know how to plan a video, write a strong hook, structure a compelling story, and guide editors toward producing high-quality results.



Key Responsibilities

1. Content Planning and Project Instructions

- Develop 3–4 new video projects per day based on the business information, services, and promotional details provided.

- Write clear and actionable video briefs for editors, including:

- Video concept and objective

- Opening hook to capture attention

- Key messages and talking points

- Video structure and storytelling direction

- Suggested visuals, footage, and editing style

- On-screen text, captions, and transitions

- Call to action (CTA)

-Turn basic information into creative, informative, and engaging video concepts suitable for social media platforms.



2. Video Editing and Content Creation

- Create and edit videos based on your own project concepts and written instructions.

- Demonstrate an understanding of pacing, storytelling, visual flow, audience engagement, and effective messaging.

- Ensure videos communicate the intended message while maintaining a professional standard of quality.

- Use your video editing experience to develop practical instructions that editors can easily follow.



3. Project Adjustments and Editor Support

- Make minor adjustments to 2–3 existing projects per day to help editors stay on schedule and improve video quality.

- Clarify project instructions and provide constructive feedback when needed.

- Help editors understand the intended creative direction and make sure their work aligns with the project brief.



4. Quality Control and Project Management Support

- Assist the Project Manager in reviewing completed and ongoing video projects.

- Check whether videos follow the instructions, communicate the key message, and meet quality standards.

- Identify areas for improvement in storytelling, editing, pacing, clarity, and audience engagement.

- Help maintain an organized workflow and ensure projects move forward efficiently.



Probation Period and Workload

During the probation period, you will work up to 4 hours per day, unless additional hours are needed and approved based on workload and business needs.



Our general expectations are:

- Content planning and editing instructions: Approximately 1–2 hours maximum per project.

- New projects: 3–4 video projects per day.

- Project adjustments: Minor revisions to 2–3 existing projects per day.

- Video creation: Produce sample videos based on your own concepts and written briefs.

- Efficiency is important. You should be able to develop clear, detailed, and actionable instructions without spending excessive time on each project.



Your primary focus will be content planning, project instructions, video creation, and quality control. Other administrative or support tasks will be secondary and should be handled after the main content responsibilities are completed.

Additional hours may be assigned when necessary, subject to approval.



Qualifications and Requirements: 

We are looking for someone who has:

1. Previous experience as a video editor, content creator, or social media content specialist.

2.A strong understanding of short-form video content for platforms such as
, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube.

3.Knowledge of video storytelling, audience retention, pacing, hooks, and calls to action.

4. The ability to turn basic business information into creative and engaging video concepts.

5. Strong writing skills and the ability to communicate editing instructions clearly.

5. An understanding of video editing techniques, visual storytelling, transitions, captions, and sound design.

6. Good attention to detail and the ability to review content objectively.

7. Strong organizational and time-management skills.

8. The ability to work independently, follow deadlines, and manage multiple projects.

9. Clear written communication skills and the ability to collaborate with editors and a Project Manager.



Bonus qualifications:

1. Experience managing video editors or coordinating content production.

2. Experience creating content for businesses, brands, or digital marketing agencies.

3. Familiarity with content calendars, project management tools, and AI-assisted content workflows.

4. A portfolio demonstrating strong video editing and content creation skills.



Skills We Value Most

We are not simply looking for someone who can write a video brief. We need someone who understands why a video works.

You should be able to answer questions such as:

- What makes someone stop scrolling?

- How do you communicate a business's message within a short video?

- How should a video be structured to maintain audience interest?

- What visuals, pacing, and editing techniques will make the content more effective?

- How can you give editors instructions that are clear enough to produce the intended result?

- We value creativity, practical thinking, efficiency, and the ability to turn ideas into finished content.



Skills Assessment

As part of our hiring process, candidates may be asked to complete a practical content creation test.



We will provide basic business information and promotional details. You will be expected to:



1. Develop a video concept from the information provided.

2. Write a detailed editing brief with a hook, key messages, video structure, and CTA.

3. Create and edit a video based on your concept and instructions.

4. Demonstrate how effectively you can turn the original information into clear, engaging, and informative content.

This assessment will help us evaluate your content planning, writing, creative thinking, and video editing abilities.

5. Candidates who demonstrate strong performance may be considered for a full-time position.



Compensation and Growth Opportunities

Compensation will be discussed based on experience, skills, and the results of the hiring assessment.

This position offers an opportunity to grow into a full-time role for someone who can consistently deliver quality content projects, support editors effectively, and contribute to improving our content production workflow.



How to Apply

If you believe you are the right fit, please submit the following: IMPORTANT 



1. Your updated resume.

2. A portfolio containing at least 2–3 videos you have created or edited.

3. A brief explanation of your experience with video editing, content creation, or content project management.

4.  The video editing software and project management tools you are familiar with.

5.Your expected hourly rate and availability.



Please include the phrase “CONTENT PROJECT PRO” in your application so we know you have read the full job posting.

We look forward to finding someone who can combine creative storytelling, strong content planning, and practical video editing skills to help our team produce better content efficiently.

title: Sales & Partnerships Manager
description:
ABOUT US



Ice Cream Sunshine is a good vibes signature ice cream tour and special events company based in Chicago. People who join our tours have loads of fun as we explore Chicago neighborhoods, enjoy delicious ice cream treats at local businesses, and learn fun facts about ice cream and the city. Guests smile, mingle, laugh, and enjoy America’s #1 dessert. Good vibes are the core of who we are, and that extends to every person on our team.



THE ROLE



We are looking for a proven, full-cycle B2B closer to grow our private tour and group sales. You will find new clients, build lasting relationships, and book private tours from the first conversation to the confirmed booking. You will work directly with our founder as a true partner in building our sales plan and generating income for the business.



Sales always comes first. You will also support projects across the company as needed.



Partnerships in this role means the relationships that bring in bookings and run our tours. Sponsorships are handled separately and are not part of this role.





CANDIDATES WHO HEAR FROM OUR TEAM

Complete a full application.  Details are found in the HOW TO APPLY section.





WHAT YOU WILL DO



● Run the full sales cycle with corporate teams, wedding planners, hotels, convention planners, and alumni groups, from first outreach to booked tour.

● Make outbound calls and send outreach every day to build a strong, healthy pipeline.

● Grow accounts over time, so one great contact leads to repeat bookings and referrals across departments, couples, and groups.

● Manage relationships with our tour partner shops and our referral partners.

● Track every lead, conversation, and deal in our CRM, and report on results weekly.

● Partner with our founder on the sales plan, and support company projects as needed.



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



● 8+ years of US B2B sales experience with increasing revenue responsibility.

● A proven full-cycle closer with provable results and references from employers, clients, and customers.

● A consistent track record of long-term engagements with employers or clients, typically two years or more.

● Expert at building long-term relationships, growing a book of business, and creating reliable, recurring revenue from repeat clients and referrals.

● Strong pipeline management, consistent follow-up, and a solid post-sale process that turns happy clients into referrals.

● Clear, confident, professional spoken and written English, and professionally presentable on video calls.



Preferred: experience in tourism, hospitality, or events.

● Weekly team meeting, Tuesdays 2:00 PM to 3:30 PM US Central Time (required).

● Independent contractor.

GOOD VIBES ONLY COMPANY



We believe in good vibes, respect, value, appreciation and fun as a company culture. We perform with excellence and have a good time along the way.

Subject line: Write your own
 subject line. Make us want to open your
.

title: Head of Marketing — Paid Media, Retention & Ecommerce
description:
A profitable, growing US-based specialty tea CPG brand (~15% YoY, 130K+ lifetime orders, warehouses in the US, Canada, UK, and EU) selling primarily through Shopify and TikTok Shop, built on authentic sourcing, education, and a founder-creator with millions of followers who is, today, the company's entire marketing engine. The brand ships frequent new product lines (two launches in the next four months alone) and runs a quarterly subscription program (~2,000 members) that is the growth core. The founder built the entire business on organic content and the company has never run paid ads. Marketing today is a set of good ideas with no owner:
, loyalty, referrals, collabs, community, contests. Your job is to become that owner, and to build the machine around the founder's audience instead of depending on it.

One thing to know before you apply: nothing customer-facing here is AI-generated. All creative is real and hand-made. That is the brand's identity, not a policy. See "How this company uses AI" below; it will d
 whether this role is for you.



The role

You own marketing end to end. This is a content-led brand: high-quality entertainment and infotainment IS the acquisition engine, and everything you do in paid,
, and lifecycle has to interact coherently with the organic machine, not run beside it. You understand how paid and organic feed each other and you manage brand awareness as one system.

The mandate runs in a deliberate order. First, find the leaks and build the scoreboard: subscription drop-off, paused members, one-time buyers, and the KPI system to see it all. Second, stand up paid media and get the
 and lifecycle machine performing. Third, once the fundamentals run, expand into organic collaboration: creator collabs, bigger content plays, deeper integration with the founder's production. The wrong hire walks in asking for a big ad budget. The right hire walks in asking where the money is leaking and what the data says.

You are a player-coach, weighted toward player early. You personally run media strategy and media buying (today's AI-powered buying tools make this a one-person job at this scale) until the marketing arm grows enough to justify dedicated hands, at which point you help define that hire. The
 specialist reports to you and executes
 and lifecycle operations under your direction. You'll also coordinate with the rest of the small team around marketing: a Shopify/ecommerce operations person and the founder's YouTube account manager.

On creative: you are close to a creative director who never creates. The founder is the creator. He likes performing, he WANTS to make ads, and he already has some in production. Your job is to make that enthusiasm strategic and intentional: understand the brand's edges and preferences deeply enough to direct
, paid media, and collab work cohesively without ever violating the ethos, and to tell him exactly what the data says he should make next. He will make you one great ad at a time, not fifteen mediocre ones.

This is not a strategy-deck job. You make tactical judgment calls on messaging, audiences, offers, and budget the same day they come up, and you push initiatives to done. The unofficial title is "the person who makes marketing ideas stop dying in the parking lot."



What you'll do

Find the leaks and build the scoreboard

Diagnose subscription drop-off: who leaves, when (the drop after box two and three is the known weak point), and why

Quantify how much meat is on the bone: lapsed members, paused subscriptions, one-time buyers who never subscribed,
 list segments that never converted



Think in the levers that multiply the business: LTV, AOV, CAC, churn, and net-new customers. When the data to see a lever doesn't exist, you fix the measurement system so it does

Run the win-back loop for paused and lapsed members, working with the internal AI survey systems that surface why people pause



Run paid media yourself

Launch paid ads from zero (Meta first, TikTok second) with an intro test budget, personally owning media strategy and buying with modern AI-powered tools



Approach ads from first principles: early paid is a learning instrument. Breaking even early on is a perfectly good outcome; the bar is don't bleed money while collecting the data that verifies hunches and shapes the growth plan, then refine and iterate from there



Run the full range deliberately: put cash behind organic content that's already working, test odd angles, and run boring direct-response ads. You have to be comfortable with both the weird and the boring

Build the creative testing plan around the founder's content and the ads he has in production; brief him on what to make next based on what the data says



Own holiday-season ad buying (Oct through Feb is the season)

Earn the budget: scale spend only as unit economics prove out, and be the person telling the founder when NOT to spend



Own
, lifecycle, and loyalty

Set strategy for and manage the
 specialist, who executes
 and lifecycle operations under your direction

Evolve loyalty into a VIP program and fold the referral program into its tiers

Multiply LTV and AOV: bundles, premium tiers, subscription upgrades, win-backs

Expand the organic machine (stage two, after the fundamentals run)



Lead creator collab strategy, including YouTube collaborations: you set the strategy and direct it, with outreach and legwork resources added as the workload materializes

Surface-manage the content production workflow (the founder has a YouTube account manager) enough to keep it moving and connected to the rest of marketing

Deepen the paid-organic loop as both sides mature



Run the machine

Build the marketing calendar and own cross-channel coordination across Shopify and TikTok Shop: a constant new-product launch cadence (next two launches already scheduled for mid-September and November) and the holiday season

Direct the founder's creative production: batched, specific asks with clear briefs, on his rhythm

Run the AI marketing stack for analytics and orchestration, and teach: make sure the whole team understands what the numbers say and why



Be our eyes and ears on the marketing org: as channels prove out, you define the next roles the team needs and help us scope them



Who survives here

The founder runs this company as a creator and an artist. He will not work 70-hour weeks, he will not sit in frequent syncs, and he does not want to be managed hard. There are standing weekly team calls and brand-alignment checks; beyond that, you get batched, well-prepared asks and a lot of autonomy.

The person who thrives: a first-principles thinker who asks "what are the alternatives" and comes at problems from angles, cares deeply about brand ethos and being genuine, and is flexible and adaptable when the picture changes. Low ego, systems-builder, gets energy from ownership rather than access, treats the founder as a scarce production resource and designs the work around that constraint. A sense of humor is close to required: the brand runs on it. The person who fails: needs frequent alignment meetings, wants to "workshop the vision" repeatedly, bulldozes the founder's constraints in the name of growth, or is too proud to run boring ads.



How this company uses AI

The company runs a deliberate split: aggressive AI adoption in operations, a hard wall around anything creative or customer-facing. This role sits exactly on that line and has to hold it.



The wall (creative side)

- Nothing customer-facing is AI-generated. No AI images ever, no AI-written copy shipped as-is. This is brand identity, not a preference: the entire premise of the brand is that everything is real. Real sourcing trips, real photos, real people.

- The standard is cultural, not just a rule. Real example: product photos came back with dust on them right before a launch, the founder was unreachable, and the team spent hours manually retouching the dust out rather than AI-recreating the images, because they knew that is what he would want. That instinct is the hiring bar.

- AI-assisted drafting is tolerated only when the shipped output is written by hand or aggressively reviewed by hand. AI passing as human is the sin. A previous team member put an obviously AI-generated image into an internal test
; it never shipped and it was still treated as a serious culture violation.



The embrace (operations side)

- The company builds internal AI agents aggressively: live inventory and logistics answers for the CS team, a demand-prediction model for new products, and a customer survey loop that maps the customer journey.

- The founder's stated goal is a middle road: full transparency with the team about how AI is used, so nobody feels they are training their replacement, and AI kept as far from the creative side as possible.



What this means for you

- You manage the AI marketing setup: agent-driven ad analytics and orchestration (think "this ad is overperforming in one region, redivert budget"), AI-powered media buying, research, segmentation, reporting, workflow. Analytics and orchestration, yes. Generating ads, images, or copy that ships, no.

- You are also the translator: part of the job is making sure everyone on the team understands what the AI spend analytics say and why, in plain language.

- The founder believes AI slop is destroying trust in faceless content and low-tier influencer marketing, and that this brand's realness becomes MORE valuable as that happens. He has watched an agency lose his business by sending an unchecked AI-generated proposal. Pitching AI-generated creator content or mass AI outreach in your interview ends the interview.





What you've done before

- 6+ years across multiple marketing channels with your own hands: paid social,
/retention, loyalty or referral programs, influencer or community marketing

- Hands-on media strategy and media buying: you have personally planned, bought, and optimized paid media, not just supervised an agency doing it

- Food and beverage CPG experience is required: you have marketed a consumable product people buy repeatedly, and you understand replenishment cycles, taste-driven loyalty, and launch cadence

- Subscription experience is required: you have managed a subscription service and its retention economics, not just one-time - - DTC

- DTC ecommerce experience; Shopify fluency expected, TikTok Shop experience a strong plus

- Startup or small-team environments: you have been the whole marketing department before, comfortable with scrappiness and wearing every hat, not corporate structure and big budgets

- You understand content-led brands: experience running or working inside media/content production is a real asset, because here the content IS the marketing

- Ran frequent product launches end to end as the project manager, not just the channel owner; this brand ships new lines constantly and the calendar never stops

- Managed at least a small team or agency relationships; comfortable being the strategy layer for an executor

- Worked directly with a founder or creative director and can tell us how you adapted to them

- Comfortable managing AI agents and tools in your workflow; clear-eyed about where AI belongs and where it does not

- You should genuinely enjoy the product. Tea, tea culture, or Chinese culture as a real personal interest is close to a requirement here: this team lives the product, and it shows in the work. Comedic sensibility is a plus, since the founder's content runs on humor

title: Cold Caller Trainer | Process Trainer | BDR Trainer | New Hire Trainer | Onboarding Specialist
description:
About StoryGen

StoryGen (storygen.agency) is a growing B2B lead generation agency specializing in outbound sales and appointment setting. We help businesses build stronger sales pipelines by developing and managing dedicated Business Development Representative (BDR) teams.



Cold calling is central to our operations, and we combine proven sales techniques with structured workflows, modern technology, automation, and AI-powered tools to drive results.

As our team continues to expand, we're focused on building a training program that helps BDRs develop the skills, confidence, and consistency needed to succeed.



About the Role

We're hiring a BDR Trainer / Cold Caller Trainer to lead new-hire training, support BDR development, and improve overall calling performance.



In this role, you'll guide new team members through onboarding, introduce them to our sales processes and tools, and prepare them to handle real conversations with business decision-makers.



Your responsibilities will extend beyond initial training. You'll evaluate recorded calls, deliver constructive feedback, identify opportunities for improvement, and provide ongoing coaching to help BDRs strengthen their performance.



You'll also collaborate with Account Managers and leadership to refine training resources, improve coaching methods, and build repeatable processes that support a growing remote sales team.



Your impact will be measured through new-hire readiness, faster ramp-up times, improved call quality, stronger process adherence, and consistent BDR performance.



We're open to applicants with different professional backgrounds. While previous sales training experience is an advantage, we also welcome individuals who have demonstrated leadership, mentoring, coaching, or facilitation skills through work experience, internships, academic organizations, or other activities.



Key Responsibilities

1. BDR Onboarding & Training

- Facilitate onboarding sessions and structured training programs for newly hired BDRs.

- Train team members on cold calling techniques, sales scripts, prospect qualification, objection handling, and effective conversation flow.

- Familiarize new hires with the sales platforms, tools, and daily workflows used across campaigns.

- Communicate performance expectations, activity targets, KPIs, and call quality standards.

- Monitor training progress, provide timely feedback, and address learning gaps.

- Assess each BDR's readiness before transitioning into independent campaign execution.



2. Call Reviews & Performance Coaching

- Listen to recorded sales calls and evaluate communication effectiveness, script delivery, and overall call execution.

- Provide practical coaching on confidence, tone, active listening, objection handling, and prospect engagement.

- Help BDRs develop natural conversations rather than relying solely on scripted responses.

- Recognize recurring performance issues and implement targeted improvement plans.

- Offer additional coaching and guidance to BDRs who need support meeting performance expectations.

- Encourage consistent execution of proven calling techniques and quality standards.



3. Training Resources & Documentation

- Develop, organize, and regularly update training guides, onboarding materials, and internal learning resources.

- Create call frameworks, objection-handling references, coaching templates, and practical sales playbooks.

- Maintain up-to-date script libraries and training documentation.

- Document effective sales techniques and incorporate them into future training sessions.

- Revise learning materials to reflect changes in company processes, technology, and outbound strategies.

- Build structured resources that make training more consistent and easier to scale.



4. Sales Enablement & Continuous Improvement

- Coordinate with Account Managers and leadership to identify training priorities and performance challenges.

- Analyze common skill gaps and recommend coaching initiatives to address them.

- Support the adoption of AI-powered call analysis, training, and coaching tools.

- Gather feedback and use performance insights to continuously improve the training program.

- Help establish standardized training practices as the BDR team grows.



Qualifications & Skills

We're interested in candidates who enjoy developing people, communicating ideas clearly, and helping others improve their performance.



Previous experience as a professional trainer is not required. Recent graduates and early-career professionals are encouraged to apply if they can demonstrate relevant skills through previous employment, internships, student leadership, volunteer work, or extracurricular activities.



What We're Looking For

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

- Ability to explain concepts clearly and confidently.Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

- Experience coaching, mentoring, training, or guiding others

- Strong leadership skills, whether formal or informal

- Confident and clear communicator

- The ability to give clear, constructive, and actionable feedback

- A structured and organized approach to training

- A collaborative, team-oriented mindset

- Strong attention to performance and measurable improvement

- Good documentation and training-content creation skills

- A positive and motivating presence while maintaining high standards and accountability



How to Apply

Join us in developing high-performing BDRs and building a training program that supports long-term team success.

People who join our tours have loads of fun as we explore Chicago neighborhoods, enjoy delicious ice cream treats at local businesses, and learn fun facts about ice cream and the city. Guests smile, mingle, laugh, and enjoy America’s #1 dessert. Good vibes are the core of who we are, and that extends to every person on our team.



THE ROLE



We are looking for a seasoned
 marketing professional to grow and monetize our newsletters. You will own growth, engagement, and revenue for two newsletters on Beehiiv: our global ice cream newsletter and a newsletter for our online community, which you will help launch. A hyper-local Chicago newsletter is planned for Q1 2027.



The metrics in this role are rigorous. You will own list growth, open rates, click-through rates, and newsletter revenue, and you will always have a plan to improve them. You will report to our Marketing Manager.





CANDIDATES WHO HEAR FROM OUR TEAM

Complete a full application.  Details are found in the HOW TO APPLY section.





WHAT YOU WILL DO



● Own the strategy, content calendar, and send cadence for each newsletter.

● Write, design, and send issues readers genuinely look forward to opening.

● Grow subscribers through referral programs, lead magnets, cross-promotions, recommendation networks, and converting our tour guests and social media followers.

● Protect deliverability and list health through authentication, list hygiene, and re-engagement campaigns.

● Build welcome sequences and automations, and use segmentation and A/B testing on subject lines, send times, and content to keep improving results.

● Generate revenue through our own products and services, affiliate partnerships, brand placements and sponsorships, and paid subscription tiers.

● Launch and grow our online community newsletter, and help build our hyper-local Chicago newsletter in Q1 2027.

● Track results and report weekly with clear insights and next steps.



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



● 5+ years of proven
 marketing and newsletter expertise, with results you can show.

title: Data Developer - 6 months Fixed Term Contract
description:
***PLEASE READ ON HOW TO APPLY***



Job Title: Data Developer  - 6 months Fixed Term Contract

Location: Remote | Philippines based ONLY

Salary Range: Php 190,000 per month

A MUST: Minimum of 5 years of solid experience



Data Engineer – Snowflake / Python / PySpark 



About the Role

We're looking for a Data Engineer to join our data team and own the ingestion, pipelines,

and infrastructure that get raw data reliably into our warehouse and ready for use. This role

is primarily focused on building and maintaining the data pipeline layer - ingesting data from

source systems, orchestrating workflows, and ensuring data lands in Snowflake accurately,

on time, and at scale.



What You'll Do

● Design, build, and own end-to-end data pipelines that ingest data from a wide range

of source systems (databases, APIs, event streams, third-party files) into our data

warehouse

● Build and maintain reliable ingestion frameworks that handle batch and/or streaming

data at scale

● Use Python and PySpark to build scalable extraction and processing jobs, including

large-scale/distributed data processing

● Build, schedule, and monitor pipelines using an orchestration tool, including

dependency management, retries, alerting, and SLAs

● Write efficient, production-grade SQL for data transformation, validation, and

troubleshooting across the pipeline

● Maintain dbt models where needed to support standardized, tested transformations

downstream of ingestion

● Implement data quality checks, monitoring, and alerting to catch pipeline failures and

data issues before they hit downstream consumers

● Partner with Product owners, data analysts, and software engineers to understand

upstream source systems and downstream data needs

● Contribute to data infrastructure and architecture decisions (e.g., ingestion patterns,

storage layout, orchestration strategy)

● Maintain clear documentation of pipeline architecture & data lineage



What We're Looking For

● Proven experience building and maintaining production data pipelines end-to-end,

from ingestion through delivery

● 5+ years of hands-on experience working with Snowflake (or a similar cloud data

warehouse) in a production environment

● Strong proficiency in Python for building ingestion jobs, automation, and data

processing

● Experience with PySpark for distributed data processing at scale

● Hands-on experience with a workflow orchestration tool (e.g., Apache Airflow,

Dagster, Prefect, or similar) for scheduling and monitoring pipelines

● Strong SQL skills for data transformation, debugging, and validation

● Working knowledge of dbt for downstream transformation and testing

● Experience integrating with diverse data sources (relational databases, REST APIs,

event/streaming systems, flat files)

● Understanding of data pipeline reliability practices: retries, idempotency, monitoring,

and alerting

● Comfort working in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities

● Strong communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally with analytics,

engineering, and business stakeholders



Nice to Have

● Experience with streaming/event-based ingestion (Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub, or

similar)

● Experience with CI/CD for data pipelines

● Experience with version control (Git) and code review workflows

● Background in a cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure)

● Experience working in an agile data team environment



***PLEASE READ ON HOW TO APPLY***



How to Apply:

To apply for this role, please submit a link to your resume and a brief Loom video (max 2 minutes) introducing yourself and highlighting your skills relevant to the role. In your video, please address the following:

- A short introduction of yourself and why you're interested in this role.

- Your current and previous experience as a Data Engineer and specific experience with Snowflake / Python / PySpark

- Key skills or qualifications that make you a strong fit for this position.



Please note: Applications without a video will not be reviewed. We look forward to welcoming a passionate developer who prioritizes clean code, performance optimization, and delivering exceptional user experiences.

title: Podcast Video Editor | XP Strategy
description:
ABOUT US

XP Strategy runs Amazon and marketplace advertising for seven- and eight-figure sellers in the US and internationally. As an Amazon Ads Verified Partner, we help brands grow across Amazon, Walmart, Target, and TikTok. The team is small, senior, and fully distributed, and we are growing.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Our founder has started recording a video podcast about Amazon, ecommerce, AI, and building a business. We need an editor who can take a raw multicam studio recording and turn it into a polished long-form episode plus a full set of short clips. The work is paid per episode, and the editor who does great work gets every episode.



WHAT YOU'LL RECEIVE

- 4 camera angles (1080p, 24fps), each as its own file

- A separate studio audio track

- The studio's DaVinci Resolve project file

- About 1.5 to 2 hours of conversation per episode, 50 GB or more of files



WHAT YOU'LL DELIVER

- One clean long-form episode: smooth switches between camera angles, filler words, long pauses, false starts and off-topic stretches removed, balanced audio, and a clean open and close

- Tighter answers. Our founder tends to talk at length, so trimming long answers to their strongest version without losing the point is a big part of this job

- A full set of vertical clips for Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts, each with a strong hook in the first few seconds and burned-in captions checked against the audio

- Clips organized by topic (for example AI, Amazon PPC, the founder's story, and lighter conversation) with clear file names and a short list of each clip's topic and suggested title

- A plus: a thumbnail and title ideas for the full episode



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- YOU HAVE EDITED FULL-LENGTH PODCAST OR INTERVIEW EPISODES, NOT ONLY SHORT CLIPS. The form asks for a link to a full episode you edited.

- Multicam editing in DaVinci Resolve, Premiere Pro, or Final Cut Pro

- You can find the moments worth clipping on your own, without a shot-by-shot brief

- Clean, accurate captions and good written English

- A computer that can handle a 4-camera 1080p timeline, and internet fast enough to download a full episode's files without a long wait

- Reliable turnaround and clear communication through Slack and ClickUp

- Experience with business, ecommerce, Amazon, or marketing content is a plus



WORKING TERMS

- Fully remote, async work

- Paid per episode. In the form, tell us what you would charge for one 2-hour episode: the full long-form edit plus around 15 short clips

- Ongoing work as we keep recording

- Some overlap with US Eastern business hours for feedback rounds

- Shortlisted applicants do a small paid test edit from a real recording

Read this post fully, then complete our short application form. It takes about 5 minutes and includes a 2-minute video intro.

title: Phone Sales Rep for US Junk Removal Company: Book Us a Meeting and the Job Is Yours
description:
Dirty South Junk Removal is a local, veteran-owned junk removal company in Middle Tennessee, USA. We’re hiring one person whose entire job is the phone. Not admin work. Not social media. Not
. The phone.



You’ll answer every call that comes in. When the phone isn’t ringing, you’re dialing out. That’s the job, all day, every day.



What you’ll actually do



Inbound (answering calls):



Answer incoming calls fast and friendly, because every call is a potential job

Ask the right questions: what items, how much, where, how soon

Give quotes using our pricing guide

Book the job on the calendar and confirm the details

Log everything in our CRM



Outbound (making calls):



Follow up with leads who called but didn’t book

Call back old customers and past quotes

Confirm tomorrow’s appointments

Follow up on estimates that are still open

Call property managers, realtors, and apartment complexes to book meetings with our owner, Trey



Schedule



Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Central Time (Middle Tennessee, USA)

This is a graveyard shift in the Philippines. You must be able to work it consistently. Do not apply if you can’t.

Weekends off



What we require



Clear, confident, neutral American-sounding English. Customers must understand you easily.

Real phone experience: BPO, call center, appointment setting, or cold calling

You’re comfortable making 50–100+ outbound calls a day and don’t get discouraged by rejection

Stable internet: minimum 15 Mbps, hardwired preferred

Backup internet AND backup power (generator, UPS, or a secondary location). We cannot have the phone go dead.

A quiet work area with a good headset

You show up on time, every day, without being reminded



Nice to have (not required)



Experience with home services (junk removal, moving, cleaning, landscaping, HVAC, roofing)

Familiarity with CRMs, Google Voice, Housecall Pro, or similar dialers

Sales instinct: you can turn a price-shopper into a booked job



Pay



$350 – $520 USD/month depending on experience

5%  commission if the meeting you book to get hired turns into a paying job

Performance bonuses for booked jobs once you’re up to speed

Raises based on results, reviewed at 90 days

Paid training during your first week



HOW TO GET THIS JOB: READ CAREFULLY



We don’t hire based on resumes. We hire people who can actually book meetings on the phone. So your application is a real call.



The challenge



Find an apartment community or property management company in Middle Tennessee, USA (Nashville, Murfreesboro, Franklin, Clarksville, Smyrna, Lebanon, Gallatin, Hendersonville, and nearby). Google Maps works fine.

Call them using the script below.

Book a 10–15 minute meeting for our owner, Trey, to stop by the property. Meetings can be booked any day Monday through Friday, during business hours Central Time.



Book a meeting and you’re hired. If that meeting turns into a paying job, you also earn commission on it.



Once you book a meeting, send me a message with:



The word “DUMPSTER” at the very start so I know you read the whole post

Property name, address, and phone number

The name, title, and
 of the person you spoke to

The meeting day and time you booked

2–3 sentences about your phone experience (inbound, outbound, or both, and what kind of business)

Your internet speed, and confirmation that you have backup internet and backup power

Confirmation that you can work 8 AM – 5 PM Central Time, Monday through Friday



We’ll confirm every meeting with the property directly. Fake or made-up meetings = instant disqualification.



Rules



Be polite and professional. You’re representing Dirty South Junk Removal.

If they say no, thank them and move on. Do not call the same property twice.

Only book meetings Monday through Friday. No weekends.



THE SCRIPT



Intro



“Hey, my name is [YOUR NAME]. I’m with Dirty South Junk Removal.



Listen, I know you guys probably already have somebody you use when bulk items start piling up: mattresses, couches, furniture, stuff people dump from off-property, things residents leave around the dumpster, or items left behind during apartment trash-outs.



Just out of curiosity, how often are you guys having to call your current vendor out to handle that stuff?”



[LET THEM ANSWER]



“Okay, awesome. So it sounds like it is something that comes up and you guys do need somebody for it.”



Why I’m calling



“We work with a lot of property managers throughout Middle Tennessee. And just so you know, we’re not calling trying to immediately replace your current vendor.



A lot of properties started using us simply because they needed another reliable option, especially when something needs to happen fast. Maybe ownership is coming to the property. Maybe there’s an inspection nobody knew about. Maybe you have units that need to turn ASAP. Or your normal vendor is just slammed and can’t meet your timeline.



That’s where we’ve been able to fill the gap.”



Price / value



“Another reason properties have started using us is cost. With some of the properties we work with, we’ve been able to save them around $500 a month compared with what they were previously spending on junk removal.



We’re a local, veteran-owned company, and we don’t have the massive overhead some of the larger companies have. So we can keep our operation profitable while passing a lot of those savings back to the properties we work with.”



Legal disposal



“We also have a solid-waste permit, so you know where your junk is actually going. It goes where it’s supposed to go, not dumped at somebody else’s apartment community.



You’ve probably seen guys who will haul away a mattress or couch unbelievably cheap. Sometimes there’s a reason they can do it that cheap. That couch gets picked up from your property and suddenly ends up beside somebody else’s compactor or in another property’s open-top dumpster.



We make sure everything we haul is properly disposed of.”



Ask for the meeting



“The owner, Trey, actually asked me to reach out. What we’d love to do is have him swing by sometime this week.



He’ll bring some goodies for the team, introduce himself, drop off some information, and take maybe 10–15 minutes to look around the property with you. He can see where your problem dumping areas are and get an idea of what you guys normally deal with.



He’s also helped properties reduce illegal dumping, not just clean it up after it happens. There are a few things he’s learned working with apartment communities that properties can do to discourage residents and outsiders from dumping in certain areas.



So even if you absolutely love your current vendor, it could still be worthwhile to meet Trey and have another local company in your back pocket.



What day works best for you this week, Monday through Friday? Is morning or afternoon better?”



[LET THEM ANSWER]



If yes



“Perfect. I’ll get that scheduled. What’s the best
 for the calendar invite?”



[GET
]



“Awesome. I’ll send that over so you have it on your calendar. We’ll also follow up either the day before or the morning of, just to remind you that Trey is swinging by. If anything changes before then, just let us know and we can always move it around.



Thank you so much. I hope you have a blessed day. Bye-bye!”



If they say: “We already have somebody.”



“Absolutely, and we’re not asking you to get rid of them. Honestly, we’d rather just become your backup option.



If your normal vendor can’t get there quickly enough, their price comes back higher than expected, or you have an emergency before an inspection or ownership visit, you have somebody else you already know you can call.



That’s really why Trey wants to introduce himself. What day this week would work for a quick introduction?”



If they say: “We don’t have much junk.”



“That’s actually great. And Trey doesn’t need to come out and give you some big sales presentation. It’s really just an introduction, so that when something does happen, you already have somebody local you can call instead of trying to find a company at the last minute.



What day this week would work for him to stop by for about 10 minutes?”

 for you?”

title: SEO, GEO, Content & AI Marketing Manager
description:
SEO, GEO, Content & AI Marketing Manager



About the Role



We are an international digital marketing and technology agency working with clients across different industries and countries.



We are looking for a proactive SEO, GEO, Content & AI Marketing Manager to join our team full time and long term.



The role has a strong focus on SEO, Local SEO, AEO/GEO and visibility in AI-driven search, while also covering content, digital marketing, analytics and practical AI automation.



We are looking for someone who understands how businesses can improve their visibility not only in Google, but increasingly across platforms such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and other AI-powered search environments.



You should be able to analyse opportunities, turn them into practical actions and take ownership rather than simply waiting for tasks.



Key Responsibilities



• Develop and implement SEO, Local SEO and AEO/GEO strategies for different clients.

• Conduct keyword, competitor, search intent and content gap research.

• Improve website structure, internal linking, metadata, content and on-page SEO.

• Identify opportunities to improve visibility in Google and AI-powered search engines.

• Research topics, entities, questions and content opportunities relevant to AI search and traditional search.

• Monitor performance using Google Search Console, GA4 and SEO tools.

• Turn SEO and performance data into clear recommendations and actions.

• Create and optimise website copy, articles, landing pages, headlines and marketing content.

• Support content strategy across LinkedIn, Instagram,
, YouTube and other channels where relevant.

• Coordinate marketing projects, developers, content production and client deliverables.

• Use tools such as ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini for research, analysis, content and productivity.

• Build or support practical automations using tools such as n8n, Make or Zapier.

• Continuously research new developments in SEO, GEO, AI search and digital marketing.

• Support lead generation through prospect research, lead scraping, data enrichment and structured outreach workflows.



What We Are Looking For



• 2+ years of experience in SEO, digital marketing, content or a related field.

• Strong understanding of SEO and on-page optimisation.

• Good understanding of AEO, GEO, AI Search or LLM visibility, or a strong willingness to specialise in this area.

• Experience with Google Search Console and GA4.

• Strong keyword, competitor and content research skills.

• Strong written English.

• Ability to create and optimise high-quality marketing and website content.

• Practical experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini.

• Good organisation and project management skills.

• Proactive, analytical and comfortable working independently.



Experience with tools such as Semrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, WordPress, Google Business Profile, YouTube SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, n8n, Make, Zapier, APIs, structured data/schema markup, AI agents or web scraping is an advantage.



• Experience with lead scraping, web scraping, prospecting tools, data enrichment or CRM workflows is an advantage.



You do not need to be an expert in every area.



How We Work



We value people who:



• understand the business objective behind the tasks

• take ownership and identify opportunities independently;

• combine analytical thinking with strong content judgement;

• turn data and research into practical actions;

• actively follow developments in Google Search and AI Search;

• use AI intelligently rather than simply generating content;

• look for ways to improve and automate processes.



A question we want you to ask regularly is:



“Can this be done better, faster or more intelligently?”



Commitment & Compensation



This is a full-time, long-term position: 8 hours per day.



Our team works primarily during European business hours, so reliable overlap with CET/CEST is required.



Starting compensation: USD 500 per month, full time, with the possibility to grow based on performance, responsibility and long-term fit.



Start the first sentence of your application with the word “SEO” so we know you have read the full job description.



How to Apply



Please include:



• A short introduction and your relevant experience.

• Your location, time zone and availability.

• Your SEO experience and examples of websites or projects you have worked on.

• Examples of keyword research, content optimisation, Local SEO, technical/on-page SEO or SEO strategies you have implemented.

• Any experience with AEO, GEO, AI Search or optimising content for platforms such as ChatGPT, Gemini or Perplexity.

• Examples of content, landing pages, articles or campaigns you have created or improved.

• SEO, analytics, AI and automation tools you regularly use.

• An example of an AI workflow or automation you have created, if available.



Please confirm whether the stated compensation of USD 500 per month is within your expectations.



We are particularly interested in understanding how you analyse a website, identify opportunities, prioritise actions and improve organic and AI-search visibility — not simply which tools you have used.

title: Hospitality / Airbnb Operations Specialist
description:
# ALL-STAR Virtual Assistant – Airbnb & Hospitality Operations



**Company:** VCAY Suites  

**Location:** Remote  

**Position:** Full-Time  

**Industry:** Hospitality / Short-Term Rentals



## We're Hiring an ALL-STAR Virtual Assistant!



VCAY Suites is a growing hospitality company in New Orleans operating large multi-bedroom hotel suites for families, groups, and corporate travelers.



We're looking for an **exceptional Virtual Assistant with real, hands-on Airbnb experience** who can think independently, solve problems quickly, and manage multiple responsibilities without constant supervision.



**This is NOT an entry-level position.**



We need someone intelligent, organized, resourceful, tech-savvy, and extremely detail-oriented.



If you need someone constantly reminding you what to do, this is not the right position.



If you're someone who sees a problem, figures out the solution, and takes ownership until it's resolved, we want to hear from you.



## Responsibilities



- Manage Airbnb guest messages, inquiries, reservation changes, and requests.

- Answer guest phone calls professionally and confidently.

- Coordinate guest check-ins, checkouts, early arrivals, and late departures.

- Monitor upcoming reservations and identify potential issues before arrival.

- Coordinate cleaning, maintenance, and inspections with on-site staff.

- Follow up on outstanding tasks until they are completed.

- Handle guest complaints, troubleshoot issues, and escalate emergencies appropriately.

- Review new reservations for accuracy and update reservation notes.

- Assist with Airbnb reviews, refunds, and reservation modifications.

- Maintain accurate operational records and communicate updates to the team.

- Identify mistakes, inefficiencies, and opportunities to improve our systems.



## Requirements



**Previous Airbnb experience is REQUIRED.**



- Minimum 1 year of hands-on Airbnb or short-term rental management experience.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving abilities.

- Ability to multitask while maintaining accuracy.

- Excellent attention to detail.

- Comfortable handling difficult guests and unexpected situations.

- Strong organizational and time-management skills.

- Experience using property management systems and guest messaging platforms.

- Ability to learn new software quickly.

- Reliable internet, computer, headset, and quiet workspace.

- Comfortable working on camera during assigned shifts.

- Able to work independently without constant supervision.



**Experience with Mews, Breezeway, Hospitable, 
, Expedia, Slack, and WhatsApp is a major plus.**



## What We're Really Looking For



We don't want someone who simply follows instructions.



We want someone who thinks.



If a guest reports an issue, you investigate it.



If a cleaner hasn't completed a room, you follow up before the guest arrives.



If a reservation looks incorrect, you catch it.



If something is overdue, you take action instead of waiting for someone to remind you.



**We value intelligence, urgency, accountability, communication, and common sense.**



You'll be working in a fast-paced hospitality environment where accuracy and quick decision-making matter.



## REQUIRED: Video Introduction



**Every applicant MUST submit a 2–3 minute video recording answering these five questions:**



1. Introduce yourself and describe your experience managing Airbnb properties.

2. How many Airbnb listings have you managed, and what were your daily responsibilities?

3. Tell us about a difficult guest situation you personally resolved.

4. A guest arrives at 3 PM, but their room isn't ready, the cleaner isn't responding, and the guest is upset. What exactly would you do?

5. Why should we hire you over other experienced virtual assistants?



**Do not read from a script or use AI-generated answers.** We want to hear how you naturally communicate and solve problems.



Applicants who do not submit a video will not be considered.



## How to Apply



Please submit:



1. Your résumé.

2. Your 2–3 minute video introduction (Loom or Google Drive link).

3. The number of Airbnb listings you've managed.

4. The software platforms you've used.

5. Your expected hourly rate and availability in US Central Time.



**IMPORTANT: Start your application with the words "I TAKE OWNERSHIP" to confirm you've read the entire posting.**



Applications without Airbnb experience, the required video, or the requested information will not be reviewed.



**We're looking for a long-term team member who can become an essential part of our operation — not someone who just checks boxes.**

description:
Motion Video Editor — EchoVerse Collective



We're a startup AI-native media company. Our flagship product, Dispatches, is a personalised daily AI brief. Four AI columnists write it and a named human editor approves it before anything ships. We publish every day, but almost nobody sees it yet. Your job is to change that.



The role

* Edit and animate. Short-form vertical cuts from our articles and audio editions, plus founder talking-heads, product walkthroughs and launch films. You own the motion graphics, kinetic type, subtitles, sound, pace and colour.

* Run the channels. Plan, schedule and write copy for LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok and Instagram, at a posting rhythm we can sustain.

* Run paid social. Audiences, creative tests, budgets and a weekly honest report on what’s working.

* Build the machine. Templates, motion presets, caption styles, a shot library and prompt libraries. If you make something twice, it becomes a template.

description:
We run an acquisition agency and we're scaling two YouTube channels with the same format. We need one editor who can hold a consistent standard, week in week out, on an ongoing basis. This is not a one-off gig.



WHAT YOU'LL BE EDITING



Two brands, one format, so you learn the style once and apply it to both.



16 long-form YouTube videos per month. Capped at 15 minutes, usually 10 to 12.

Up to 60 shorts per month, cut from those long-forms and from raw clips we send, formatted for Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts.



Expect around 13 to 15 hours a week.



Only two video types:



Lifestyle / story videos — talking head with B-roll cutaways

Technical breakdowns — screen recordings of real dashboards and numbers, composited cleanly



Same template every time. Once you've learned it, it's repeatable work.



WHAT YOU GET FROM US



A full package for every single video: the script, editing notes, and a shot list telling you exactly which B-roll clip goes where. You are never guessing what we want.

An organised Google Drive with labelled and indexed B-roll, horizontal and vertical.

Fast feedback. One revision round, not endless nitpicking.

We run AI tools for the first pass on rough cuts and captions, so the grunt work is partly done before it reaches you. Your job is polish and judgment.



PAY



Monthly retainer, paid on time, every time. No chasing, no invoicing battles.



16 long-form + up to 30 shorts = $400/month

16 long-form + up to 60 shorts = $550/month (this is where we're starting)

PAID TRIAL

WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



A reel, or 3 recent long-form videos you edited start to finish

Ability to composite screen recordings and screenshots cleanly. This is most of the technical videos, so it matters more than anything else on this list

Genuinely fast at cutting vertical shorts out of long-form. This is a big chunk of the volume, so speed here counts

First cut within 48 hours

Consistency. Available every week, ongoing

Your reel or 3 examples of long-form YouTube you cut start to finish

title: Media Buyer
description:
Cellexia Labs currently serves customers in markets all over the world, with our fastest-growing communities in Europe, the US, Canada, and Australia. We're a fully remote, international team, small by design, where everyone owns something real and decisions are made by the people closest to the work.



In skincare, the ad is where the relationship starts. A stranger scrolling past on a phone gives us a second or two, and in that time the ad has to earn a look, a click, and the start of trust. Done well, it brings in customers who stay and reorder. Done badly, it burns budget on people who were never going to buy.



This role runs that moment. You'll own our Meta advertising: what we test, what we scale, where the budget goes, and how we know it's working. It's work where decisions turn into numbers within days, and every number tells you something.

For a sharp, driven media buyer who wants their work judged by results, this is a rare opportunity: ownership of a growing brand's biggest growth channel.



A few examples of your responsibilities



Own the Meta ad account. Plan, launch, and manage campaigns across our markets. You'll d
 the structure, the audiences, the budgets, and when to scale or cut.



Build a testing engine. Run a steady stream of tests on creative, hooks, angles, audiences, and offers. Know what you're testing, why, and what you'll do with the result.



Scale what works. Find the winners, push spend up without breaking performance, and keep acquisition profitable as budgets grow.



Work hand in hand with the creative team. Turn what the data shows into clear briefs for our writers and video editors, so the next round of ads is sharper than the last.



Make the numbers trustworthy. Keep tracking and attribution clean, so every decision rests on data you can believe. Report on cost per acquisition, return on ad spend, and customer quality.



Take every market seriously. Adapt campaigns to the tastes, budgets, and buying habits of customers in Europe, the US, Canada, Australia, and beyond.



Keep the account healthy. Know Meta's ad policies, especially for skincare claims, and keep our campaigns compliant and our account in good standing.



Move fast without cutting corners. Use AI tools to speed up analysis, research, and reporting, then apply your own judgment to make the final calls.



What we look for



Analytical mind. You read the numbers and know what they mean. You can tell a real signal from noise, and explain why a campaign is working or not.



Hands-on skill. You've managed Meta ad accounts with real budgets and understand how structure, creative, and audience work together.



Creative instinct. You can tell a strong ad from a weak one before the data does, and you can explain why in words a writer or editor can use.



Ownership. You treat every campaign as yours until it performs. You hold yourself to a bar that keeps rising.



Calm under pressure. You stay steady when performance dips, find the cause, and act without panicking or hiding the problem.



Team spirit. You support the best idea, not your own. You take feedback well and give it generously.



Relevant experience. [2+] years running Meta ads for e-commerce or consumer brands, with results you can show, ideally with the numbers to prove it. Experience in beauty, skincare, or another consumer category is a strong advantage. Excellent written English is essential.



What we offer



Fast decisions, minimal bureaucracy. Your ideas are taken seriously here, whatever your title or tenure, and the best ones get tested.



Competitive pay, set for where you live. We pay well above local market norms.



Yearly bonuses of up to 40% of your annual salary. When the brand grows, you share in it.



Monthly and yearly subsidies to do your best work. Every month, we put money toward the things that make you more productive: wellness, focus, hardware and internet upgrades, and more. You know what you need better than we do, so you d
 how to use it.



Impact you can see. Campaigns go live fast here, and results come back quickly. You'll watch your decisions move the numbers.



A small team that moves fast. Good ideas get tested quickly.



Work from anywhere. Fully remote, with an international team and the flexibility that comes with it.



A path that grows with the company. As Cellexia Labs scales, the buyer who runs our growth channel is the buyer best placed to lead it.



The selection process



We care about what you can do, not how polished your CV looks. That's why our process is built around how you think and work, not just where you've worked.



Step 1: Apply. Submit your application and CV through this link: 

Step 2: Online assessments. Right after you apply, you'll take two short tests: a problem-solving test and a personality test. The problem-solving test shows us how you reason through unfamiliar challenges. The personality test helps us understand how you work and whether the way we operate will suit you.

Step 3: Interview. If your results stand out, we'll invite you to interview with the team.



We move quickly. The whole process, from application to interview invitation, takes a couple of days.



If you like the role and believe you could excel at it, don't talk yourself out of applying. A less conventional background is welcome here if your results speak for themselves.



Before you apply



Cellexia Labs is a demanding environment. We hold ourselves to a high bar, and we ask the same of the people who join us. In return, you get real freedom, work that goes live, and a front-row seat to the growth of a brand.



If this sounds like the work you want to be doing, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply here:

title: Scheduler / Staffing Coordinator
description:

About You



You enjoy solving puzzles — a last-minute call-off is a challenge, not a crisis, and you stay level-headed while you fix it.



You have world-class written and spoken English. You'll be on the phone constantly with U.S. clients, families, and case managers — confident, clear, professional phone communication is non-negotiable, not a nice-to-have.

You'll own the daily schedule: booking home visits for field staff, filling call-offs quickly, and keeping clients, caregivers, case managers, and office staff informed and coordinated. When schedules run smoothly, clients get consistent care and caregivers get reliable hours — you make that happen.

Requirements



Minimum 5 years of scheduling/staffing coordination experience specifically within a home care agency (required) — this means coordinating field staff visiting clients in private homes, not assisted living facility scheduling and not generic staffing agency placement work



Hands-on experience with home care scheduling software (AlayaCare, WellSky, or similar) and managing multiple schedules simultaneously



Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)



Excellent spoken and written English — near-native fluency required; phone screening will specifically assess verbal communication



Willingness and ability to quickly learn U.S. geography, specifically the Delaware service area, as it's central to daily scheduling decisions



High attention to detail and the ability to multitask in a fast-paced, compliance-sensitive environment



Proactive, problem-solving mindset



Healthcare certification (RN, CNA, or similar) is a plus



Responsibilities



Ensure accurate and appropriate scheduling for clients and staff.



Manage calls from patients and field staff regarding scheduling issues.



Enter and maintain accurate information in the Home Care operating software (AlayaCare).



Communicate professionally with clients, family members, and staff.



Document and maintain schedule notations timely to ensure compliance.



Provide staffing coverage for call-offs and monitor clock-in/out accuracy of field staff.



Answer incoming calls promptly and pleasantly.



Relay information from referral sources, clients, family members, and case managers to appropriate personnel.



Document and report client or staff concerns.

Collaborate with team members to identify opportunities to improve service delivery.



Identify and proactively address scheduling challenges and process improvements.

Applications that do not follow these instructions exactly will not be considered.

title: Hiring: Skilled 3D Generalist Character Modeler/ Animator
description:
Long-Term Opportunity | Potential Full-Time Position | Indie Game Development



Job Description



We are independent game development studio seeking a talented, creative, and reliable 3D Generalist to assist with several ongoing video game projects.



We are looking for someone who is comfortable working across multiple areas of 3D development, including character modeling, environmental modeling, texturing, rigging, and animation.



This position is intended to develop into a full-time, long-term opportunity for the right candidate.



While specialists are welcome to apply, priority will be given to experienced 3D Generalists who demonstrate strong skills in modeling, high-quality texturing, and character animation.



Our projects primarily involve stylized anime-inspired visuals, immersive environments, and interactive gameplay systems developed in Unreal Engine.



Primary Responsibilities



1. 3D Character Modeling



- Create high-quality, stylized anime-inspired 3D characters from concept art and references.

- Model both male and female characters with accurate anatomy, proportions, and silhouettes.

- Create detailed clothing, hairstyles, accessories, and character variations.

- Develop characters suitable for real-time gameplay.

- Optimize character models while maintaining visual quality.

- Modify and improve existing 3D models when necessary.



2. Texturing and Materials



- Create detailed, professional-quality textures for characters, clothing, props, and environments.

- Work with stylized anime materials and realistic or semi-realistic textures when required.

- Produce clean UV maps and properly organized texture sets.

- Maintain consistent visual quality across different game assets.

- Understand PBR workflows and materials compatible with Unreal Engine.



Strong texturing abilities are extremely important for this position.



3. Character Rigging and Animation



- Rig humanoid characters for gameplay and cinematic sequences.

- Create smooth, natural character animations.

- Produce idle, walking, running, crouching, and other basic movement animations.

- Animate character interactions with environmental objects and other characters.

- Create expressive facial animations, gestures, and body language.

- Develop custom animations based on video references or provided examples.

- Create animations for horror, stealth, simulation, and narrative-driven gameplay.

- Work with existing skeletons and animation systems when possible.



Experience with animation retargeting and Unreal Engine skeleton compatibility is highly desirable.



4. Environmental Modeling and Props



- Create interior and exterior environments for video games.

- Model residential buildings, apartments, houses, stores, and other urban environments.

- Develop furniture, appliances, decorative objects, and interactive props.

- Create environmental assets for horror-themed locations, including mansions and abandoned buildings.

- Optimize environments for real-time performance.

- Work with existing marketplace assets and modify them to fit project requirements.



5. Game Asset Integration



- Prepare and export models for use in Unreal Engine. (And or other game engines as needed)

- Ensure models have appropriate topology, materials, UVs, and skeletal structures.

- Assist with importing and configuring character animations.

- Troubleshoot issues involving meshes, textures, and animation compatibility.

- Collaborate on asset optimization and organization.



Current Project Styles



Our development projects include:



Anime-Inspired Life Simulation



A stylized anime life simulator featuring interactive characters, residential neighborhoods, interior environments, and everyday activities.



Assets may include:



- Anime-style characters and alternate outfits.

- Everyday character animations and interactions.

- Residential buildings and neighborhood assets.

- Furniture, household appliances, and interactive objects.

- Character expressions and relationship-driven animations.



Stealth Horror



A horror experience featuring supernatural humanoid characters, detailed environments, and character-driven interactions.



Assets may include:



- Stylized supernatural and humanoid character models.

- Unique character animations and movement styles.

- Detailed mansion interiors and environmental props.

- Suspenseful character interactions and horror animations.

- Character outfits, accessories, and variations.



Multiplayer Survival Horror



An anime-inspired asymmetric survival horror experience.



Assets may include:



- Stylized playable characters.

- Character outfits and cosmetic variations.

- Movement, combat, and interaction animations.

- Environmental objects and map assets.

- Unique character-specific animations.



Preferred Qualifications



We are primarily interested in candidates who possess:



- 2–5+ years of demonstrable 3D development experience.

- Strong proficiency in Blender, Maya, 3ds Max, or comparable 3D software.

- Excellent character modeling and texturing abilities.

- Experience creating stylized anime-inspired characters.

- Practical knowledge of character rigging and animation.

- Familiarity with Unreal Engine workflows.

- Understanding of topology, UV mapping, and optimization.

- Ability to work independently using visual references and written instructions.

- Strong communication skills and professional reliability.

- Ability to provide regular progress updates and meet agreed-upon deadlines.



Experience creating complete game-ready characters, from modeling and texturing through rigging and animation, will receive the highest consideration.



Additional Skills That Are a Plus



- Unreal Engine 5 experience.

- Anime shaders and stylized material creation.

- Facial rigging and expression systems.

- Character clothing and accessory creation.

- Animation retargeting.

- Experience with marketplace assets.

- Blendshapes and morph targets.

- Basic understanding of game development pipelines.

- Experience with mature-rated video game projects.



Important Information



Some of our projects involve mature themes, horror, violence, and adult-oriented content.



Applicants should be comfortable working on projects intended for mature audiences.



Not every project involves mature content, and assignments will vary depending on development requirements.



Employment Opportunity



We are looking to establish a long-term working relationship with a dependable and talented artist.



The position may begin with individual assignments or a paid trial project to evaluate compatibility, work quality, and communication.



Our primary goal is to find the right candidate for consistent, potentially full-time employment.



We value reliability, communication, creativity, and attention to detail just as much as technical ability.



Candidates who consistently deliver quality work and demonstrate versatility will be prioritized for ongoing development opportunities.



How to Apply



Please include the following information in your application:



1. Your portfolio showcasing your best 3D modeling, texturing, and animation work.

2. Your years of professional experience.

3. The 3D software you primarily use.

4. Your experience with Unreal Engine, if applicable.

5. Examples of completed, game-ready character models.

6. Examples of animations you personally created.

7. Your desired monthly salary or hourly rate for long-term employment.

8. Your availability for consistent or full-time work.



Important: Please specify which parts of your portfolio you personally created, particularly modeling, texturing, rigging, and animation.



Applications demonstrating strong abilities in all three priority areas, modeling, texturing, and animation, will receive preference.



We are particularly interested in artists who are passionate about independent game development and interested in growing alongside our projects.



We look forward to reviewing your work!
