title: Real Estate - Acquisitions VA
description:
Real Estate Acquisitions Specialist (Remote)



ABOUT US

Price Real Estate Investments is a U.S.-based real estate investment company purchasing properties directly from homeowners across multiple markets. Our team works remotely to build relationships with sellers, evaluate opportunities, negotiate purchases, and move deals toward closing.



We’re hiring an experienced Real Estate Acquisitions Specialist who can confidently speak with homeowners, present offers, handle objections, and guide sellers toward signed purchase agreements.



This is a hands-on phone sales position. We’re looking for someone who can negotiate and close, but also stays organized, documents information accurately, follows through, and takes ownership of their work.



COMPENSATION

$10 USD per hour base pay, paid on the 1st and 15th of each month.



Monthly Contract Bonuses:

• Bronze: 2 qualified signed contracts = $500 bonus

• Silver: 3 qualified signed contracts = $1,500 bonus

• Gold: 4 qualified signed contracts = $2,000 bonus

• Platinum: 5 qualified signed contracts = $2,500 bonus



For each qualified contract above five in the same month, you may earn an additional $500, subject to ownership approval.

You receive the bonus for the tier you reach, not the sum of all tiers. Contracts count toward the month in which they are fully signed by the seller and approved by ownership as qualified and realistic. Ownership determines contract qualification and agent credit.



Quarterly Consistency Bonus:

Earn an additional $2,000 by securing at least three qualified signed contracts in each month of a calendar quarter. This rewards consistent monthly production, not just the total number of contracts across the quarter.

Quarterly bonuses are reviewed after the quarter ends and paid on the next regular payroll after ownership approval.



SCHEDULE

Full-time, Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM U.S. Central Time, following U.S. daylight saving changes.

This is a fully remote position requiring reliable availability, a quiet workspace, and a dependable computer and internet setup.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Speak directly with homeowners. Build rapport and gather accurate information about property condition, motivation, timeline, occupancy, ownership, and price expectations.

• Evaluate opportunities and present offers. Review comparable properties, help evaluate pricing, and present offers approved by our acquisitions department.

• Negotiate and close. Handle objections, negotiate within approved amounts and terms, and guide sellers toward signed purchase agreements using DocuSign.

• Stay on top of follow-up. Work new leads, scheduled callbacks, pending offers, and ongoing seller follow-up according to team priorities.

• Keep FreedomSoft accurate. Maintain clear notes, correct contact information, current statuses, and specific next steps. Document what sellers actually say rather than making assumptions.

• Work closely with our team lead. Participate in coaching and call reviews, apply feedback, and communicate problems early.



TRAINING AND ONGOING INTAKE RESPONSIBILITIES

Initial training typically takes approximately three to four weeks, depending on progress. It includes reviewing SOPs, shadowing a senior team member, practicing calls, learning our CRM, and receiving feedback.

After training, you will handle seller intake and lead processing while management evaluates your readiness to make offers independently. Approval depends on call handling, accuracy, follow-through, consistency, and response to coaching, not simply time in the role.



Seller intake and lead processing remain regular responsibilities after you begin making offers. This is not a closer-only position. Your assignments will vary based on lead volume, pending offers, and team priorities.



WHAT IT TAKES TO SUCCEED

Sales ability: You can listen, uncover the real objection, communicate the value of our offer, and ask for a decision without sounding aggressive or robotic.

Ownership and reliability: You complete assigned work, keep commitments, and communicate when you are behind or need help. You do not quietly skip required work to catch up.

Attention to detail: You clarify conflicting information, preserve important details, and keep CRM records accurate so the next person can trust your notes.

Coachability: You bring your experience while remaining willing to learn our process, follow approved scripts and rebuttals naturally, and apply feedback.

Consistent follow-up: You stay professional and persistent through our approved calling, texting, and follow-up process, including when results are slow.



REQUIREMENTS

• At least two years of experience in real estate acquisitions or seller negotiations.

• Experience personally presenting offers, handling objections, and moving sellers toward signed purchase agreements. Be prepared to explain your own results and what other team members handled.

• Strong spoken and written English, with the ability to communicate clearly and naturally with U.S. homeowners.

• Familiarity with comparable sales, ARV, repair considerations, and purchase agreements.

• Comfort using CRMs and outbound dialers. FreedomSoft experience is helpful but not required.

• Ability to make 100 or more outbound calls per day when assigned to intake or outbound calling, while meeting the expectations for your assigned work.

• A reliable computer, high-speed internet, quality headset, quiet workspace, and a practical backup plan for internet or power interruptions.



WHY JOIN US?

You’ll have clear processes, training, coaching, and performance-based earning opportunities with a remote real estate investment team.

We’re looking for a long-term team member who wants to improve, contribute consistently, and turn seller conversations into qualified signed contracts.



HOW TO APPLY

 your application to: 

Use the subject line: Real Estate Acquisitions Application - OJPH



Include both of the following:

Your résumé: Highlight your relevant real estate acquisitions, seller-negotiation, and phone-sales experience. A 1-2 minute voice recording in English: Briefly introduce yourself, describe your most recent relevant role and day-to-day responsibilities, and explain your experience speaking with homeowners, making offers, handling objections, or securing signed contracts. Be clear about what you personally handled.



Speak naturally in your own voice. Do not read a prepared script or use AI-generated audio. We want to hear how you communicate and learn about your relevant experience. Audio is sufficient; video is optional.



You may attach the recording or provide a link that opens without requesting access.



Applications missing the résumé or introductory recording will not move forward.

title: Sales & Operational Manager - Virtual Assistant (Housekeeping Business)
description:
We are a growing U.S. based cleaning and housekeeping company specializing in short-term rental turnovers, including Airbnb properties. We help property owners and hosts maintain consistent cleaning quality, reliable scheduling, and an excellent guest and client experience.



We are looking for a dependable, organized, and proactive Sales and Operations Manager to help manage daily operations, coordinate our cleaning team, communicate with clients, and generate new business.



This role is ideal for someone who takes initiative, communicates confidently, solves problems independently, and wants to grow alongside a developing business.



Key Responsibilities:



1. Sales and Business Development



- Respond to inbound calls,
s, messages, and cleaning inquiries, converting qualified leads into paying customers.

- Make outbound calls and send messages to potential clients, including short-term rental hosts and property managers.

- Generate new leads through social media engagement, cold outreach, referrals, and other organic sales efforts.

- Follow up with prospective and existing clients to build relationships and secure new business.

- Track leads, sales activity, conversion rates, and follow-ups in the company's CRM or tracking systems.

- Provide accurate information about services, answer questions, and confidently communicate the value of GuestMaids.

- Work toward a target sales close rate of 40% or higher.



2. Operations and Customer Service



- Coordinate daily and weekly cleaning schedules to ensure all jobs are assigned and completed on time.

- Communicate with cleaners, monitor progress, and address scheduling needs.

- Handle last-minute cancellations, cleaner call-outs, no-shows, and other operational issues.

- Respond promptly (within 10 minutes) to client inquiries, requests, schedule changes, and minor complaints.

- Monitor ongoing cleaning jobs and ensure reported issues and follow-ups are resolved.

- Maintain accurate, up-to-date schedules in our booking software.

- Monitor cleaner performance and escalate significant issues to the owner when necessary.

- Maintain professional communication with clients, cleaners, and other team members.



3. Cleaner Recruitment and Onboarding



- Maintain and update job descriptions and online job listings for cleaner positions.

- Review applications, communicate with candidates, and conduct initial interviews.

- Assist with recruiting, selecting, and onboarding reliable cleaners.

- Maintain an organized recruitment pipeline to support the company's growth.

- Help ensure new cleaners understand company expectations, cleaning standards, and operational procedures.



4. Marketing and Online Presence



- Manage and update the company's social media accounts.

- Maintain the company's Google Business Profile, including posting updates and responding to reviews.

- Update website content and assist with improving the website's appearance, usability, and search engine optimization (SEO).

- Help develop practical marketing strategies to attract new clients and strengthen the company's online presence.



5. Administrative and Special Projects



- Maintain accurate client records, sales information, schedules, and other business documentation.

- Complete assigned business and administrative tasks within established deadlines.

- Assist with process improvements, documentation (i.e. SOP), and projects that improve operational efficiency.

- Take ownership of assigned tasks and provide updates on progress and outstanding issues.

- Assist with other reasonable business or administrative tasks as needed.



Requirements and Qualifications:



- Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate professionally and confidently.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Previous experience in sales, customer service, virtual assistance, operations, or administrative support.

- Comfortable making outbound calls, following up with leads, and selling services over the phone or through messages.

- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to handle unexpected situations calmly.

- Comfortable using computers, spreadsheets, online platforms, and business software.

- Willingness to learn and use tools such as Notion, ConvertLabs, Breezeway, CRM systems, scheduling software, and website management platforms.

- Ability to work independently, prioritize responsibilities, and meet deadlines with minimal supervision.

-  A proactive mindset: able to identify problems, suggest solutions, and take action without waiting for instructions on every task.

- Reliable internet connection and a dedicated workspace suitable for professional remote work.

- Ability to work effectively in a growing business where priorities and responsibilities may change.



Preferred Qualifications:



- Experience working with U.S.-based clients.

- Experience in the cleaning, housekeeping, Airbnb, or property management industry.

- Experience recruiting and coordinating cleaners or independent contractors.

- Familiarity with social media management, Google Business Profile, website editing, and basic SEO.



Work Schedule:



- Part-time or Full-time position, with the initial schedule agreed upon with the successful candidate.

- Working hours will be coordinated around U.S. Eastern Time (8:30AM to 5:30PM)

- Availability during agreed-upon working hours is important to ensure timely responses to clients and cleaners.



Compensation and Bonuses:



* **Base pay:** Hourly compensation, agreed upon before starting.

* **Payment schedule:** Biweekly payments through Wise.

* **Monthly KPI bonus:** An additional 5% of the month's base pay if all established monthly key performance indicators (KPIs) are met.

* **New revenue bonus:** 1% of new revenue booked. For example, booking $1,000 in new business earns a $10 bonus.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)



Success in this position will be measured by the following:



Scheduling and reliability: Cleaning jobs are assigned and completed as scheduled, with minimal errors or delays.

Customer service: Client inquiries and messages receive a response within 10 minutes during working hours, whenever reasonably possible.

Customer satisfaction: Clients and guests consistently receive the high-quality service expected from GuestMaids.

Cleaner coordination: Cleaners receive clear communication, feel supported, and have the information needed to complete their assignments successfully.

Sales performance: Maintain a target close rate of 40% or higher for qualified sales leads.

Lead management: Keep sales records updated and ensure prospective clients receive timely follow-ups.

Task completion: Complete assigned responsibilities accurately and within established deadlines.



Work Leave and Communication Expectations:



- Requests for more than two consecutive days off should be submitted at least seven days in advance.

- Other planned time-off requests should be submitted at least 48 hours in advance.

- If leaving the position, the employee is expected to provide at least 14 days' notice.

- Maintain professional communication and notify the owner promptly about absences, delays, or issues affecting work.



Technical Requirements:



- A dedicated workstation at home.

- A stable internet connection of at least 30 Mbps.

- A backup internet solution and access to backup devices or power arrangements when needed.

- A quiet working environment suitable for calls and professional communication.



How to Apply?



Please submit your resume and a brief introduction video (2 minutes or less) introducing yourself and why you are the best candidate for this role? Please send your video to 



We care about more than getting tasks done. We want to build a team of people we can trust to do the right thing, care about others, and take ownership of their work.



Our values guide how we make decisions, communicate, and serve our customers. We’re looking for someone who genuinely identifies with these values and demonstrates them through their daily actions.



1. Excellence

 Do the Job Right, Even When No One Is Watching.



We take pride in our work and pay attention to the details. We don't cut corners or wait for someone to check our work. Whether you're updating a cleaning schedule, responding to a customer, following up with a lead, or completing an administrative task, you take responsibility for doing it correctly.



2. Honest and Fair

Tell the Truth and Treat People Right.



We communicate honestly, take responsibility for mistakes, and treat customers, cleaners, and teammates fairly. If something goes wrong, we address it instead of hiding it. We value people who can be trusted to give accurate updates, keep their commitments, and do the right thing even when it's uncomfortable.



3. Care About People 

Look Out for Our Customers and Each Other.



Our business depends on trust and strong relationships. We want someone who genuinely cares about helping customers, supporting cleaners, and making things easier for the people they work with. You listen, show empathy, communicate respectfully, and look for solutions that are fair and practical.



4. Always Growing 

Keep Learning and Getting Better.



We don't expect you to know everything from day one. We do expect you to be curious, open to feedback, and willing to improve. You learn from mistakes, look for better ways to do things, and take initiative to develop your skills. As GuestMaids grows, we want you to grow with us.



5. Go With the Flow 

Adapt Without Losing Your Cool.



Cleaning operations can change quickly. A cleaner might cancel, a customer might change a schedule, or an urgent issue might need attention. We need someone who can adjust priorities, stay calm under pressure, and focus on solving the problem rather than getting frustrated. We value flexibility, practical thinking, and a positive approach to change.



Who We're Looking For



The right person is dependable, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership of responsibilities. You don't need someone reminding you about every task or telling you what to do at every step. You notice what needs attention, communicate when something is wrong, and follow through until the job is done.



You care about the quality of your work, treat people fairly, and understand that small details can make a big difference to customers and the team.



We're looking for someone who wants to be part of a growing business, contribute ideas, solve problems, and build systems that help the company run better over time.



If these values reflect how you naturally work, not just what you think an employer wants to hear, we'd like to meet you!

title: 3D Artist (Environment / Architectural Visualization) for Surf Lagoon Resort Concept
description:
I am looking for a skilled 3D artist to turn a concept image into a real 3D scene.



THE PROJECT

The concept is an aerial view of a surf lagoon resort: a large wave pool with a sandy beach edge and a central wave-generating structure, a main clubhouse building, beach cabanas, a small waterpark area, a pool and amenity areas, sports courts (tennis/pickleball and beach volleyball), parking lots, walking paths, a service building, and heavy tropical landscaping (palms and trees) with a highway and water along the edges.



I will share the reference image with shortlisted applicants.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Build the scene in 3D from the reference image (terrain, lagoon, buildings, landscaping, parking, paths, props)

- Set up realistic water, sand, lighting and materials

- Deliver high-quality still renders from several camera angles (aerial, mid-level, and ground level)

- Deliver a short camera fly-through video of the full site

- Make revisions based on my feedback

- Share your working files (not only the final renders)



WHAT I NEED FROM YOU

- Proven 3D environment or architectural visualization work (portfolio required)

- Strong skills in Blender, 3ds Max, SketchUp, Unreal Engine, Lumion, or a similar tool (tell me which one you use)

- Good eye for realistic lighting, water, and landscaping

- Able to work from a reference image and keep the layout faithful to it

- Clear written English and quick replies

- Reliable internet and a computer that can handle large scenes and rendering

- Honest time tracking. I would rather you tell me early if something will take longer than estimated.



PAY AND HOURS

$10 per hour, up to about 20 hours per week (around $800/ month). I will pay for hours worked and logged, so please give a realistic time estimate for each stage.



HOW TO APPLY

Please include:

1. Your portfolio or links to 3D scenes you have built (environments, resorts, parks, or buildings are best)

2. The software you will use

3. A rough estimate of how many total hours you think this project will take, and how you would break it into stages

4. Your availability and timezone

5. Whether you use AI tools in your workflow, and for what. All final models must be your own 3D work, not AI images presented as 3D.



Applications without a portfolio link will not be considered. Start your application with the word "3D" so I know you read this post.

title: Guest Experience Specialist
description:
Excellent spoken English is the most important requirement for this role. Guests will hear you on the phone. We will teach you the software and our process.



Sonoma Coastal Collection is a locally rooted, family-owned property management company serving California's Sonoma Coast — Sea Ranch, Gualala, Sonoma, and the surrounding coastal communities — with over 200 curated vacation homes. Our deep connection to this region is what inspired us to build Sonoma Coastal Collection. We are focused on providing thoughtful, memorable stays for our guests and reliable, attentive stewardship for our homeowners. Our goal is to grow in a way that honors what makes the Sonoma Coast special — its dramatic coastline, redwood forests, tight-knit communities, and slower pace of life — while delivering exceptional experiences for guests and trusted, long-term partnerships for homeowners.

Tech stack (daily tools): Guesty (PMS), Breezeway (tasks/workorders + cleaning), Akia (guest messaging), Zoom Phone (calls).

Our Promises



Everything we do is guided by our Promises. They are our operating standard and the way we earn five-star stays and trusted, long-term homeowner partnerships.



Thoughtful Guest Engagement: Proactive, genuine hospitality from booking to five-star review. We believe vacations are special — something people save for, plan for, and look forward to. Our job is to make every stay feel seamless and memorable. We anticipate needs, communicate early, check in during the stay, and resolve issues quickly with warmth and care. Our guest journey is intentionally crafted to deliver the kind of responsiveness, thoughtfulness, and attention to detail that turns a great trip into an unforgettable coastal experience.



Attentive Home Stewardship: We care for every home as if it were our own. As people who live and work on this coast, we know what true home stewardship looks like. We operate with a proactive mindset of quality, consistency, and pride. Regular home checks, rigorous cleaning standards, quality control, seasonal readiness, and preventive maintenance are all part of how we ensure every property is clean, protected, and presentation-ready — for guests and for you. We treat every home with the same respect and diligence we expect for our own.



Trusted Homeowner Partnerships: We treat each home like our own investment. Every homeowner has different goals — maximizing revenue, balancing personal use, focusing on long-term appreciation, or simply enjoying peace of mind. Our role is to be a true partner in those goals, not simply a property manager. As owners and operators in this region ourselves, our guidance comes from real-world results, not theory. Through regular business reviews, thoughtful design and amenity recommendations, revenue and pricing insights, and brand-building support, we help each property reach its highest potential.

Our Guest Experience team is one of the biggest ways we deliver these promises. This is hospitality work. You are a core part of our team, not an outsourced call-center function.



Job Description: Guest Experience Specialist — Sonoma Coast

As a Guest Experience Specialist, you own guest communication and coordination. You are the voice of Sonoma Coastal Collection, a core part of our team, and a key driver of five-star stays. This role is built around answering phones and helping with guest messaging in Akia. Excellent spoken English matters more than prior software experience — we will teach you Guesty, Breezeway, Akia, and Zoom Phone, and we will teach you our process. You will also coordinate work orders and cleaning schedules with our local teams and vendors, and bring thoughtful hospitality to every stay.



You will own:

Answer guest calls and return missed calls promptly (Zoom Phone)

Guest messaging in Akia, with warmth and clarity

Proactive outreach and warm guest engagement that drives five-star stays

Work order coordination and task follow-through

Cleaning scheduling and day-to-day coordination with our local team and vendors



Working Hours

This is one fixed schedule. There is no shift rotation.

Days: Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday

Hours: 9:00am–6:00pm Pacific Time

Days off: Friday and Saturday



Shift length: 9 hours, including up to 90 minutes of self-scheduled break time

Philippines time during Pacific Daylight Time (roughly March–November): 12:00am–9:00am PHT

Philippines time during Pacific Standard Time (roughly November–March): 1:00am–10:00am PHT

Night shift differential: +$50 USD per month, because this schedule is overnight in the Philippines



Compensation and Incentives

Base pay: $650–$750 USD per month (full-time, based on experience)

Night shift differential: +$50 per month

Internet/tech allowance: $20 per month

13th month pay: offered in December (prorated for partial years)



Monthly Bonus: Monthly 5-Star Bonus Pool (based on team review quality + individual SLA performance)

PTO: Accrues at 1 paid day per month (usable after 90 days; no annual rollover)

Monthly 5-Star Bonus Pool

We keep the bonus simple, measurable, and tied directly to delivering thoughtful guest experiences — the heart of your role.

Pool funding: $2.00 USD for every 5-star review received during the month.

Quality gate: Pool funded only if the monthly average rating is 4.85+ and the review rate is 80%+.

Distribution: The funded pool is divided equally among the Guest Experience Team members.

Eligibility: You receive your share when monthly SLA and performance standards are met. Shares are not redistributed from non-eligible members.



Location

These roles are fully remote within the Philippines.



Role and Responsibilities

Phone support (Zoom Phone)

Answer calls quickly and calmly and return missed calls promptly

Troubleshoot common issues (access codes, Wi-Fi, amenities, heating/hot tub basics, recreation passes) and escalate when needed

Thoughtful Guest Engagement (Akia + text/email)

Answer guest messages in Akia with warmth, clarity, and genuine care

Proactively share helpful guidance (arrival, access, weather/fog, coastal road conditions, home-specific tips) and check in during the stay

Keep conversations organized and ensure no guest is left waiting or confused

Ensure every guest experience feels personal and thoughtfully handled

Welcome outreach (required for every reservation)

Send a personalized welcome text to find out what, if anything, they are celebrating

Confirm access and comfort, offer help, and document any concerns quickly

Identify opportunities to make the guest's stay a memorable coastal experience

Workorders and coordination (Breezeway)

Create workorders fast when issues arise and confirm vendor/team acknowledgment

Track progress, follow up, and close the loop with guests and the local team

Keep notes and task status clean so handoffs are seamless

Cleaning scheduling and turnovers (Breezeway)

Coordinate turn cleaning schedules and special requests

Ensure all turns are scheduled a minimum of one week prior to booking and confirm scheduled cleaner by 6:00pm Pacific the night prior to a scheduled cleaning and communicate key notes to cleaners



Documentation and handoffs

Maintain accurate property notes and updates

Close out open items before shift end and hand off active issues with clear context

Monthly SLA Standards (required for bonus eligibility)

Guest messages answered within 5 minutes during your shift (Akia)

Phone calls answered within 30 seconds during your shift

No open guest messages left at shift end; clean handoffs with clear notes

Workorders created promptly and vendor/team acknowledgment confirmed quickly



Local expertise

Become an expert on Sea Ranch, Gualala, and the Sonoma Coast, including seasonal rhythms, coastal weather and fog patterns, Highway 1 road conditions, and local norms.

Learn the best restaurants, cafes, shops, activities, and experiences in each market so you can offer personalized, concierge-level recommendations that make each stay special.

Know our homes in detail: complete Matterport and photo walkthroughs; learn layouts, bedding, amenities, quirks, parking, access instructions, recreation pass usage, and any "good to know" details for guests.

Stay current on local events and updates by checking event calendars, tourism sites, and community pages (including Sea Ranch Association updates and relevant local
 groups).

Use your local and property knowledge proactively to help guests plan better stays, avoid common issues, and feel confidently looked after from booking to checkout.



What we look for

Excellent spoken English and good written english with a warm, helpful tone. Spoken English is the most important requirement.

Hospitality mindset (you enjoy caring for people, not just closing tickets)

Strong ownership and follow-through, especially on busy days

Detail-oriented and eager to learn homes, markets, and local context

No prior experience with Guesty, Breezeway, Akia, or Zoom Phone is required. We will teach you the software and the process.

Reliable internet and a quiet, professional work environment



How to apply

Please submit the following:

Resume/CV

2-minute video recording introducing yourself and your experience (English)

Speedtest.net result (screenshot)

Short written samples: How would you respond to the following guest messages?

"The hot tub isn't heating. Can you help?"

"Can we request a late checkout tomorrow?"

"We're staying in Sea Ranch — any recommendations for a great dinner spot nearby?"

Short written samples: These three guests message you at the same time. In what order would you respond and why?

"We can't get into the home, the code isn't working."

"The Wi-Fi is slow and we need it for work."

"Can we check out one hour later?"

title: AI Video Editor for a Fast-Growing DTC Brand
description:
We're a small, fast-growing Shopify brand, and Meta ads are how we grow. I'm hiring 2 AI video editors to work directly with me. You'll make ads with AI video tools, recreate and iterate on our winners, and help find the next one.



Why this role:

- You work directly with the founder. There are no managers.

- You'll start as an editor and grow beyond it. I'll share all the strategy behind the ads: why one creative carries the account for weeks while another dies in testing. As you take on more of the thinking, your pay goes up with it.



What separates the editor I hire:



- You're deliberate with every shot. Each beat has a job: stop the scroll, build curiosity, or pay it off. A visual that only loosely matches the script isn't good enough.

- You treat the first frame as the most important part of the ad. You know how to make it pattern-interrupting and instantly clear about who the ad is for.

- You care about sound. Our process ads are ASMR-driven, so crisp effects and no AI music mush.

- You'll improve a brief and tell me why. I'd rather hear "I changed the hook shot, here's why" than get a clean execution of something that was going to flop.

- You're patient with AI. You know that getting a clip right takes regenerations, and you can spot a bad hand, a warped object or a continuity error before I do.



The work:

- Make 5–10 Meta ads per week across:

> AI-generated process/ASMR ads. Recreate our proven winners with new inputs so each one feels fresh but keeps what made the original work.

> Emotional storytelling. Ads built on real moments and the feelings behind them.

> AI UGC and talking-head ads.

> Editing real footage, such as UGC and product clips.



- Turn reference videos into our own original versions with AI. We never repost other people's content.

- Iterate fast from performance data. Every week we review the ad account together: what won, what died, and why.

- About 70% of the work is iterating on winners and 30% is new concepts.



Tools:

- Seedance, Kling, Higgsfield, CapCut or Premiere. We pay for all AI tools.



Compensation:

- $1,500–$3,000/month base, depending on skill

- A percentage of spend on every winner you make, paid for as long as the ad keeps spending profitably



Hiring process:

Application → call → paid 2-week trial 



Don't apply if…

- You've never made ads for an ecommerce brand

- You haven't edited or generated AI video ads

- You need every shot described in the brief

- You can't explain why your edit should perform better

- Your idea of "good" is how an ad looks, not what it did

- You get defensive about feedback

- You need slow timelines and hand-holding

title: SEO Specialist / SEO Manager
description:
*************Only candidates who submit an introduction video will be considered.***************



************* This is an inhouse position only************** 



Kitchen & Bath Authority has been serving the home improvement industry for over 23 years. As we continue to grow our digital presence, we are looking for a results-driven SEO Specialist / SEO Manager with hands-on experience in modern search, backlink acquisition, content strategy, and AI-driven optimization.



This is a full-time position with some scheduling flexibility. Core availability and reliable communication are expected during agreed-upon working hours, but we are open to accommodating your time zone on certain days of the week.



This role is ideal for someone who can both execute SEO initiatives independently and take ownership of projects, priorities, and potentially other team members or external partners as our digital team continues to grow.



What You'll Do



• Manage and improve on-page SEO across product, category, and content pages, including title tags, meta descriptions, heading structure, internal linking, schema markup, and content optimization



• Develop and execute backlink acquisition strategies through outreach, editorial placements, guest posting, partnerships, and digital PR



• Optimize content and site structure for emerging AI-powered search experiences, including AI Overviews (AIO), generative search surfaces, and image/search optimization opportunities



• Conduct keyword research and competitive analysis across our kitchen, bath, lighting, and home improvement product categories



• Plan, assign, review, and optimize SEO-focused blog and landing-page content; AI writing tools are welcome, but strong human editing, fact-checking, and optimization are required



• Identify technical SEO issues and work with developers or internal team members to prioritize and implement improvements



• Monitor rankings, organic traffic, conversions, backlink growth, and other key SEO KPIs using GA4, Google Search Console, Ahrefs, SEMrush, and related tools



• Prepare clear monthly performance reports and translate SEO data into actionable recommendations



• Take ownership of SEO priorities, timelines, and deliverables while helping coordinate writers, developers, freelancers, agencies, or other digital team members when necessary



• Help establish SEO processes, documentation, quality standards, and best practices as the department grows



Requirements



• Minimum 2+ years of hands-on SEO experience, preferably in e-commerce



• Demonstrated ability to manage SEO projects from strategy through execution and reporting



• Some managerial, team-lead, project-management, or vendor-management experience preferred



• Must submit at least 2 case studies or documented examples of past SEO success showing where you started, what actions you took, and the measurable results

title: Client Care Specialist – Client Support & Experience
description:
Fully Remote | Client Relations | Customer Service | Client Support



About the Opportunity



We are looking for a friendly, proactive, and client-focused Client Care Specialist to serve as a primary point of contact for our clients and help ensure they receive exceptional service throughout their experience with the firm.



In this role, you’ll be responsible for responding to client inquiries, providing timely updates, addressing questions and concerns, and ensuring clients feel heard, informed, valued, and supported. You’ll work closely with attorneys, paralegals, and other team members to help clients navigate their experience with the firm while maintaining clear communication and consistent follow-through.



This position is ideal for someone who enjoys helping people, communicates effectively, stays organized in a fast-paced environment, and takes pride in delivering a positive client experience.



Key Responsibilities



Client Communication & Support



- Serve as a primary point of contact for client inquiries through phone,
, text messages, and other communication channels.

- Respond to client questions, requests, and concerns promptly, professionally, and courteously.

- Provide clients with appropriate updates regarding their cases, appointments, next steps, and outstanding requests.

- Explain processes and procedures clearly while ensuring clients understand what to expect.

- Maintain a friendly, patient, and empathetic approach when interacting with clients.



Client Experience & Issue Resolution



- Ensure clients receive consistent, responsive, and high-quality support throughout their engagement with the firm.

- Listen carefully to client concerns and identify the appropriate steps to address them.

- Resolve routine client service issues within the scope of the role and escalate complex matters to the appropriate team members.

- Recognize when clients require additional assistance, clarification, or follow-up.

- Help identify recurring client concerns and recommend ways to improve service quality and client satisfaction.



Follow-Up & Documentation



- Track client inquiries, pending requests, callbacks, and outstanding action items to ensure nothing is overlooked.

- Follow up with clients and internal team members to ensure questions and concerns are addressed within appropriate timeframes.

- Maintain accurate and up-to-date client contact information, communication logs, and case notes in the firm’s CRM or case management system.

- Document important client interactions, requests, and updates clearly and accurately.

- Ensure all communication commitments are fulfilled and no client is left without an appropriate response.



Internal Coordination & Team Collaboration



- Coordinate with attorneys, paralegals, intake personnel, and other departments to address client needs.

- Route inquiries and requests to the appropriate team members and monitor them through resolution when necessary.

- Communicate relevant client feedback, concerns, and service issues to the appropriate personnel.

- Help maintain consistent communication between clients and the firm’s internal teams.

- Support team workflows by ensuring client requests are properly documented, assigned, and followed through.



Confidentiality & Professionalism



- Handle sensitive client information with discretion and care.

- Follow established privacy, confidentiality, and information security procedures.

- Maintain accurate records and comply with the firm’s communication and documentation standards.

- Represent the firm professionally in every client interaction.

- Recognize the limits of the role and refer legal questions to the appropriate attorney rather than providing unauthorized legal advice.



What We’re Looking For



We’re looking for someone who is compassionate, dependable, organized, and committed to delivering excellent client service.



Ideal candidates will have:



- Previous experience in customer service, client care, client support, call center operations, client relations, or a similar role.

- Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal.

- A friendly, professional, and empathetic communication style.

- Excellent active listening, problem-solving, and interpersonal skills.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- The ability to manage multiple client inquiries, tasks, and follow-ups without losing track of priorities.

- Confidence handling difficult conversations and responding calmly to frustrated or concerned clients.

- Familiarity with CRM platforms, case management systems, or other client communication tools.

- The ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and collaborate with a remote team.

- A proactive mindset with a strong sense of accountability and follow-through.

- Law firm or legal industry experience is a plus.

- Spanish-speaking ability is a plus.



What Success Looks Like



Success in this role means ensuring that every client receives timely communication, reliable support, and a consistently positive experience with the firm.



You’ll help ensure:



- Client inquiries are acknowledged and addressed promptly.

- Calls,
s, and messages receive appropriate follow-up.

- Clients understand their next steps and know where to turn for assistance.

- Outstanding requests and concerns are tracked through resolution.

- Client records and communication notes remain accurate and organized.

- Attorneys and team members receive relevant client updates in a timely manner.

- Potential service issues are identified early and escalated appropriately.

- Clients feel respected, supported, and confident in their interactions with the firm.



How to Apply



If you enjoy helping people, solving problems, staying organized, and creating positive client experiences, we’d love to hear from you.



Please submit your resume and highlight your relevant experience in customer service, client care, or client support. We’re looking for someone who takes ownership of client requests, communicates with empathy, and consistently follows through to ensure every client feels taken care of.

- Clear written English communication and reliable availability during working hours

Nice to Have:

title: Video Editor & Creator
description:
Calling All Video Editors!

 

Do you speak and write excellent English? Are you looking for a stable, full-time role with a USA-based company? Our Filipino team members have been with us for years, and we'd love for you to be next.

 

Do you love turning raw footage into engaging stories? Are you skilled in Adobe Premiere Pro, with a sharp eye for detail? If so, we want YOU on our team!

 

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

 

We're looking for a talented and enthusiastic Video Editor to join our growing team. You'll edit long-form video podcasts for YouTube channels run by medical professionals, covering health topics such as joint pain, sports medicine, regenerative treatments and men's health.

 

You'll work closely with an established production team that offers clear communication and support. Even so, we need an independent problem-solver. You should be able to take raw video and audio, handle post-production from start to finish, and deliver on time without needing reminders or close supervision.

 

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 

- Video and audio editing: Edit raw podcast recordings into polished long-form YouTube videos using Adobe Premiere Pro. Cut filler words, dead air and awkward pauses. Clean up background noise and balance audio levels so every episode sounds crisp and professional.

- Visual enhancements: Add b-roll, captions and simple graphics that follow brand guidelines.

- Thumbnail design: Create eye-catching, high-converting thumbnails that drive clicks.

- AI-assisted optimization: Use AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) to write SEO-friendly titles, descriptions and tags, following the team's templates.

- Accuracy: Make sure medical terms are spelled correctly in captions, titles and descriptions.

- Channel management: Upload videos, manage playlists and handle the YouTube back end so each channel runs smoothly.

- Delivery and revisions: Upload deliverables to Dropbox, submit them for review before the deadline, and make revisions based on feedback.

- Team collaboration: Coordinate daily with the team on files, workflows and publishing schedules, and submit an End-of-Day report.

 

 

REQUIREMENTS

 

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Strong skills in Adobe Premiere Pro (other editing software such as DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro or CapCut is a plus)

- Solid audio editing skills (EQ, compression, noise reduction)

- Familiarity with AI tools for writing titles, descriptions and other content

- Thumbnail design skills in Photoshop, Canva or similar software

- Basic understanding of YouTube Studio, SEO and analytics

- Comfortable working with medical and health content (a healthcare background or interest is a plus)

- Highly reliable: manages time well, meets deadlines consistently and communicates proactively

- Detail-oriented, organized and open to feedback

- Experience editing long-form YouTube videos or podcasts is a plus, but we're willing to train the right person

 

 

EQUIPMENT REQUIREMENTS

 

- A PC or laptop that can handle video editing:

   - Intel Core i5/i7 or AMD Ryzen 5/7 (newer generations preferred)

   - At least 16GB of RAM

   - At least 1TB of storage

   - Dedicated graphics card (optional)

- A fast, reliable internet connection for uploading and downloading large video files

- A backup power source

 

 

SCHEDULE

 

Full-time, Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM US Eastern Time (11:00 PM - 7:00 AM Philippine Time)

 

 

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

 

- Base salary: PHP 40,000 per month

- Quarterly bonus: PHP 20,000 every 3 months (in place of the 13th month pay)

- Paid time off: Includes paid leave and select Philippine holidays, such as All Saints' Day

 

 

WHY JOIN US?

 

We help a lot of people, and you'll be an important part of that work. We currently have 14 full-time, permanent team members in the Philippines, and we treat each of them like pamilya, with respect and appreciation.

 

As a thank-you to our Filipino team, we've hosted all-expense-paid trips for two (travel, food and 5-star lodging such as Henann Resorts), including:

 

- 2022: Boracay

- 2023: Alona Beach, Bohol

- April 2024: El Nido, Palawan

- March 2025: Boracay

 

This is a full-time position, and we're hiring immediately.

 

 

HOW TO APPLY

 

SERIOUS APPLICANTS ONLY. ORIGINAL WORK SAMPLES ARE REQUIRED.

 

Click the Apply button and type "Video Ninja" in the subject line. Please include:

 

1. A recent voice recording introducing yourself, explaining why you want this job and why we should choose you

2. Confirmation that you have both a computer and a cell phone

We'll reply through OnlineJobs.ph to applicants we'd like to interview and schedule a meeting on Zoom or MS Teams. Please check your OnlineJobs.ph inbox for our response.

title: Senior Video-editor
description:
We are a Dutch D2C brand based in the Netherlands. We run paid video ads on Meta 
 & Instagram) for the Dutch and Belgian market. Our creatives are built around strategic concepts, and every video has one job: grab attention, hold it, and turn viewers into customers.

We're looking for a Senior Video Editor who doesn't just cut clips together, but understands why a video works.



Who We're Looking For

Someone who understands how people actually watch ads on Meta: thumb on the screen, sound often off, ready to scroll away at any second. You know how to structure a video so the viewer stays, from the first frame to the CTA.

Ideally, you can look at a script and tell us: "This part will lose people. Let's move the payoff up," or "This hook is too slow, try this instead." We value editors who bring their own ideas and actively look for ways to make our ads better.



This is NOT a role for YouTube editors, vlog editors or wedding/event editors. We need someone with real experience in performance ads for D2C brands. So if you don't have experience with D2C, do not apply. 



What You'll Do

- Edit high-converting AI UGC videos and B-roll-driven ads for Meta (Reels, Stories, Feed)

- Structure videos for maximum retention: hook → problem → proof → solution → CTA

- Create scroll-stopping hooks in the first 1–3 seconds

- Build clear, strong CTAs that drive action

- Create and source B-roll using AI tools and stock libraries



Produce videos with our AI stack:

- Higgsfield for AI video and visuals

- HeyGen for AI avatars and UGC-style talking heads

- ElevenLabs for Dutch voiceovers

- Use Claude for optimising visual prompts



Give feedback on scripts: where they're too slow, unclear or weak

Create multiple variations per concept for testing (different hooks, angles and CTAs)

Add captions, motion graphics, sound design and pacing optimized for sound-off viewing



Requirements (Must-Have)

- Minimum 2 years of experience editing Meta ads for D2C / e-commerce brands. This is non-negotiable.

- A portfolio with real paid ads you've edited (Meta or TikTok ads, not organic or YouTube content)

- Deep understanding of hooks, retention, pacing, storytelling and CTAs in short-form ads

- Experience with AI UGC and comfort with tools like Higgsfield, HeyGen and ElevenLabs

- Comfortable editing videos in Dutch. You don't need to speak it, but you must work accurately with Dutch scripts, voiceovers and captions (we'll provide translations).

- Good English to communicate about briefs, scripts and feedback

- A stable internet connection and a strong editing setup



Nice to Have

- Experience with health, wellness or 45+ target audiences

- Copywriting skills for hooks and on-screen text

- Experience working with European brands

- Understanding of ad metrics (hook rate, hold rate, CTR) and how editing affects them



What We Offer

- Long-term, stable position with a growing Dutch brand

- Work with the latest AI video tools

- Your ideas are heard. We want you to think along, not just execute.

- Room to grow into a lead creative role



How to Apply

Send us:

- Your portfolio with links to paid Meta ads for D2C brands you edited

- Pick one ad from your portfolio and explain: what was the hook, how did you structure the video, and why did it work?

- Which D2C brands have you edited ads for, and for how long?

- Your experience with Higgsfield, HeyGen and ElevenLabs

- Your expected monthly salary



⚠️ Start your application with the word "APPLE" so we know you read the full post. Applications without it will not be reviewed.

title: Real Estate - Acquisitions Closer
description:
Real Estate Acquisitions Specialist (Remote)



ABOUT US

Price Real Estate Investments is a U.S.-based real estate investment company purchasing properties directly from homeowners across multiple markets. Our team works remotely to build relationships with sellers, evaluate opportunities, negotiate purchases, and move deals toward closing.



We’re hiring an experienced Real Estate Acquisitions Specialist who can confidently speak with homeowners, present offers, handle objections, and guide sellers toward signed purchase agreements.



This is a hands-on phone sales position. We’re looking for someone who can negotiate and close, but also stays organized, documents information accurately, follows through, and takes ownership of their work.



COMPENSATION

$10 USD per hour base pay, paid on the 1st and 15th of each month.



Monthly Contract Bonuses:

• Bronze: 2 qualified signed contracts = $500 bonus

• Silver: 3 qualified signed contracts = $1,500 bonus

• Gold: 4 qualified signed contracts = $2,000 bonus

• Platinum: 5 qualified signed contracts = $2,500 bonus



For each qualified contract above five in the same month, you may earn an additional $500, subject to ownership approval.

You receive the bonus for the tier you reach, not the sum of all tiers. Contracts count toward the month in which they are fully signed by the seller and approved by ownership as qualified and realistic. Ownership determines contract qualification and agent credit.



Quarterly Consistency Bonus:

Earn an additional $2,000 by securing at least three qualified signed contracts in each month of a calendar quarter. This rewards consistent monthly production, not just the total number of contracts across the quarter.

Quarterly bonuses are reviewed after the quarter ends and paid on the next regular payroll after ownership approval.



SCHEDULE

Full-time, Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM U.S. Central Time, following U.S. daylight saving changes.

This is a fully remote position requiring reliable availability, a quiet workspace, and a dependable computer and internet setup.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Speak directly with homeowners. Build rapport and gather accurate information about property condition, motivation, timeline, occupancy, ownership, and price expectations.

• Evaluate opportunities and present offers. Review comparable properties, help evaluate pricing, and present offers approved by our acquisitions department.

• Negotiate and close. Handle objections, negotiate within approved amounts and terms, and guide sellers toward signed purchase agreements using DocuSign.

• Stay on top of follow-up. Work new leads, scheduled callbacks, pending offers, and ongoing seller follow-up according to team priorities.

• Keep FreedomSoft accurate. Maintain clear notes, correct contact information, current statuses, and specific next steps. Document what sellers actually say rather than making assumptions.

• Work closely with our team lead. Participate in coaching and call reviews, apply feedback, and communicate problems early.



TRAINING AND ONGOING INTAKE RESPONSIBILITIES

Initial training typically takes approximately three to four weeks, depending on progress. It includes reviewing SOPs, shadowing a senior team member, practicing calls, learning our CRM, and receiving feedback.

After training, you will handle seller intake and lead processing while management evaluates your readiness to make offers independently. Approval depends on call handling, accuracy, follow-through, consistency, and response to coaching, not simply time in the role.



Seller intake and lead processing remain regular responsibilities after you begin making offers. This is not a closer-only position. Your assignments will vary based on lead volume, pending offers, and team priorities.



WHAT IT TAKES TO SUCCEED

Sales ability: You can listen, uncover the real objection, communicate the value of our offer, and ask for a decision without sounding aggressive or robotic.

Ownership and reliability: You complete assigned work, keep commitments, and communicate when you are behind or need help. You do not quietly skip required work to catch up.

Attention to detail: You clarify conflicting information, preserve important details, and keep CRM records accurate so the next person can trust your notes.

Coachability: You bring your experience while remaining willing to learn our process, follow approved scripts and rebuttals naturally, and apply feedback.

Consistent follow-up: You stay professional and persistent through our approved calling, texting, and follow-up process, including when results are slow.



REQUIREMENTS

• At least two years of experience in real estate acquisitions or seller negotiations.

• Experience personally presenting offers, handling objections, and moving sellers toward signed purchase agreements. Be prepared to explain your own results and what other team members handled.

• Strong spoken and written English, with the ability to communicate clearly and naturally with U.S. homeowners.

• Familiarity with comparable sales, ARV, repair considerations, and purchase agreements.

• Comfort using CRMs and outbound dialers. FreedomSoft experience is helpful but not required.

• Ability to make 100 or more outbound calls per day when assigned to intake or outbound calling, while meeting the expectations for your assigned work.

• A reliable computer, high-speed internet, quality headset, quiet workspace, and a practical backup plan for internet or power interruptions.



WHY JOIN US?

You’ll have clear processes, training, coaching, and performance-based earning opportunities with a remote real estate investment team.

We’re looking for a long-term team member who wants to improve, contribute consistently, and turn seller conversations into qualified signed contracts.



HOW TO APPLY:

 your application to: 

Use the subject line: Real Estate Acquisitions Application - OJPH



Include both of the following:

Your résumé: Highlight your relevant real estate acquisitions, seller-negotiation, and phone-sales experience. A 1-2 minute voice recording in English: Briefly introduce yourself, describe your most recent relevant role and day-to-day responsibilities, and explain your experience speaking with homeowners, making offers, handling objections, or securing signed contracts. Be clear about what you personally handled.



Speak naturally in your own voice. Do not read a prepared script or use AI-generated audio. We want to hear how you communicate and learn about your relevant experience. Audio is sufficient; video is optional.



You may attach the recording or provide a link that opens without requesting access.



Applications missing the résumé or introductory recording will not move forward.

HOW TO APPLY



Application Link: 



As part of our standard recruitment procedure, we kindly ask that you complete your application through Rippling, our global Human Resources Information System (HRIS). This platform is used globally at DTiQ to ensure a consistent and secure way of managing candidate information.



What to expect:

We understand that this process may be different from traditional application methods commonly used in the Philippines, such as submitting resumes via email or by job postings. Our HRIS system will require you to:

Hired candidates will be engaged through an Employment of Record (EOR) at the start of employment. This is a widely used approach by international companies to hire talent in countries where we do not yet have a legal entity and allows us to comply with legal regulations. This means that Rippling, our EOR provider in the Philippines will officially employ you on behalf of DTiQ Technologies while you will work day-to-day with our team. Under this arrangement salary, government contributions and taxes are processed in compliance with Philippine regulations. DTiQ will manage your daily work, performance and career development. If you have further questions about this arrangement, please let me know and I’d be happy to address it with you.



Is my data secure?

Yes, the system complies with international data privacy standards and your information will only be accessed by authorized personnel.



What if I experience technical issues?

If you have any trouble in the Rippling system, please reply to this message so we can assist you properly.



We truly appreciate your time and effort in completing these next steps. If you have any questions or concerns, please reach out – I’m here to help.



At DTiQ, we value dedication, teamwork, and continuous improvement. If you are looking for a stable job with opportunities to grow and develop your skills, we encourage you to apply and be part of our global team.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience creating high-engagement or high-performing digital content.

title: LinkedIn Expert
description:
ABOUT US



Ice Cream Sunshine is a good vibes signature ice cream tour and special events company based in Chicago. People who join our tours have loads of fun as we explore Chicago neighborhoods, enjoy delicious ice cream treats at local businesses, and learn fun facts about ice cream and the city. Guests smile, mingle, laugh, and enjoy America’s #1 dessert. Good vibes are the core of who we are, and that extends to every person on our team.



THE ROLE



We are looking for a LinkedIn expert to build Ice Cream Sunshine’s presence on LinkedIn from the ground up. You will grow our company page and our founder’s personal brand, position Ice Cream Sunshine as the authority on ice cream experiences in Chicago, and turn that presence into real business leads for private tours and team events.



You will report to our Marketing & Social Media Manager and work closely with our founder on her profile and voice. We do not want AI produced content or AI generated strategy. We are hiring your expertise and your judgment.





CANDIDATES WHO HEAR FROM OUR TEAM

Complete a full application.  Details are found in the HOW TO APPLY section.





WHAT YOU WILL DO



● Build and optimize our company page and our founder’s personal profile, including headlines, banners, About sections, and Featured content.

● Plan, write, and publish content about three times per week on each profile, with a clear content calendar and strong hooks.

● Grow followers and connections through meaningful daily engagement: commenting, connecting, and joining conversations that matter to our audience.

● Build relationships with corporate event planners, HR teams, and culture leads, and turn engagement into warm leads for private tours and team events.

● Pass qualified leads to our Sales & Partnerships Manager so every opportunity gets followed up.

● Use the full range of LinkedIn formats, including document carousels, native video, polls, articles, newsletters, and events.

● Track results and report weekly on followers, impressions, engagement rate, profile views, and leads generated.



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



● 5+ years of proven LinkedIn expertise, with top performer results you can show.

● A track record of growing both company pages and personal brands, backed by real analytics.

● Experience generating B2B leads and booked conversations through LinkedIn.

● A talented writer who can capture a founder’s voice in a way that feels warm, authentic, and true to her.

● Strong, current knowledge of the LinkedIn algorithm, content formats, and what drives dwell time, reach, and engagement.

● Your own expertise, strategy, and ideas, not AI produced content or plans.

● Works independently, communicates proactively, and follows through on every commitment.

● A positive attitude, warmth with people, and a love of teamwork and good vibes.

● Clear, confident, professional written and spoken English.



Preferred: experience with tourism, hospitality, events, food, or consumer brands.



This role is open to candidates in any country at the stated USD pay, as long as you meet every requirement and can work during our US Central Time hours.



SCHEDULE & PAY



● 15 to 20 hours per week, Monday through Friday, fully remote.

● Daily start time: 10 AM US Central Time.

● Weekly team meeting, Tuesdays 2:00 PM to 3:30 PM US Central Time (required).

● Optional online team events, held at various times.

● $6 to $9 per hour, plus potential bonus.

● Independent contractor.

● Target start date: Monday, October 19, 2026.



GOOD VIBES ONLY COMPANY



We believe in good vibes, respect, value, appreciation and fun as a company culture. We perform with excellence and have a good time along the way.



HOW TO APPLY



Subject line: Write your own
 subject line. Make us want to open your
.



Cover letter (required): Two paragraphs, simple and to the point.



Paragraph 1, your personality. Tell us why Ice Cream Sunshine caught your eye and how you bring good vibes to the people and brands you work with.



Paragraph 2, your proof. Describe one company page or personal brand you grew on LinkedIn, with real numbers such as followers, impressions, engagement rate, and the leads or sales you drove. Then add one or two sentences about your additional LinkedIn expertise and results.



Video (required): A 60 to 90 second introduction video, camera on, telling us what you love about LinkedIn, your previous results, what you hope to contribute, and your favorite ice cream. Share it as a link, such as an unlisted YouTube or Google Drive video.



The team at Ice Cream Sunshine wishes you joy always and delicious ice cream too. 🍦

title: Financial Accounting Coordinator
description:
About Eureka (Designa)



Eureka, LLC (Designa) is a growing California-based company with businesses spanning furniture, workspace solutions, and modular construction.



Our established brand, Eureka Ergonomic, designs and manufactures ergonomic furniture and workspace solutions for home, commercial, hospitality, residential, education, healthcare, and other environments. Our headquarters in Corona, California, is a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment where teams work closely across finance, operations, sales, product, manufacturing, and management.

You will work closely with company management, internal teams, vendors, and external CPAs and accounting professionals.



This position is focused on accurate execution, coordination, organization, follow-through, and reliable financial documentation. It is not a CPA sign-off position and does not independently provide tax or legal advice.



What We Offer

Dental Insurance

Vision Insurance

401(k)

Paid Time Off

Growth and advancement opportunities

Opportunity to work across Eureka Ergonomic and Eureka Modular

Fast-paced, entrepreneurial work environment

Why Join Eureka?



At Eureka, your work will directly support the company's financial operations and continued growth.

If you are someone who values accuracy, accountability, organization, problem-solving, and continuous learning, we would like to hear from you.



Apply today to join Eureka, LLC in Corona, California.

description:

About Power Plus Systems:

Our vision is to successfully wire 28,000 homes to completion by the year 2029, ensuring safe and efficient electrical solutions, thereby making a positive impact on the lives of our customers and communities. title: Virtual Assistant – Business Development Associate – Real Estate—Immediate Start —Multiple Vacancies Available
description:
VIRTUAL ASSISTANT – BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT ASSOCIATE – UK LETTINGS



TYPE OF WORK: Full-time (UK business hours)

WAGE / SALARY: $300/month fixed + $50 per let-only instruction + $75 per fully managed instruction (uncapped incentives)

HOURS PER WEEK: 40 hours, mostly UK business hours (approximately 9am–5pm UK / 4pm–midnight Philippine time)



ABOUT US



We’re a growing independent UK estate agency specialising in sales, lettings and property management. We’re part of a global luxury real estate network and are its exclusive lettings provider in the UK.



We have the brand, the agreement and the back office. What we need is someone who can turn that into a steady flow of landlord instructions.



THE ROLE



Your job is to find landlords who need an agent and persuade them to instruct us.



There’s no single method. We want someone who tries different channels, tracks what works and does more of it. You’ll be expected to use:



• OUR AGENT NETWORK – Build relationships with agents in our network’s UK offices so they refer landlords to us.



• TRADESPEOPLE & LOCAL BUSINESSES – Develop referral partnerships with builders, plumbers, electricians, cleaners, solicitors, mortgage brokers, accountants and removal firms.



• ONLINE LANDLORD SOURCES – Find landlords on platforms such as OpenRent and SpareRoom and contact those who could benefit from professional letting or property management services.



• LINKEDIN – Find and connect with landlords, investors and property professionals.



• YOUR OWN IDEAS – Come up with and test new ways of finding landlords, then share what works. We want someone who brings ideas rather than waiting for instructions.



You'll be working with the Managing Director who will handle in-person meetings and office visits. You’ll manage the day-to-day outreach between their visits and turn introductions into booked valuations.



DAILY OUTREACH TARGET



We expect approximately 100 tracked outreaches per day via
, phone, WhatsApp, LinkedIn or platform messages.



Consistent effort is essential to success in this role. Every outreach must be logged in our CRM, including replies, follow-ups and results.





WHAT YOU’LL DO



• Carry out and log approximately 100 outreaches per day across the channels listed above.

• Follow up consistently until each contact has replied, referred a landlord or declined.

• Book valuations and meetings for me and our lettings team.

• Research landlord leads using public sources and add them to the pipeline.

• Prepare short messages, one-page offers and follow-up templates, using AI tools to help with drafting.

• Keep the CRM accurate and up to date.

• Send a weekly report covering outreaches by channel, replies, valuations booked, instructions won, what’s working and what you would change.



ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS



• Experience in real estate, property, sales or customer-facing business development. UK lettings experience is a major advantage.

• Excellent spoken and written English, with the confidence to call and message UK professionals and landlords.

• Persistence and the ability to follow up without being pushy.

• Self-discipline to meet daily targets with minimal supervision.

• Willingness to learn the basics of UK lettings legislation, including the Tenant Fees Act and the Renters’ Rights Act.

• Reliable internet connection, a laptop or PC, and a quiet workspace.

• Availability to work UK business hours.

• Good internet and ability to connect via Windows RDP to a computer based in the UK to work from.



DESIRABLE EXPERIENCE



• Experience using a CRM.

• Experience in outbound sales or lead generation.

• Experience in the luxury or international property market.

• Experience working in a startup or small team.



PAY & INCENTIVES



All payments are in USD and paid monthly in arrears by bank transfer.



FIXED BASE: $300 per month



PERFORMANCE INCENTIVES:

• $50 for each new let-only instruction.

• $75 for each new fully managed instruction.



HOW IT WORKS:

• Incentives are paid once the tenancy has started and the first rent has been received.

• Incentives apply to instructions generated through your own outreach and recorded in our CRM.

• There is no cap on the number of incentives you can earn.



EARNINGS EXAMPLE



In a month where you secure 4 let-only instructions and 2 fully managed instructions:



• Fixed base: $300

• 4 let-only instructions: $200

• 2 fully managed instructions: $150



TOTAL MONTHLY EARNINGS: $650



HOW TO APPLY



Please
 your CV and a short introduction video (maximum 3 minutes) to 



 SUBJECT: BDA LETTINGS



Applications without the introduction video will not be considered.



WHAT TO COVER IN YOUR VIDEO



Please answer the following questions:



• What experience do you have in real estate, sales or business development?

• How would you persuade an agent in another office to refer their landlord to us when they don’t know us yet?

• How would you find and approach landlords on OpenRent, SpareRoom and LinkedIn? What would you say to them?

• How would you build a referral network with tradespeople and local businesses? What would you offer them?

• What other creative ideas do you have for finding landlord clients? Tell us your two best ideas.

• How do you maintain consistent daily outreach, and how would you track what’s working?

• How soon could you start, and are you able to work UK business hours?

• Please confirm that you understand the pay structure: a fixed monthly base plus incentives for each qualifying instruction, with incentives paid after the tenancy starts and the first rent is received.



We look forward to hearing from you!

Remote Work Requirements

As a remote team member, you are expected to maintain:

- Reliable high-speed internet service.

You will also be expected to:

- Maintain your assigned work schedule and remain available during scheduled hours.

- Respond to customer requests within established response-time expectations.

- Communicate proactively with your team and leadership.

- Follow company processes, SOPs, escalation procedures, and quality standards.

- Maintain accurate and timely documentation of customer interactions.



Benefits

Following successful completion of the introductory period, eligible team members will receive:

- Paid time off (PTO) in accordance with company policy.

- Paid holidays in accordance with company policy.



How to Apply

To be considered for this position, please submit:

1. Your resume.

2. A short introduction video recording.



Please ensure all required application materials are submitted. Incomplete applications will not be considered.



Join REsimpli and help us deliver fast, knowledgeable, and exceptional support to the real estate investors who rely on our platform every day.

title: Accounts Receivable Specialist
description:
>>Role Overview

We are looking for a detail-oriented and reliable Accounts Receivable Specialist with strong QuickBooks Online skills to support our finance and accounting operations.

This role requires someone who is highly comfortable working inside QuickBooks Online on a daily basis, including customer invoicing, payment application, account reconciliation, AR aging, credit memos, deposits, and customer account maintenance.



The ideal candidate has solid hands-on experience with Accounts Receivable and QuickBooks Online, can confidently navigate customer accounts and transactions, and is able to identify and resolve discrepancies without requiring constant guidance.



Strong attention to detail, organization, follow-through, and professional customer communication are essential for this position.



>>Key Responsibilities

- Use QuickBooks Online as the primary accounting platform for Accounts Receivable tasks

- Enter, review, and maintain customer invoices in QuickBooks Online

- Apply customer payments accurately to open invoices

- Record and reconcile payments received via ACH, wire transfer, check, and credit card

- Review customer balances and transaction histories in QuickBooks Online

- Review and maintain the Accounts Receivable Aging Report

- Monitor outstanding balances, payment terms, and invoice due dates

- Follow up professionally with customers regarding past-due invoices and outstanding balances

- Send customer statements, payment reminders, and collection follow-ups

- Communicate with customers regarding payment discrepancies, missing payments, and billing questions

- Post and track customer deposits, prepayments, and account credits

- Create and process credit memos for returns, shortages, billing corrections, or approved adjustments

- Research and resolve invoice, payment, and customer account discrepancies

- Coordinate with Sales and Operations regarding customer orders, invoicing, credits, and billing issues

- Reconcile Accounts Receivable balances to the general ledger

- Assist with bank, payment, and account reconciliations as needed

- Prepare weekly AR aging, collections, and outstanding balance reports for management

- Maintain accurate customer account records and supporting documentation

- Assist with month-end closing and financial reporting related to Accounts Receivable

- Ensure all customer payments are accurately recorded, matched, and processed in a timely manner



>>Qualifications

- Strong hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online is required

- Must be highly comfortable navigating QuickBooks Online independently

- Experience creating and managing invoices, applying payments, reviewing customer balances, processing deposits, and handling credit memos in QuickBooks Online

- Strong understanding of Accounts Receivable processes, including AR aging, collections, payment application, and account reconciliation

- Previous experience in Accounts Receivable, bookkeeping, accounting support, or a similar finance role

- Ability to investigate and resolve discrepancies within customer accounts

- Comfortable communicating professionally with customers regarding outstanding invoices and payment issues

- Strong attention to detail and accuracy when handling financial records

- Good organizational and time-management skills

- Ability to work independently and manage recurring deadlines

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills



>>Preferred Qualifications

- Advanced or extensive experience using QuickBooks Online

- Experience supporting a U.S.-based company

- Experience working with B2B customers

- Familiarity with ACH, wire transfers, checks, credit card payments, deposits, and credit memos

- Experience assisting with month-end reconciliation and financial reporting

- Experience coordinating with Sales, Operations, or Customer Service teams regarding billing issues



>>What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who is not only familiar with QuickBooks Online, but can use it confidently and independently as part of their day-to-day work.



This role is best suited for someone who has already worked extensively inside QuickBooks Online and understands how Accounts Receivable transactions flow through the system. The successful candidate should be able to review accounts, identify discrepancies, apply payments correctly, monitor aging balances, follow up on overdue invoices, and help ensure that AR records remain accurate and organized.



Applicants with only basic or limited QuickBooks exposure may not be a strong fit for this position.



Send your application to 
 with the subject: A-Game AR - (your name)

1. Resume link

2. OLJ link

3. Short self-intro that includes your QuickBooks experience summary



Working hours: 10am to 2pm/3pm PST

title: Customer Success & STR Operations Specialist – Full Time
description:
UPDATE: The position at 
 has now been filled, however we will be looking at further candidates for other roles in the near future; first from those that have already applied, and then from updates we receive.



We're looking for someone to join BetterSTR as a full-time, long-term member of our team.



BetterSTR provides software and technology for short-term rental owners and property managers. We also operate our own portfolio of 11 short-term rental properties.



This is a varied role combining customer support, customer success, short-term rental operations, content creation and administration. We're looking for someone intelligent, friendly, creative and proactive who can gradually take ownership of these areas rather than waiting to be told every individual task.



Your responsibilities will include:



• Monitoring our Tawk.to live chat and helping BetterSTR customers

• Learning our products and helping customers with setup and troubleshooting

• Following up customers interested in our products

• Creating short Loom how-to videos

• Updating our knowledge base, including taking new screenshots and writing instructions

• Creating
 posts and other simple customer content

• Learning Hospitable and helping manage our 11 short-term rentals

• Responding to guest messages and booking enquiries

• Helping guests with check-in and property questions

• Coordinating routine property/maintenance issues as you become trained

• Identifying recurring problems and suggesting ways we can improve our support and documentation



You don't need to know BetterSTR or every tool before starting — we will train you.



Experience with SaaS/customer support, Airbnb/short-term rentals, Hospitable, Tawk.to, Loom, Canva or similar tools is an advantage.



Excellent written and spoken English is essential. You must also be comfortable recording your voice/screen for customer tutorial videos.



This position requires 40 hours per week and includes scheduled afternoon/evening hours in the Philippines to provide coverage while our New Zealand team is offline. Your exact regular shift will be agreed before employment.



During quiet periods on live chat, you'll work on customer follow-ups, our properties, documentation, tutorials and content. This is an active working shift rather than an on-call position.



We're looking for someone who wants a stable, long-term position and can grow into greater responsibility as they learn the business.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the words BETTER GUESTS so we know you've read the full listing.



Tell us:



A little about yourself and your relevant experience.

Any customer support or short-term rental experience you have.

Whether you've used Hospitable, Tawk.to, Loom, Canva or similar tools.

Your current employment situation and whether you're available for a dedicated full-time role.

Your computer/internet setup.

Why this particular position interests you.



Finally, please include a 60–90 second Loom video introducing yourself. Tell us about yourself and briefly explain something you've learned recently.



We're not looking for a perfect video — we want to see how clearly and naturally you communicate.



Salary: US$1,000–$1,200/month depending on experience. Paid training. Salary review as responsibilities increase.
